scripts.source:
-- Small helpers shared by server and client.

local Util = {}

function Util.flat(v: Vector3): Vector3
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end

-- Unit vector on the ground plane, or nil when there is no horizontal part.
function Util.flatUnit(v: Vector3): Vector3?
	local f = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
	local m = f.Magnitude
	-- `m ~= m` catches NaN; huge catches infinity (both can come from exploiters).
	if m ~= m or m == math.huge or m < 1e-4 then
		return nil
	end
	return f.Unit
end

function Util.flatDistance(a: Vector3, b: Vector3): number
	local dx, dz = a.X - b.X, a.Z - b.Z
	return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
end

function Util.color(hex: string): Color3
	return Color3.fromHex(hex)
end

-- 6729 -> "6,729"
function Util.commas(n: number): string
	local s = tostring(math.floor(n))
	local sign = ""
	if string.sub(s, 1, 1) == "-" then
		sign, s = "-", string.sub(s, 2)
	end
	local out = s
	while true do
		local replaced, count = string.gsub(out, "^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
		out = replaced
		if count == 0 then
			break
		end
	end
	return sign .. out
end

-- 151 -> "2:31"
function Util.clock(seconds: number): string
	local s = math.max(0, math.ceil(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", s // 60, s % 60)
end

return Util

scripts.name: AdminService
scripts.source:
-- The admin panel's server side. Every request is checked here: only admins
-- (Studio testers, the experience owner, Config.ADMIN_USER_IDS) get through,
-- and every argument is validated before it touches the game.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local FurnitureService = require(script.Parent.FurnitureService)
local ItemService = require(script.Parent.ItemService)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local RoundManager = require(script.Parent.RoundManager)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local AdminService = {}

local MAX_SPEED_FACTOR = 5
local C = Config.CHARACTER

-- Where to stand someone of `scale` at a spot, feet on the floor (like spawns).
local function standAt(position: Vector3, scale: number): CFrame
	local y = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor + C.HipHeight + C.RootHeight / 2 * scale + 0.3
	return CFrame.new(position.X, y, position.Z)
end
local MAX_POINTS = 10_000_000

function AdminService.isAdmin(player: Player): boolean
	if RunService:IsStudio() then
		return true
	end
	if table.find(Config.ADMIN_USER_IDS, player.UserId) then
		return true
	end
	if game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.User then
		return player.UserId == game.CreatorId
	end
	local ok, rank = pcall(function()
		return player:GetRankInGroup(game.CreatorId)
	end)
	return ok and rank >= 254
end

-- "*" means everyone; otherwise one participant id.
local function targets(data: { [string]: any }): { Participant }
	local id = data.target
	if id == "*" then
		return Participants.all()
	end
	local p = if typeof(id) == "string" then Participants.get(id) else nil
	return if p then { p } else {}
end

local function number(value: any, low: number, high: number): number?
	if typeof(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then
		return nil
	end
	return math.clamp(value, low, high)
end

local function names(list: { Participant }): string
	if #list == 1 then
		return list[1].name
	end
	return #list .. " players"
end

type Handler = (admin: Participant, data: { [string]: any }) -> (boolean, string)

local ACTIONS: { [string]: Handler } = {}

-- Items ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function ACTIONS.give(admin, data)
	local item = Items.get(if typeof(data.item) == "string" then data.item else nil)
	if not item then
		return false, "Unknown item"
	end
	if data.ground == true then
		local root = Participants.body(admin)
		if not root then
			return false, "You need a character to drop items"
		end
		ItemService.spawnGround(item.id, root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * 5)
		return true, item.name .. " dropped in front of you"
	end
	local list = targets(data)
	local given = 0
	for _, p in list do
		if p.team == "Human" then
			ItemService.give(p, item.id)
			given += 1
		end
	end
	if given == 0 then
		return false, "Only humans can hold items"
	end
	return true, string.format("Gave %s to %s", item.name, names(list))
end

-- Players -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function ACTIONS.speed(_admin, data)
	local factor = number(data.factor, 0, MAX_SPEED_FACTOR)
	if not factor then
		return false, "Bad speed"
	end
	local list = targets(data)
	for _, p in list do
		p.adminSpeed = factor
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	end
	return #list > 0, string.format("Speed x%.2g for %s", factor, names(list))
end

function ACTIONS.points(_admin, data)
	local add = number(data.add, -MAX_POINTS, MAX_POINTS)
	local set = number(data.set, 0, MAX_POINTS)
	if not add and not set then
		return false, "Bad points"
	end
	local list = targets(data)
	for _, p in list do
		Participants.setScore(p, if set then set else p.score + (add or 0))
		CharacterService.refreshSize(p)
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	end
	local what = if set then "set to " .. Util.commas(set) else string.format("%+d", add or 0)
	return #list > 0, string.format("Points %s for %s", what, names(list))
end

function ACTIONS.immunity(_admin, data)
	local value = number(data.value, 0, Config.IMMUNITY_MAX)
	if not value then
		return false, "Bad immunity"
	end
	local list = targets(data)
	for _, p in list do
		Participants.setImmunity(p, value)
	end
	return #list > 0, string.format("Immunity %d for %s", value, names(list))
end

function ACTIONS.team(_admin, data)
	local team = data.team
	if team ~= "Human" and team ~= "Zombie" then
		return false, "Bad team"
	end
	local list = targets(data)
	for _, p in list do
		RoundManager.setTeam(p, team)
	end
	return #list > 0, string.format("%s now %s", names(list), if team == "Zombie" then "zombie" else "human")
end

function ACTIONS.bring(admin, data)
	local root = Participants.body(admin)
	if not root then
		return false, "You need a character"
	end
	local list = targets(data)
	for i, p in list do
		if p ~= admin then
			local angle = i / math.max(1, #list) * math.pi * 2
			local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * 6
			CharacterService.place(p, standAt(root.Position + offset * math.max(1, p.scale), p.scale))
		end
	end
	return #list > 0, "Brought " .. names(list)
end

function ACTIONS.goTo(admin, data)
	local list = targets(data)
	local target = list[1]
	local root = target and Participants.body(target)
	if not target or target == admin or not root then
		return false, "Pick one other player"
	end
	CharacterService.place(
		admin,
		standAt(root.Position + Vector3.new(6 * math.max(1, target.scale), 0, 0), admin.scale)
	)
	return true, "Went to " .. target.name
end

function ACTIONS.respawn(_admin, data)
	local list = targets(data)
	for _, p in list do
		RoundManager.respawn(p)
	end
	return #list > 0, "Respawned " .. names(list)
end

-- Round ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function ACTIONS.skip()
	if RoundManager.skipPhase() then
		return true, "Skipped to the next phase"
	end
	return false, "Nothing to skip right now"
end

function ACTIONS.time(_admin, data)
	local seconds = number(data.seconds, -600, 600)
	if not seconds then
		return false, "Bad time"
	end
	if RoundManager.addTime(seconds) then
		return true, string.format("%+d seconds", seconds)
	end
	return false, "No timer to change right now"
end

function ACTIONS.nextMap()
	if RoundManager.queueNextMap() then
		return true, "Next round loads the next map"
	end
	return false, "Only one map is in the rotation"
end

function ACTIONS.resetFurniture()
	FurnitureService.resetAll()
	return true, "Furniture put back"
end

function ACTIONS.clearItems()
	ItemService.clearGround()
	return true, "Ground items removed"
end

local function handle(player: Player, action: unknown, data: unknown): (boolean, string)
	if not AdminService.isAdmin(player) then
		return false, "Not an admin"
	end
	local admin = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	local handler = if typeof(action) == "string" then ACTIONS[action] else nil
	if not admin or not handler then
		return false, "Unknown command"
	end
	local args: { [string]: any } = if typeof(data) == "table" then data :: any else {}
	local ok, success, message = pcall(handler, admin, args)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Admin] " .. tostring(action) .. " failed: " .. tostring(success))
		return false, "That failed (see server output)"
	end
	return success, message
end

function AdminService.init()
	Remotes.func("Admin").OnServerInvoke = handle
	Participants.onAdded(function(p)
		if p.player and AdminService.isAdmin(p.player) then
			p.state:SetAttribute("Admin", true)
		end
	end)
end

return AdminService

scripts.name: Announcer
scripts.source:
-- Server -> client messages: yellow system lines in chat, short on-screen
-- toasts, and visual/sound effects that every client plays locally.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)

local Announcer = {}

local announce = Remotes.event("Announce")
local toast = Remotes.event("Toast")
local fx = Remotes.event("Fx")

function Announcer.chat(text: string, hex: string?)
	announce:FireAllClients(text, hex or Config.COLORS.SystemMessage)
end

function Announcer.toast(player: Player?, text: string, hex: string?)
	if player then
		toast:FireClient(player, text, hex)
	else
		toast:FireAllClients(text, hex)
	end
end

function Announcer.fx(kind: string, data: { [string]: any })
	fx:FireAllClients(kind, data)
end

return Announcer

scripts.name: BotService
scripts.source:
-- Bots that play every round with everyone (Config.BOTS). They count as
-- participants for every rule. Each has a difficulty level from 1 (dopey)
-- to 5 (Mario Robles):
--   * thinks faster, walks faster and sees farther
--   * as a zombie: leads its target, remembers where a human hid, and
--     presses "Z" sooner when stuck
--   * as a human: grabs items during prep (top levels "buy" one), swings at
--     zombies that get close, flees smarter and hides in bushes more

local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Bushes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Bushes)
local BushService = require(script.Parent.BushService)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Combat = require(script.Parent.Combat)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local ItemService = require(script.Parent.ItemService)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local RoundManager = require(script.Parent.RoundManager)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local BotService = {}

type Level = {
	think: number, -- seconds between decisions
	speed: number, -- walk speed multiplier
	sight: number, -- zombie: how far away it notices humans
	lead: number, -- zombie: seconds of target movement it predicts
	memory: number, -- zombie: seconds it keeps chasing where a human vanished
	stuck: number, -- zombie: seconds stuck before pressing Z
	flee: number, -- human: zombie distance that starts a run
	directions: number, -- human: escape directions considered
	hide: number, -- human: chance to be a bush hider
	swing: number, -- human: chance per decision to swing at a close zombie
	grab: boolean, -- human: walks to items during prep
	buys: boolean, -- human: starts each round with a weapon
}

local LEVELS: { Level } = {
	{
		think = 0.45,
		speed = 0.82,
		sight = 35,
		lead = 0,
		memory = 0,
		stuck = 8,
		flee = 25,
		directions = 6,
		hide = 0.15,
		swing = 0,
		grab = false,
		buys = false,
	},
	{
		think = 0.3,
		speed = 0.9,
		sight = 55,
		lead = 0.15,
		memory = 1,
		stuck = 7,
		flee = 35,
		directions = 8,
		hide = 0.3,
		swing = 0.25,
		grab = false,
		buys = false,
	},
	{
		think = 0.2,
		speed = 0.97,
		sight = 85,
		lead = 0.35,
		memory = 2.5,
		stuck = 6,
		flee = 45,
		directions = 12,
		hide = 0.45,
		swing = 0.55,
		grab = true,
		buys = false,
	},
	{
		think = 0.12,
		speed = 1.04,
		sight = 140,
		lead = 0.5,
		memory = 4,
		stuck = 4.5,
		flee = 55,
		directions = 16,
		hide = 0.55,
		swing = 0.85,
		grab = true,
		buys = true,
	},
	{
		think = 0.07,
		speed = 1.12,
		sight = 500,
		lead = 0.7,
		memory = 7,
		stuck = 3,
		flee = 70,
		directions = 20,
		hide = 0.65,
		swing = 1,
		grab = true,
		buys = true,
	},
}

-- Name and difficulty. The first Config.BOT_COUNT of these join.
local ROSTER: { { name: string, level: number } } = {
	{ name = "Mario Robles", level = 5 },
	{ name = "Fart Butt", level = 2 },
	{ name = "Poop Face", level = 3 },
	{ name = "Fat Guy", level = 1 },
	{ name = "Booger Bob", level = 4 },
	{ name = "Stinky Pete", level = 3 },
	{ name = "Captain Wedgie", level = 2 },
	{ name = "Toilet Ted", level = 1 },
	{ name = "Sir Toots-a-Lot", level = 4 },
	{ name = "Sweaty Steve", level = 3 },
	{ name = "Moldy Cheese", level = 2 },
	{ name = "Burp Master", level = 4 },
}

-- Weapons the top bots "buy" at the start of a round.
local STARTER_WEAPONS = { "Bat", "Spear", "Swordfish", "FryingPan", "Katana", "Lollipop" }

local function randomInside(rng: Random): Vector3
	local layout = MapLayout.current()
	local list = if rng:NextNumber() < 0.6 then layout.itemSpots else layout.humanSpawns
	local spot = list[rng:NextInteger(1, #list)]
	return Vector3.new(spot.x, 2, spot.z)
end

local function inBounds(v: Vector3): boolean
	return MapLayout.inRect(MapLayout.current().bounds, v.X, v.Z, -4)
end

-- Center of the nearest bush within `range`, to hide in.
local function nearestBush(from: Vector3, range: number): Vector3?
	local best: Vector3? = nil
	local bestDistance = range
	for _, leaves in Bushes.leaves() do
		local d = Util.flatDistance(leaves.Position, from)
		if d < bestDistance then
			best, bestDistance = Vector3.new(leaves.Position.X, from.Y, leaves.Position.Z), d
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- Nearest ground item within `range`.
local function nearestItem(from: Vector3, range: number): Vector3?
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("GroundItems")
	if not folder then
		return nil
	end
	local best: Vector3? = nil
	local bestDistance = range
	for _, model in folder:GetChildren() do
		local x, z = model:GetAttribute("SpotX"), model:GetAttribute("SpotZ")
		if typeof(x) == "number" and typeof(z) == "number" then
			local spot = Vector3.new(x, from.Y, z)
			local d = Util.flatDistance(spot, from)
			if d < bestDistance then
				best, bestDistance = spot, d
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- The nearest member of `team` this bot can notice: within `sight`, and
-- not hidden in a bush (unless close). Returns their root too.
local function nearest(me: Participant, from: Vector3, team: string, sight: number): (BasePart?, number)
	local best: BasePart? = nil
	local bestDistance = math.huge
	for _, other in Participants.onTeam(team :: Participants.Team) do
		if other ~= me then
			local root = Participants.body(other)
			if root and BushService.visibleFrom(other, from) then
				local d = Util.flatDistance(root.Position, from)
				if d < bestDistance and d <= sight then
					best, bestDistance = root, d
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best, bestDistance
end

local function brain(p: Participant, level: Level, rng: Random)
	local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
		AgentRadius = 2,
		AgentHeight = 4,
		AgentCanJump = false,
		WaypointSpacing = 5,
	})
	local waypoints: { PathWaypoint } = {}
	local waypointIndex = 1
	local pathGoal: Vector3? = nil
	local computedAt = 0
	local wanderGoal: Vector3? = nil
	local wanderUntil = 0
	local lastPosition = Vector3.zero
	local stuckSince = os.clock()
	local hider = rng:NextNumber() < level.hide
	local lastSeen: Vector3? = nil -- zombie memory of a target that vanished
	local lastSeenAt = 0
	local armedRound = -1

	local function followPath(goal: Vector3, root: BasePart, humanoid: Humanoid)
		local now = os.clock()
		local refresh = math.max(0.4, level.think * 5)
		if not pathGoal or now - computedAt > refresh or (goal - pathGoal).Magnitude > 8 then
			pathGoal, computedAt = goal, now
			local ok = pcall(function()
				path:ComputeAsync(root.Position, goal)
			end)
			if ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
				waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
				waypointIndex = math.min(2, #waypoints)
			else
				waypoints = {}
			end
		end
		local waypoint = waypoints[waypointIndex]
		if waypoint then
			if Util.flatDistance(waypoint.Position, root.Position) < 2.5 and waypointIndex < #waypoints then
				waypointIndex += 1
				waypoint = waypoints[waypointIndex]
			end
			humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
		else
			humanoid:MoveTo(goal)
		end
	end

	-- Walk straight when nothing is in the way (sharper), else pathfind.
	local function goTo(goal: Vector3, root: BasePart, humanoid: Humanoid)
		if Util.flatDistance(goal, root.Position) < 30 and Combat.clearPath(root.Position, goal) then
			humanoid:MoveTo(goal)
			pathGoal = nil
		else
			followPath(goal, root, humanoid)
		end
	end

	while Participants.get(p.id) == p do
		task.wait(level.think * rng:NextNumber(0.8, 1.2))
		local root, humanoid = Participants.body(p)
		if not root or not humanoid then
			continue
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if (root.Position - lastPosition).Magnitude > 1.5 then
			lastPosition = root.Position
			stuckSince = now
		end
		local phase = RoundManager.phase()

		local function wander()
			if not wanderGoal or now > wanderUntil or Util.flatDistance(wanderGoal, root.Position) < 3 then
				wanderGoal = randomInside(rng)
				wanderUntil = now + rng:NextNumber(6, 12)
			end
			followPath(wanderGoal :: Vector3, root, humanoid)
		end

		if p.team == "Zombie" then
			local target, distance = nearest(p, root.Position, "Human", level.sight)
			if target then
				-- Aim where the human is going, not where they are.
				local lead = Util.flat(target.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
					* level.lead
					* math.min(1, distance / 20)
				local goal = target.Position + lead
				lastSeen, lastSeenAt = goal, now
				goTo(goal, root, humanoid)
			elseif lastSeen and now - lastSeenAt < level.memory then
				goTo(lastSeen, root, humanoid) -- check where they vanished
			else
				lastSeen = nil
				wander()
			end
			if now - stuckSince > level.stuck then
				RoundManager.zombieReturn(p)
				stuckSince = now
				lastPosition = root.Position
			end
			continue
		end

		-- Human ----------------------------------------------------------------------
		local round = RoundManager.roundNumber()
		if level.buys and phase == "Prep" and armedRound ~= round and not p.heldItem then
			armedRound = round
			ItemService.give(p, STARTER_WEAPONS[rng:NextInteger(1, #STARTER_WEAPONS)])
		end
		local item = Items.get(p.heldItem)
		local threat, distance = nearest(p, root.Position, "Zombie", math.huge)

		-- Swing at a zombie in reach.
		if
			threat
			and item
			and (item.kind == "Melee" or item.kind == "Blast" or item.kind == "Projectile")
		then
			local reach = if item.kind == "Projectile"
				then 40
				else (item.reach or 5) * math.max(1, p.scale * 0.9) + 2
			if distance <= reach and rng:NextNumber() < level.swing then
				local aim = Util.flatUnit(threat.Position - root.Position)
				if aim then
					ItemService.botUse(p, aim)
				end
			end
		end

		local hidden = BushService.hidden(p)
		local bush = if hider and not hidden then nearestBush(root.Position, 35) else nil
		if hidden and (not threat or distance > Config.BUSH_REVEAL_DISTANCE) then
			humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position) -- stay still and hope
		elseif threat and distance < level.flee and bush then
			followPath(bush, root, humanoid)
		elseif threat and distance < level.flee then
			-- Try several directions and run toward the one that keeps the
			-- most distance from every zombie (better bots look further).
			local stride = 10 + level.directions * 0.5
			local best: Vector3? = nil
			local bestScore = -math.huge
			for i = 0, level.directions - 1 do
				local angle = i / level.directions * math.pi * 2
				local candidate = root.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * stride
				if inBounds(candidate) and Combat.clearPath(root.Position, candidate) then
					local _, away = nearest(p, candidate, "Zombie", math.huge)
					if away > bestScore then
						best, bestScore = candidate, away
					end
				end
			end
			humanoid:MoveTo(best or (root.Position + (root.Position - threat.Position).Unit * 10))
			pathGoal = nil
		elseif level.grab and phase == "Prep" and not p.heldItem then
			local spot = nearestItem(root.Position, 80)
			if spot then
				if Util.flatDistance(spot, root.Position) < Config.PICKUP_RADIUS then
					ItemService.pickUp(p)
				else
					goTo(spot, root, humanoid)
				end
			else
				wander()
			end
		else
			wander()
		end
		-- Hold the weapon out the way you're going (it's solid).
		local facing = Util.flatUnit(root.CFrame.LookVector)
		if facing then
			p.aim = facing
		end
	end
end

function BotService.start()
	if not Config.BOTS then
		return
	end
	local count = math.min(Config.BOT_COUNT, #ROSTER)
	print(string.format("[Bots] %d bots are playing. Set Config.BOTS = false to turn them off.", count))
	for i = 1, count do
		local entry = ROSTER[i]
		local level = LEVELS[math.clamp(entry.level, 1, #LEVELS)]
		local p = Participants.add({
			id = "B" .. i,
			name = entry.name,
			isBot = true,
		})
		p.adminSpeed = level.speed
		p.state:SetAttribute("BotLevel", entry.level)
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
		task.spawn(brain, p, level, Random.new(i * 97 + os.time()))
	end
end

return BotService

scripts.name: BushService
scripts.source:
-- Flags characters standing in a bush (character attribute "InBush") so bots
-- can't see them. Clients work out the visual side (name tags, see-through
-- canopy) themselves from the same shared geometry.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Bushes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Bushes)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local BushService = {}

local INTERVAL = 0.1

function BushService.hidden(p: Participant): boolean
	local character = p.character
	return character ~= nil and character:GetAttribute(Bushes.ATTRIBUTE) == true
end

-- Whether someone at `from` can spot `p`: always, unless `p` is in a bush
-- and the looker is farther than the reveal distance.
function BushService.visibleFrom(p: Participant, from: Vector3): boolean
	if not BushService.hidden(p) then
		return true
	end
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	return root ~= nil and Util.flatDistance(root.Position, from) <= Config.BUSH_REVEAL_DISTANCE
end

function BushService.init()
	local elapsed = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed < INTERVAL then
			return
		end
		elapsed = 0
		for _, p in Participants.all() do
			local character = p.character
			if character then
				local root = Participants.body(p)
				local hidden = root ~= nil and Bushes.coverAt(root.Position) ~= nil
				if character:GetAttribute(Bushes.ATTRIBUTE) ~= hidden then
					character:SetAttribute(Bushes.ATTRIBUTE, hidden)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return BushService

scripts.name: CharacterService
scripts.source:
-- Spawns and dresses characters. Every player and bot uses the same custom
-- rig: an invisible collision box (HumanoidRootPart) with a Humanoid, wearing
-- the flat blob look from CharacterLook. Avatars, clothes and accessories are
-- never loaded.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local StarterPlayer = game:GetService("StarterPlayer")

local CharacterLook = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CharacterLook)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)
local RoundRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoundRules)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)

local C = Config.CHARACTER

local CharacterService = {}

type Participant = Participants.Participant

-- Called when a character died or vanished and needs a new one. RoundManager
-- sets this so it can choose the right spawn for the current phase.
CharacterService.onNeedRespawn = function(_p: Participant) end

-- Called after a participant's size changed, so the held item can be
-- re-attached at the new grip. ItemService sets this.
CharacterService.onResized = function(_p: Participant) end

local template: Model

function CharacterService.buildTemplate()
	local existing = StarterPlayer:FindFirstChild("StarterCharacter")
	if existing then
		existing:Destroy()
	end
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "StarterCharacter"

	local root = Parts.make({
		name = "HumanoidRootPart",
		size = Vector3.new(C.RootWidth, C.RootHeight, C.RootWidth),
		cframe = CFrame.new(0, 5, 0),
		color = "FFFFFF",
		transparency = 1,
		anchored = false,
		parent = model,
	})
	root.CanQuery = true -- the hitbox for potatoes and line-of-sight checks
	model.PrimaryPart = root

	local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
	humanoid.RigType = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
	humanoid.HipHeight = C.HipHeight
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.BASE_WALKSPEED
	humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
	humanoid.JumpPower = 0
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	humanoid.RequiresNeck = false
	humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
	humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	humanoid.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
	humanoid.Parent = model

	CharacterLook.apply(model, root, nil, "Human", 1)
	model.Parent = StarterPlayer
	template = model
end

local function nameColor(p: Participant): Color3
	if p.passes.VIP then
		return Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.VipName)
	end
	return Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.OtherName)
end

local function updateNameTag(p: Participant)
	local character = p.character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
	if not head then
		return
	end
	local tag = head:FindFirstChild("NameTag") :: BillboardGui?
	if not tag then
		local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		gui.Name = "NameTag"
		gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 24)
		gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
		gui.LightInfluence = 0
		gui.MaxDistance = 1000
		gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = "Label"
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		label.Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansBold
		label.TextSize = 16
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
		label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
		label.Parent = gui
		gui.Parent = head
		tag = gui
	end
	assert(tag, "tag")
	tag.Adornee = head
	-- World offset toward -Z = "up" on the top-down screen.
	tag.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 1, -(C.BodyWidth * 0.5 + 0.7) * p.scale)
	tag:SetAttribute("ParticipantId", p.id)
	local label = tag:FindFirstChild("Label") :: TextLabel
	label.Text = (if p.passes.VIP then "[VIP] " else "") .. p.name
	label.TextColor3 = nameColor(p)
end

function CharacterService.skinFor(p: Participant): string
	if p.team == "Zombie" and p.alpha then
		return "Alpha"
	end
	return if p.team == "Zombie" then p.zombieSkin else p.humanSkin
end

-- An invisible cylinder the size of the drawn body. Only other characters'
-- shells collide with it (see WorldSetup), so characters bump into each
-- other while the narrow root box still decides what fits through doors.
local function addShell(character: Model, root: BasePart, scale: number)
	local old = character:FindFirstChild("Shell")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local diameter = C.ShellDiameter * scale
	local shell = Instance.new("Part")
	shell.Name = "Shell"
	shell.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	shell.Size = Vector3.new(C.RootHeight * scale, diameter, diameter)
	shell.CFrame = root.CFrame * Parts.UPRIGHT
	shell.Transparency = 1
	shell.Massless = true
	shell.CanCollide = true
	shell.CanQuery = false
	shell.CanTouch = true -- your client plays a bump sound on contact
	shell.CastShadow = false
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = root
	weld.Part1 = shell
	weld.Parent = shell
	shell.Parent = character
	shell.CollisionGroup = "CharacterShells"
end

-- Rebuilds the look for the participant's team, skin and size.
function CharacterService.applyLook(p: Participant)
	local character = p.character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	root.Size = Vector3.new(C.RootWidth, C.RootHeight, C.RootWidth) * p.scale
	-- Hip height stays fixed while the body grows, so even giant players keep
	-- their collision box low enough to bump into benches and coffee tables.
	humanoid.HipHeight = C.HipHeight
	CharacterLook.apply(character, root, CharacterService.skinFor(p), p.team, p.scale)
	for _, part in character:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CollisionGroup = "Characters"
		end
	end
	addShell(character, root, p.scale)
	character:SetAttribute("Team", p.team)
	updateNameTag(p)
end

function CharacterService.refreshNameTag(p: Participant)
	updateNameTag(p)
end

-- Size follows score live: call after a participant's score changes. Only
-- rebuilds the look when the size really changed.
function CharacterService.refreshSize(p: Participant)
	local scale = RoundRules.scaleForScore(p.score)
	if math.abs(scale - p.scale) < 0.01 then
		return
	end
	p.scale = scale
	p.state:SetAttribute("Scale", scale)
	CharacterService.applyLook(p)
	CharacterService.onResized(p)
end

function CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p: Participant)
	local _, humanoid = Participants.body(p)
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < p.stunUntil then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
		return
	end
	local speed = RoundRules.walkSpeed(p.score, p.team == "Zombie") * p.adminSpeed
	if now < p.boostUntil then
		speed *= p.boostFactor
	end
	if now < p.slowUntil then
		speed *= p.slowFactor
	end
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed
end

-- Speeds a participant up (energy drink) or down (snowball) for a while.
function CharacterService.speedEffect(p: Participant, factor: number, seconds: number)
	local untilTime = os.clock() + seconds
	if factor >= 1 then
		p.boostFactor, p.boostUntil = factor, math.max(p.boostUntil, untilTime)
	else
		p.slowFactor, p.slowUntil = factor, math.max(p.slowUntil, untilTime)
	end
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	task.delay(seconds + 0.05, function()
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	end)
end

local function setup(p: Participant, character: Model)
	p.character = character
	character:SetAttribute("ParticipantId", p.id)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	assert(humanoid, "character has no Humanoid")
	humanoid.AutoRotate = p.isBot -- players face the mouse from their client
	humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	CharacterService.applyLook(p)
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		task.delay(2, function()
			if Participants.get(p.id) == p and p.character == character then
				CharacterService.onNeedRespawn(p)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function spawnBot(p: Participant, at: CFrame): Model
	local character = template:Clone()
	character.Name = p.name
	character:PivotTo(at)
	character.Parent = workspace:WaitForChild("Bots")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart
	pcall(function()
		root:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	end)
	setup(p, character)
	return character
end

local function spawnPlayer(p: Participant, at: CFrame): Model?
	local player = p.player
	if not player or player.Parent ~= Players then
		return nil
	end
	player:LoadCharacter()
	local character = player.Character
	if not character or Participants.get(p.id) ~= p then
		return nil
	end
	setup(p, character)
	character:PivotTo(at)
	return character
end

-- Gives the participant a fresh character standing at `at`.
function CharacterService.spawn(p: Participant, at: CFrame): Model?
	if p.spawning then
		return nil -- a spawn is already in progress (LoadCharacter yields)
	end
	p.spawning = true
	local ok, result = pcall(function(): Model?
		if p.isBot then
			if p.character then
				p.character:Destroy()
			end
			return spawnBot(p, at)
		end
		return spawnPlayer(p, at)
	end)
	p.spawning = false
	if not ok then
		warn("[Characters] spawn failed for " .. p.name .. ": " .. tostring(result))
		return nil
	end
	return result
end

-- Moves an existing living character, or spawns one if there is none.
function CharacterService.place(p: Participant, at: CFrame)
	if p.spawning then
		return
	end
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	if not root or not p.character then
		CharacterService.spawn(p, at)
		return
	end
	p.character:PivotTo(at)
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

function CharacterService.init()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		player.CanLoadCharacterAppearance = false
	end)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		player.CanLoadCharacterAppearance = false
	end
end

return CharacterService

scripts.name: Combat
scripts.source:
-- Shoves and stuns. Weapons never kill: they push zombies away and freeze
-- them for a moment. Players' characters are simulated by their own clients,
-- so their shove is sent to them; bots are shoved right here.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Knockback = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Knockback)
local MapBuilder = require(script.Parent.MapBuilder)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local Combat = {}

local knockbackRemote = Remotes.event("Knockback")
local wallParams = RaycastParams.new()
wallParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
local solidParams = RaycastParams.new()
solidParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

function Combat.init()
	wallParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { MapBuilder.wallsFolder() }
	solidParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { MapBuilder.wallsFolder(), workspace:WaitForChild("Furniture") }
end

-- Like lineOfSight, but furniture blocks too (used for infection, so a
-- barricade always protects the people behind it).
function Combat.clearPath(from: Vector3, to: Vector3): boolean
	-- Low enough to hit every piece of furniture, whatever the players' size.
	local y = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor + 1.4
	local a = Vector3.new(from.X, y, from.Z)
	local b = Vector3.new(to.X, y, to.Z)
	return workspace:Raycast(a, b - a, solidParams) == nil
end

-- True when no (unbroken) wall stands between the two points.
function Combat.lineOfSight(from: Vector3, to: Vector3): boolean
	local y = math.max(from.Y, to.Y)
	local a = Vector3.new(from.X, y, from.Z)
	local b = Vector3.new(to.X, y, to.Z)
	return workspace:Raycast(a, b - a, wallParams) == nil
end

function Combat.wallParams(): RaycastParams
	return wallParams
end

-- `gentle` shoves (a zombie leaning on a held weapon) never cut short a
-- real hit that is still sending the zombie flying.
function Combat.knockback(
	target: Participant,
	velocity: Vector3,
	stun: number,
	seconds: number?,
	gentle: boolean?
)
	local root = Participants.body(target)
	local character = target.character
	if not root or not character then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if gentle and now < target.knockedUntil then
		return
	end
	if stun > 0 then
		target.stunUntil = math.max(target.stunUntil, os.clock() + stun)
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(target)
		task.delay(stun + 0.05, function()
			CharacterService.refreshSpeed(target)
		end)
	end
	local duration = seconds or Config.KNOCKBACK_SECONDS
	if not gentle then
		target.knockedUntil = now + duration
	end
	if target.player then
		knockbackRemote:FireClient(target.player, velocity, duration)
	else
		Knockback.apply(character, velocity, duration)
	end
end

-- Area blast (duck launcher): shoves every zombie within `radius` away from
-- the center, with a classic (harmless) Roblox explosion for show.
function Combat.explode(at: Vector3, radius: number, knockback: number, stun: number)
	local boom = Instance.new("Explosion")
	boom.Position = at
	boom.BlastRadius = radius
	boom.BlastPressure = 0
	boom.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
	boom.ExplosionType = Enum.ExplosionType.NoCraters
	boom.Parent = workspace
	for _, zombie in Participants.onTeam("Zombie") do
		local root = Participants.body(zombie)
		if root then
			local offset = Util.flat(root.Position - at)
			if offset.Magnitude <= radius and Combat.lineOfSight(at, root.Position) then
				local away = if offset.Magnitude > 0.1 then offset.Unit else Vector3.xAxis
				local falloff = 1 - offset.Magnitude / radius * 0.5
				Combat.knockback(zombie, away * knockback * falloff, stun)
			end
		end
	end
end

export type Hit = { target: Participant, direction: Vector3, distance: number }

-- Zombies inside a cone in front of `attacker`, not behind walls.
function Combat.zombiesInCone(attacker: Participant, aim: Vector3, reach: number, arcDegrees: number): { Hit }
	local root = Participants.body(attacker)
	local hits = {}
	if not root then
		return hits
	end
	local cosHalf = math.cos(math.rad(arcDegrees / 2))
	local myRadius = root.Size.X / 2
	for _, zombie in Participants.onTeam("Zombie") do
		local zRoot = Participants.body(zombie)
		if zRoot then
			local offset = Util.flat(zRoot.Position - root.Position)
			local distance = offset.Magnitude
			local zRadius = zRoot.Size.X / 2
			if distance > 0.01 and distance <= reach + zRadius then
				local direction = offset.Unit
				local touching = distance <= myRadius + zRadius + 0.6
				if
					(touching or direction:Dot(aim) >= cosHalf)
					and Combat.lineOfSight(root.Position, zRoot.Position)
				then
					table.insert(hits, { target = zombie, direction = direction, distance = distance })
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return hits
end

return Combat

scripts.name: DataService
scripts.source:
-- Saves each player's score, stats, skins and purchases with DataStoreService.
--
-- Safety rules:
--  * Every DataStore call is wrapped in pcall and retried with backoff.
--  * If a player's data fails to load, the session uses defaults and is NEVER
--    saved, so a hiccup can't overwrite real progress with zeros.
--  * In Studio without "Enable Studio Access to API Services" (Game Settings >
--    Security), saving is off for the session and a single warning explains why.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Skins = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Skins)

local DataService = {}

local VERSION = 1
local MAX_RECEIPTS = 100

export type Profile = {
	Version: number,
	Score: number,
	Wins: number,
	Infections: number,
	RoundsPlayed: number,
	OwnedSkins: { [string]: boolean },
	HumanSkin: string,
	ZombieSkin: string,
	SeenTutorial: boolean,
	BoostEndsAt: number,
	PendingItems: { string },
	Receipts: { [string]: number },
}

type Session = {
	data: Profile,
	loaded: boolean, -- false = defaults after a failed load; never saved
	saving: boolean,
}

local sessions: { [Player]: Session } = {}
local store: DataStore? = nil
local orderedStore: OrderedDataStore? = nil
local available = false
local warned = false

local function defaults(): Profile
	return {
		Version = VERSION,
		Score = 0,
		Wins = 0,
		Infections = 0,
		RoundsPlayed = 0,
		OwnedSkins = { [Skins.DEFAULT_HUMAN] = true, [Skins.DEFAULT_ZOMBIE] = true },
		HumanSkin = Skins.DEFAULT_HUMAN,
		ZombieSkin = Skins.DEFAULT_ZOMBIE,
		SeenTutorial = false,
		BoostEndsAt = 0,
		PendingItems = {},
		Receipts = {},
	}
end

-- Fills in any fields added after a player's data was first saved.
local function reconcile(saved: any): Profile
	local data = defaults()
	if type(saved) ~= "table" then
		return data
	end
	for key, value in saved do
		if (data :: any)[key] ~= nil and type(value) == type((data :: any)[key]) then
			(data :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	data.OwnedSkins[Skins.DEFAULT_HUMAN] = true
	data.OwnedSkins[Skins.DEFAULT_ZOMBIE] = true
	return data
end

local function warnOnce(message: string)
	if not warned then
		warned = true
		warn("[Data] " .. message)
	end
end

local function retry<T>(label: string, fn: () -> T): (boolean, T?)
	local lastError
	for attempt = 1, 4 do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		lastError = result
		task.wait(attempt * 1.5)
	end
	warn(string.format("[Data] %s failed: %s", label, tostring(lastError)))
	return false, nil
end

local function key(player: Player): string
	return "u_" .. player.UserId
end

function DataService.init()
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DATASTORE_NAME)
	end)
	if ok then
		store = result
		local okOrdered, ordered = pcall(function()
			return DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore(Config.LEADERBOARD_STORE_NAME)
		end)
		if okOrdered then
			orderedStore = ordered
		end
		-- A cheap read tells us whether DataStores actually work here.
		local probe = pcall(function()
			(store :: DataStore):GetAsync("__probe")
		end)
		available = probe
	end
	if not available then
		if RunService:IsStudio() then
			warnOnce(
				"Saving is OFF in this test. To save in Studio: publish the place (File > Publish to Roblox), then Game Settings > Security > Enable Studio Access to API Services."
			)
		else
			warnOnce("DataStores are unavailable right now; this server will not save.")
		end
	end

	game:BindToClose(function()
		local threads = {}
		for player in sessions do
			table.insert(
				threads,
				task.spawn(function()
					DataService.save(player)
				end)
			)
		end
		-- Give saves time to finish (BindToClose allows about 30 seconds).
		local deadline = os.clock() + 25
		while os.clock() < deadline do
			local busy = false
			for _, session in sessions do
				if session.saving then
					busy = true
				end
			end
			if not busy then
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.AUTOSAVE_SECONDS)
			for player in sessions do
				task.spawn(DataService.save, player)
			end
		end
	end)
end

function DataService.isAvailable(): boolean
	return available
end

-- Loads (yields). Always returns a profile; check `isSaved` to know whether
-- it came from the DataStore.
function DataService.load(player: Player): Profile
	local session: Session = { data = defaults(), loaded = false, saving = false }
	if available and store then
		local ok, saved = retry("load " .. player.UserId, function()
			return (store :: DataStore):GetAsync(key(player))
		end)
		if ok then
			session.data = reconcile(saved)
			session.loaded = true
		end
	end
	if player.Parent ~= Players then
		-- They left while we were loading: never register (or autosave) this
		-- stale copy, or it could overwrite progress made in another server.
		return session.data
	end
	sessions[player] = session
	return session.data
end

function DataService.get(player: Player): Profile?
	local session = sessions[player]
	return session and session.data
end

function DataService.isSaved(player: Player): boolean
	local session = sessions[player]
	return session ~= nil and session.loaded
end

-- Keeps the receipt log small: drops the oldest entries past MAX_RECEIPTS.
local function trimReceipts(data: Profile)
	local list = {}
	for id, at in data.Receipts do
		table.insert(list, { id = id, at = at })
	end
	if #list <= MAX_RECEIPTS then
		return
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return a.at > b.at
	end)
	for i = MAX_RECEIPTS + 1, #list do
		data.Receipts[list[i].id] = nil
	end
end

-- Writes the player's profile. Returns true when it reached the DataStore.
function DataService.save(player: Player): boolean
	local session = sessions[player]
	if not session or not session.loaded or not available or not store then
		return false
	end
	while session.saving do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	session.saving = true
	trimReceipts(session.data)
	local snapshot = table.clone(session.data)
	local ok = retry("save " .. player.UserId, function()
		(store :: DataStore):UpdateAsync(key(player), function()
			return snapshot
		end)
		return true
	end)
	if ok and orderedStore then
		pcall(function()
			(orderedStore :: OrderedDataStore):SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), math.floor(snapshot.Score))
		end)
	end
	session.saving = false
	return ok
end

function DataService.release(player: Player)
	DataService.save(player)
	sessions[player] = nil
end

-- Top scores across all servers, best first: { { userId, score } }.
function DataService.topScores(count: number): { { userId: number, score: number } }
	local result = {}
	if not available or not orderedStore then
		return result
	end
	local ok, page = pcall(function()
		return (orderedStore :: OrderedDataStore):GetSortedAsync(false, count):GetCurrentPage()
	end)
	if ok and page then
		for _, entry in page do
			local id = tonumber(entry.key)
			if id then
				table.insert(result, { userId = id, score = entry.value })
			end
		end
	end
	return result
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	if sessions[player] then
		DataService.release(player)
	end
end)

return DataService

scripts.name: FurnitureBuilder
scripts.source:
-- Builds one furniture piece: an invisible-to-physics stack of colored details
-- welded onto a single "Body" part that carries all the mass and collision.
-- Details are designed to read clearly from straight above.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local FurnitureSpecs = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.FurnitureSpecs)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)

local FurnitureBuilder = {}

-- Context passed to each design: adds parts relative to the body center.
type Ctx = {
	w: number,
	d: number,
	h: number,
	body: Part,
	model: Model,
	-- Block whose top sits `raise` studs above the body's top.
	top: (
		self: Ctx,
		x: number,
		z: number,
		sx: number,
		sz: number,
		raise: number,
		thickness: number,
		color: string,
		yaw: number?
	) -> Part,
	disc: (
		self: Ctx,
		x: number,
		z: number,
		diameter: number,
		raise: number,
		thickness: number,
		color: string
	) -> Part,
	ball: (self: Ctx, x: number, y: number, z: number, diameter: number, color: string) -> Part,
}

local function newCtx(model: Model, body: Part, w: number, d: number, h: number): Ctx
	local ctx = { w = w, d = d, h = h, body = body, model = model } :: any

	function ctx.top(self: Ctx, x, z, sx, sz, raise, thickness, color, yaw)
		local y = self.h / 2 + raise - thickness / 2
		local part = Parts.make({
			name = "Detail",
			size = Vector3.new(sx, thickness, sz),
			cframe = self.body.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, y, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw or 0, 0),
			color = color,
			parent = self.model,
		})
		return part
	end

	function ctx.disc(self: Ctx, x, z, diameter, raise, thickness, color)
		local y = self.h / 2 + raise - thickness / 2
		return Parts.make({
			name = "Detail",
			shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
			size = Vector3.new(thickness, diameter, diameter),
			cframe = self.body.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, y, z) * Parts.UPRIGHT,
			color = color,
			parent = self.model,
		})
	end

	function ctx.ball(self: Ctx, x, y, z, diameter, color)
		return Parts.make({
			name = "Detail",
			shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
			size = Vector3.one * diameter,
			cframe = self.body.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, y, z),
			color = color,
			parent = self.model,
		})
	end

	return ctx :: Ctx
end

type Design = { body: string, transparentBody: boolean?, draw: (ctx: Ctx) -> () }

local BOOK_COLORS = { "C0392B", "2E86C1", "27AE60", "F1C40F", "8E44AD", "E67E22", "16A085", "D35400" }

local DESIGNS: { [string]: Design } = {
	Couch = {
		body = "3C8DBC",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, -c.d / 2 + 0.5, c.w, 1.0, 0.7, 0.8, "2F7099") -- backrest
			for side = -1, 1, 2 do
				c:top(side * (c.w / 2 - 0.45), 0.2, 0.9, c.d - 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, "2F7099") -- arms
				c:top(side * (c.w / 4 - 0.2), 0.45, c.w / 2 - 1.3, c.d - 1.3, 0.15, 0.2, "5BA7D6") -- cushions
				c:top(side * (c.w / 4 - 0.2), 0.45, c.w / 2 - 1.8, 0.12, 0.17, 0.2, "4A93C2") -- cushion seam
			end
			c:top(c.w / 2 - 1.6, -0.2, 1.2, 1.0, 0.35, 0.3, "F1C40F", 0.3) -- throw pillow
		end,
	},
	Armchair = {
		body = "4E9A3E",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, -c.d / 2 + 0.45, c.w, 0.9, 0.7, 0.8, "3D7D30")
			for side = -1, 1, 2 do
				c:top(side * (c.w / 2 - 0.35), 0.2, 0.7, c.d - 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, "3D7D30")
			end
			c:top(0, 0.45, c.w - 1.6, c.d - 1.3, 0.15, 0.2, "6CBF5A")
		end,
	},
	Fridge = {
		body = "EEF1F4",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, -0.3, c.w - 0.4, 0.12, 0.03, 0.06, "B9C0C8") -- door split
			c:top(c.w / 2 - 0.7, c.d / 2 - 0.25, 0.25, 0.5, 0.06, 0.1, "8A939C") -- handle
			c:top(0, 0, c.w - 0.3, c.d - 0.3, 0.01, 0.02, "F7F9FA")
			c:disc(-0.9, 0.6, 0.4, 0.05, 0.06, "E5484D") -- fridge magnets
			c:disc(-0.3, 0.9, 0.35, 0.05, 0.06, "3498DB")
			c:top(0.6, 0.7, 0.6, 0.45, 0.05, 0.06, "FFE14D", 0.2) -- a note
		end,
	},
	Stove = {
		body = "E6E6E6",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, -c.d / 2 + 0.3, c.w, 0.6, 0.35, 0.4, "BDBDBD") -- control strip
			for i = -1, 1 do
				c:disc(i * 1.1, -c.d / 2 + 0.3, 0.3, 0.42, 0.08, "333333") -- knobs
			end
			c:disc(0.9, 0.95, 0.95, 0.5, 0.5, "7F8C8D") -- a pot on the front burner
			c:disc(0.9, 0.95, 0.75, 0.52, 0.5, "C0392B")
			for _, x in { -0.9, 0.9 } do
				for _, z in { -0.35, 0.95 } do
					c:disc(x, z, 1.1, 0.06, 0.08, "3A3A3A")
					c:disc(x, z, 0.5, 0.08, 0.08, "6B6B6B")
				end
			end
		end,
	},
	Sink = {
		body = "C9D1D9",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, 0.25, c.w - 1.4, c.d - 1.2, 0.03, 0.06, "8FA6BC") -- basin
			c:top(0, -c.d / 2 + 0.35, 0.3, 0.7, 0.4, 0.4, "8A939C") -- faucet
		end,
	},
	Toilet = {
		body = "F2F4F6",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, -c.d / 2 + 0.5, c.w, 1.0, 0.5, 0.6, "E1E6EB") -- tank
			c:disc(0, 0.45, 2.1, 0.04, 0.08, "DCE3E9") -- seat
			c:disc(0, 0.45, 1.3, 0.06, 0.08, "A8D4EE") -- water
			c:disc(c.w / 2 + 0.2, -c.d / 2 + 0.6, 0.7, -0.4, 0.5, "FFFFFF") -- paper roll
		end,
	},
	Bathtub = {
		body = "F4F7FA",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, 0, c.w - 1.0, c.d - 1.0, 0.03, 0.06, "A9D6F0")
			c:top(c.w / 2 - 0.4, 0, 0.4, 0.5, 0.3, 0.3, "8A939C") -- tap
			c:ball(-1.5, c.h / 2 + 0.15, 0.3, 0.6, "FFD93B") -- rubber duck
			c:ball(-1.25, c.h / 2 + 0.35, 0.3, 0.35, "FFD93B")
			c:top(-1.0, 0.3, 0.2, 0.15, 0.4, 0.1, "F28C1C")
			for i = 1, 4 do
				c:disc(1.6 - i * 0.5, -0.6 + (i % 2) * 0.4, 0.35, 0.08, 0.06, "FFFFFF") -- bubbles
			end
		end,
	},
	Bed = {
		body = "8E5A32",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, -c.d / 2 + 0.25, c.w, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, "6B4226") -- headboard
			c:top(0, 0.1, c.w - 0.6, c.d - 0.8, 0.2, 0.3, "F5F5F5") -- mattress
			c:top(0, c.d * 0.18, c.w - 0.5, c.d * 0.6, 0.3, 0.35, "2FA84F") -- blanket (green, like the original)
			c:top(0, c.d * 0.18 - c.d * 0.3 + 0.2, c.w - 0.5, 0.4, 0.32, 0.36, "F2F2F2") -- folded sheet
			for side = -1, 1, 2 do
				c:top(side * 1.55, -c.d / 2 + 1.3, 2.6, 1.4, 0.45, 0.4, "FFFFFF") -- pillows
			end
			for row = 0, 2 do
				for col = -1, 1, 2 do
					c:top(col * 1.5, c.d * 0.02 + row * 1.6, 2.4, 0.06, 0.32, 0.36, "27924A") -- quilt lines
				end
			end
			c:ball(1.6, c.h / 2 + 0.55, -c.d / 2 + 2.6, 0.9, "A0582A") -- teddy bear
			c:ball(1.6, c.h / 2 + 0.75, -c.d / 2 + 2.05, 0.6, "A0582A")
		end,
	},
	Table = {
		body = "B07A45",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, 0, c.w - 0.6, c.d - 0.6, 0.02, 0.04, "C08A55")
			for _, x in { -2.3, 0, 2.3 } do
				c:disc(x, 0, 1.3, 0.06, 0.06, "F4F4F4") -- plates
				c:disc(x, 0, 0.7, 0.08, 0.06, "E8E8E8")
			end
			c:disc(-1.2, 1.4, 0.45, 0.1, 0.1, "3498DB") -- cups
			c:disc(1.2, -1.4, 0.45, 0.1, 0.1, "E5484D")
		end,
	},
	CoffeeTable = {
		body = "9A6838",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, 0, c.w - 0.5, c.d - 0.5, 0.02, 0.04, "B07A45")
		end,
	},
	Chair = {
		body = "C08A55",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, -c.d / 2 + 0.2, c.w, 0.4, 0.8, 0.9, "8B5A2B")
			c:top(0, 0.2, c.w - 0.6, c.d - 0.9, 0.05, 0.06, "C0392B") -- seat cushion
		end,
	},
	Bookshelf = {
		body = "6B4226",
		draw = function(c)
			local count = 11
			local span = c.w - 0.6
			for i = 1, count do
				local x = -span / 2 + (i - 0.5) * span / count
				local depth = c.d - 0.7 - (i % 3) * 0.2 -- books of different sizes
				local raise = 0.04 + (i % 2) * 0.03
				c:top(
					x,
					0.15,
					span / count - 0.12,
					depth,
					raise,
					0.08,
					BOOK_COLORS[(i - 1) % #BOOK_COLORS + 1]
				)
			end
		end,
	},
	Box = {
		body = "C9A06A",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, 0, 0.55, c.d, 0.02, 0.04, "E6CFA1") -- tape
			c:top(0, 0, c.w, 0.08, 0.02, 0.04, "A88350") -- flap seam
			c:top(0.75, 0.75, 0.7, 0.45, 0.03, 0.04, "F4F4F4") -- shipping label
		end,
	},
	-- Wooden crate with a diagonal brace, like the original's.
	Crate = {
		body = "C8955A",
		draw = function(c)
			local t = 0.4
			c:top(0, -c.d / 2 + t / 2, c.w, t, 0.03, 0.06, "8E5F33")
			c:top(0, c.d / 2 - t / 2, c.w, t, 0.03, 0.06, "8E5F33")
			c:top(-c.w / 2 + t / 2, 0, t, c.d, 0.03, 0.06, "8E5F33")
			c:top(c.w / 2 - t / 2, 0, t, c.d, 0.03, 0.06, "8E5F33")
			c:top(0, 0, (c.w - t) * 1.3, t, 0.03, 0.06, "8E5F33", math.rad(45))
		end,
	},
	Barrel = {
		body = "8B5A2B",
		transparentBody = true,
		draw = function(c)
			c:disc(0, 0, c.w, -0.05, c.h - 0.1, "8B5A2B")
			c:disc(0, 0, c.w * 0.82, 0.01, 0.06, "A0703F")
			c:disc(0, 0, c.w * 0.3, 0.03, 0.06, "6B4226")
		end,
	},
	Wardrobe = {
		body = "7A4A2A",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, 0, c.w - 0.5, c.d - 0.5, 0.02, 0.04, "8E5A32")
			c:top(0, 0, 0.12, c.d - 0.5, 0.04, 0.06, "5A3520") -- door split
		end,
	},
	Piano = {
		body = "222222",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, c.d / 2 - 0.55, c.w - 0.6, 0.9, 0.04, 0.06, "F4F4F4") -- keys
			for i = 1, 9 do
				local x = -c.w / 2 + 0.3 + (c.w - 0.6) * (i / 10)
				c:top(x, c.d / 2 - 0.75, 0.18, 0.5, 0.07, 0.06, "111111") -- black keys
			end
			c:top(0, -0.6, c.w - 1.2, 1.6, 0.03, 0.06, "333333") -- lid
		end,
	},
	PoolTable = {
		body = "6B4226",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, 0, c.w - 1.2, c.d - 1.2, 0.03, 0.06, "2E8B57") -- felt
			for _, x in { -1, 0, 1 } do
				for _, z in { -1, 1 } do
					c:disc(x * (c.w / 2 - 0.6), z * (c.d / 2 - 0.6), 0.6, 0.06, 0.06, "111111") -- pockets
				end
			end
			c:disc(-2, 0, 0.45, 0.1, 0.1, "FFFFFF")
			c:disc(1.5, 0.4, 0.45, 0.1, 0.1, "E5484D")
			c:disc(2, -0.5, 0.45, 0.1, 0.1, "F2C230")
		end,
	},
	-- A big yellow supercar: tapered nose, black glass with shiny streaks,
	-- wing mirrors, a vented engine cover and a black tail (nose toward -Z).
	Car = {
		body = "F5C518",
		transparentBody = true,
		draw = function(c)
			local yellow, edge, black = "F5C518", "B8860B", "151515"
			c:top(0, 1.0, c.w, c.d - 2.2, -0.6, c.h - 0.8, edge) -- outline
			c:top(0, 1.0, c.w - 0.6, c.d - 3.0, -0.4, c.h - 0.6, yellow) -- hull
			c:top(0, -6.4, 6.8, 3.2, -0.65, c.h - 1.1, edge) -- nose outline
			c:top(0, -6.6, 6.2, 2.6, -0.6, c.h - 1.0, yellow) -- nose
			for side = -1, 1, 2 do
				c:top(side * 2.9, -6.0, 2.2, 2.6, -0.6, c.h - 1.0, yellow, side * 0.45) -- nose corners
				c:top(side * 2.6, -7.1, 1.4, 0.7, -0.55, 0.1, black, side * 0.4) -- front intakes
				c:top(side * 2.6, -2.6, 1.2, 2.6, 0, 0.4, black, side * 0.35) -- windshield corners
				c:top(side * 2.75, 0.4, 0.5, 4.4, 0, 0.3, black) -- side windows
				local shine = c:top(side * 2.75, -0.2, 0.12, 1.6, 0.02, 0.05, "FFFFFF")
				shine.Transparency = 0.4
				c:top(side * 4.7, -2.6, 1.4, 0.55, -0.5, 0.3, black, side * 0.45) -- wing mirrors
				c:top(side * 3.6, 2.6, 0.7, 2.4, -0.3, 0.1, black) -- side intakes
				c:top(side * 3.0, 4.6, 2.6, 4.2, -0.2, 0.3, yellow, side * 0.12) -- rear haunches
				c:top(side * 2.6, 7.55, 1.8, 0.3, -0.35, 0.1, "C0392B") -- tail lights
				for _, z in { -4.4, 4.6 } do
					c:top(side * 4.35, z, 0.6, 2.5, -1.6, 1.0, black) -- tyres peeking out
				end
			end
			c:top(0, -2.4, 5.6, 3.0, 0, 0.4, black) -- windshield
			-- Shiny streaks across the glass.
			for _, streak in { { -0.9, 0.35, 0.3 }, { 0.4, 0.22, 0.45 }, { 1.5, 0.15, 0.6 } } do
				local part = c:top(streak[1], -2.4, streak[2], 3.2, 0.03, 0.05, "FFFFFF", 0.7)
				part.Transparency = streak[3]
			end
			c:top(0, 0.2, 5.0, 2.6, 0.05, 0.4, yellow) -- roof
			c:top(0, 3.6, 4.6, 3.4, -0.1, 0.3, black) -- engine cover
			for i = 0, 3 do
				c:top(0, 2.4 + i * 0.75, 3.6, 0.3, 0, 0.1, "5E5E5E") -- vents
			end
			c:disc(0, 3.6, 1.4, 0.02, 0.1, "7A7A7A")
			c:top(0, 7.4, 7.6, 1.2, -0.4, 0.4, black) -- tail
			for side = -1, 1, 2 do
				c:disc(side * 0.8, 7.7, 0.6, -0.3, 0.2, "9A9A9A") -- exhausts
			end
		end,
	},
	Dresser = {
		body = "8E5A32",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, 0, c.w - 0.4, c.d - 0.4, 0.02, 0.04, "A0703F")
			c:disc(-1, 0.3, 0.7, 0.04, 0.06, "D9E0E6") -- mirror stand
			c:disc(1.2, 0.2, 0.5, 0.06, 0.06, "E8C26A")
		end,
	},
	Washer = {
		body = "E8ECEF",
		draw = function(c)
			c:disc(0, 0.2, 2.0, 0.03, 0.06, "B9C3CC") -- door rim
			c:disc(0, 0.2, 1.5, 0.05, 0.06, "7FB8E0") -- window
			c:top(0, -c.d / 2 + 0.3, c.w, 0.5, 0.06, 0.08, "C9D1D9") -- control strip
		end,
	},
	Desk = {
		body = "A0703F",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, 0, c.w - 0.4, c.d - 0.4, 0.02, 0.04, "B88A55")
			c:top(-1.2, -0.3, 1.8, 1.2, 0.06, 0.08, "2B2B30") -- laptop
			c:top(1.4, 0.2, 1.2, 0.9, 0.05, 0.06, "F4F4F4") -- papers
		end,
	},
	TVStand = {
		body = "5A3A22",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, -0.2, c.w - 0.8, 0.6, 0.15, 0.2, "1C1C20") -- TV
		end,
	},
	Bench = {
		body = "A0703F",
		draw = function(c)
			for i = -1, 1 do
				c:top(0, i * 0.6, c.w, 0.45, 0.02, 0.04, "B88A55") -- slats
			end
		end,
	},
	Lamp = {
		body = "F2E2A0",
		transparentBody = true,
		draw = function(c)
			c:disc(0, 0, 0.9, -c.h + 0.6, 0.3, "6B6B6B") -- base
			c:disc(0, 0, c.w, -0.2, 0.6, "F2E2A0") -- shade
			c:disc(0, 0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.06, "FFF8D6")
		end,
	},
	Plant = {
		body = "B5653A",
		transparentBody = true,
		draw = function(c)
			c:disc(0, 0, 2.0, -0.6, c.h - 0.6, "B5653A") -- pot
			c:disc(0, 0, 1.6, -0.55, 0.1, "5A3A22") -- soil
			for i = 0, 5 do
				local a = i / 6 * math.pi * 2 + 0.4
				local leaf = if i % 2 == 0 then "3E9B3A" else "4FB848"
				c:ball(math.cos(a) * 0.6, c.h / 2 + 0.1, math.sin(a) * 0.6, 1.0, leaf)
			end
			c:ball(0, c.h / 2 + 0.45, 0, 0.5, "F48FB1") -- a flower
			c:ball(0, c.h / 2 + 0.6, 0, 0.22, "FFE066")

	Picture = {

		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, 0, c.w - 0.7, c.d - 0.7, 0.03, 0.06, "7FB8E0") -- sky

		transparentBody = true,

		body = "7F8C8D",
		transparentBody = true,
		draw = function(c)
			c:disc(0, 0, c.w + 0.25, -0.1, c.h - 0.2, "4D5656")

		end,

	Aquarium = {
		body = "7FC8F8",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, 0, c.w - 0.4, c.d - 0.4, 0.02, 0.04, "4FA3D9") -- water
			c:top(0, c.d / 2 - 0.45, c.w - 0.5, 0.4, 0.03, 0.04, "E8D3A2") -- sand
			local fishes: { { x: number, z: number, color: string } } = {
				{ x = -1.6, z = -0.2, color = "F39C12" },

			}
			for i, fish in fishes do
				local x, z, color = fish.x, fish.z, fish.color
				c:top(x, z, 0.7, 0.35, 0.05 + i * 0.01, 0.04, color) -- fish
				c:top(x + 0.45, z, 0.25, 0.3, 0.05 + i * 0.01, 0.04, color, math.rad(45)) -- tails
			end
			c:top(-2.3, 0.6, 0.15, 0.8, 0.04, 0.05, "27AE60") -- seaweed
			c:disc(2.4, 0.5, 0.25, 0.07, 0.04, "FFFFFF") -- bubbles
			c:disc(2.2, 0.1, 0.18, 0.07, 0.04, "FFFFFF")
		end,
	},
	Arcade = {
		body = "6C3483",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, -0.35, c.w - 0.6, 1.4, 0.04, 0.06, "111111") -- screen
			for i, color in { "E74C3C", "F1C40F", "2ECC71", "3498DB" } do
				c:top(-0.9 + i * 0.36, -0.35 + (i % 2) * 0.3, 0.25, 0.25, 0.06, 0.04, color) -- pixels
			end
			c:disc(-0.6, 0.85, 0.45, 0.2, 0.25, "E74C3C") -- joystick
			c:disc(0.4, 0.85, 0.3, 0.08, 0.08, "F1C40F") -- buttons
			c:disc(0.9, 0.85, 0.3, 0.08, 0.08, "3498DB")
		end,
	},
	VendingMachine = {
		body = "C0392B",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(-0.4, 0, c.w - 1.6, c.d - 0.6, 0.03, 0.05, "B3E5FC") -- glass
			local colors = { "E74C3C", "3498DB", "2ECC71", "F1C40F", "9B59B6", "E67E22" }
			for row = 0, 2 do
				for col = 0, 2 do
					c:disc(
						-1.5 + col * 0.8,
						-0.8 + row * 0.8,

						colors[(row * 3 + col) % #colors + 1]
					) -- cans

			end
			c:top(c.w / 2 - 0.55, -0.4, 0.5, 0.9, 0.05, 0.06, "2B2B30") -- coin slot panel
			c:top(c.w / 2 - 0.55, 0.6, 0.5, 0.25, 0.06, 0.06, "F1C40F")
		end,
	},
	Treadmill = {
		body = "3A3A3A",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, 0.4, c.w - 0.8, c.d - 1.6, 0.02, 0.04, "222222") -- belt
			for i = -2, 2 do
				c:top(0, 0.4 + i * 1.1, c.w - 0.9, 0.06, 0.04, 0.03, "4A4A4A") -- belt slats
			end
			c:top(0, -c.d / 2 + 0.4, c.w, 0.8, 0.5, 0.5, "5D6D7E") -- console
			c:top(0, -c.d / 2 + 0.4, 1.0, 0.4, 0.52, 0.5, "2ECC71") -- display
		end,
	},
	-- Green rug with a pale border and a fringe on the short ends, like the original.
	Rug = {
		body = "A9C7B8",
		draw = function(c)
			c:top(0, 0, c.w - 0.8, c.d - 0.8, 0.02, 0.02, "2DB35A")
			c:top(0, 0, c.w - 1.6, c.d - 1.6, 0.04, 0.02, "34BF62")
			for i = 0, 11 do
				local z = -c.d / 2 + 0.5 + (c.d - 1) * i / 11
				for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
					c:top(side * (c.w / 2 + 0.25), z, 0.5, 0.08, 0.0, 0.02, "C9D9CF")
				end
			end
			c:disc(-c.w / 4, c.d / 5, 0.5, 0.06, 0.02, "1F8F45")
			c:disc(c.w / 4, -c.d / 5, 0.4, 0.06, 0.02, "1F8F45")
		end,
	},
}

local UPRIGHT_FRAME = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.zAxis) -- X axis points up

export type Built = {
	model: Model,
	body: Part,
	kind: string,
	weight: FurnitureSpecs.Weight,
	decor: boolean,
	home: CFrame,
}

function FurnitureBuilder.build(spot: MapLayout.FurnitureSpot, parent: Instance): Built
	local spec = FurnitureSpecs.get(spot.kind)
	local design = DESIGNS[spot.kind]
	local floorTop = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor
	local decor = spec.decor == true
	local baseY = if decor then MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Rug - spec.h / 2 else floorTop + spec.h / 2 + 0.02
	local home = CFrame.new(spot.x, baseY, spot.z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(spot.rot), 0)

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = spot.kind
	local body = Parts.make({
		name = "Body",
		size = Vector3.new(spec.w, spec.h, spec.d),
		cframe = home,
		color = design.body,
		transparency = if design.transparentBody then 1 else 0,
		parent = model,
	})
	model.PrimaryPart = body

	design.draw(newCtx(model, body, spec.w, spec.d, spec.h))

	if not design.transparentBody and not decor then
		-- A darker, slightly bigger copy just under the top: from above it
		-- draws the thick outline the original's furniture has.
		local base = Color3.fromHex(design.body)
		Parts.make({
			name = "Outline",
			size = Vector3.new(spec.w + 0.4, spec.h - 0.04, spec.d + 0.4),
			cframe = home * CFrame.new(0, -0.02, 0),
			color = Color3.new(base.R * 0.55, base.G * 0.55, base.B * 0.55),
			parent = model,
		})
	end

	if decor then
		for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.CanCollide = false
				part.CanQuery = false
			end
		end
		model.Parent = parent
		return {
			model = model,
			body = body,
			kind = spot.kind,
			weight = spec.weight,
			decor = true,
			home = home,
		}
	end

	for _, part in model:GetChildren() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= body then
			Parts.makeVisual(part)
			Parts.weldInPlace(body, part)
		end
	end

	body.Anchored = false
	body.CollisionGroup = "Furniture"
	-- Low friction with weight 1: floors (friction 0, weight 100) let pieces
	-- glide at exactly the speed FurnitureService sets, while walls (friction
	-- 1, weight 100) grip them, so a barricade pressed into a doorway holds.
	body.CustomPhysicalProperties =
		PhysicalProperties.new(Config.FURNITURE_DENSITY[spec.weight], 0.3, 0, 1, 1)

	-- Stay upright but spin freely around the vertical axis.
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = "Upright"
	attachment.CFrame = UPRIGHT_FRAME
	attachment.Parent = body
	local align = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	align.Name = "KeepUpright"
	align.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	align.AlignType = Enum.AlignType.PrimaryAxisParallel
	align.Attachment0 = attachment
	align.CFrame = UPRIGHT_FRAME
	align.MaxTorque = 1e7
	align.Responsiveness = 40
	align.Parent = body

	model:SetAttribute("Weight", spec.weight)
	model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", 0)
	model.Parent = parent
	return { model = model, body = body, kind = spot.kind, weight = spec.weight, decor = false, home = home }
end

return FurnitureBuilder

scripts.name: FurnitureService
scripts.source:
-- Owns every furniture piece: builds them, decides who simulates each one,
-- and resets them each round.
--
-- Responsiveness: when you push a piece, your client asks for it ("claim")
-- and the server hands you its physics, so it moves the instant you push
-- and stops the instant you stop, with no network lag. If anyone else pushes
-- the same piece (a zombie on the other side of a barricade, another player,
-- a bot), the server takes it back and resolves everyone's pushes itself, so
-- a barricade standoff is fair. Pieces nobody pushes stand perfectly still.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CharacterLook = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CharacterLook)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local FurnitureBuilder = require(script.Parent.FurnitureBuilder)
local FurniturePush = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.FurniturePush)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local RoundRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoundRules)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

local FurnitureService = {}

type Piece = FurnitureBuilder.Built & {
	owner: Player?,
	lastClaim: number,
	pushers: { [string]: number }, -- participant id -> last time seen pushing
	contestedUntil: number,
	tugOfWar: boolean, -- contestedUntil came from two pushers, not a shove
	burst: Vector3,
	burstUntil: number,
	burstLength: number,
	lastGood: CFrame, -- last position that passed the anti-cheat checks
	lastGoodAt: number, -- when the piece last moved to lastGood
}

-- Someone who can push furniture. `reach` is set while they hold a melee
-- weapon, whose shaft (along `aim`) pushes too.
export type Mover = {
	root: BasePart,
	humanoid: Humanoid,
	id: string,
	scale: number,
	aim: Vector3,
	dragging: boolean?, -- hooking a piece with held click
	firmness: number?, -- held weapon's Items.firmness
	guard: number?, -- held weapon's Items.guard
	reach: number?,
}

local OWNER = FurniturePush.OWNER_ATTRIBUTE
local CONTEST_SECONDS = 0.8

local pieces: { Piece } = {}
local byBody: { [BasePart]: Piece } = {}
local byModel: { [Instance]: Piece } = {}
local folder: Folder
local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
local external: FurniturePush.Pushes = {}

local getMovers: () -> { Mover } = function()
	return {}
end

local function serverOwns(piece: Piece)
	piece.owner = nil
	pcall(function()
		piece.body:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	end)
	piece.model:SetAttribute(OWNER, 0)
end

local function stop(piece: Piece)
	local v = piece.body.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	piece.body.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.min(v.Y, 0), 0)
	piece.body.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

-- Takes a piece back from a client (optionally blocking new claims for a
-- bit). In a tug of war the piece keeps moving: the server writes the
-- resolved velocity the same frame, so stopping it would only cause a snap.
local function revoke(piece: Piece, blockSeconds: number, halt: boolean?)
	if piece.owner then
		serverOwns(piece)
		if halt ~= false then
			stop(piece)
		end
	end
	piece.contestedUntil = math.max(piece.contestedUntil, os.clock() + blockSeconds)
end

-- True if anyone other than `id` pushed the piece in the last moment.
local function othersPushing(piece: Piece, id: string, now: number): boolean
	for other, seen in piece.pushers do
		if other ~= id and now - seen <= 0.3 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function grant(piece: Piece, player: Player)
	local ok = pcall(function()
		piece.body:SetNetworkOwner(player)
	end)
	if ok then
		piece.owner = player
		piece.model:SetAttribute(OWNER, player.UserId)
	end
end

function FurnitureService.build(layout: MapLayout.Layout)
	folder = workspace:WaitForChild("Furniture") :: Folder
	folder:ClearAllChildren()
	table.clear(pieces)
	table.clear(byBody)
	table.clear(byModel)
	for _, spot in layout.furniture do
		local built = FurnitureBuilder.build(spot, folder)
		if not built.decor then
			local piece = built :: Piece
			piece.owner = nil
			piece.lastClaim = 0
			piece.pushers = {}
			piece.contestedUntil = 0
			piece.tugOfWar = false
			piece.burst = Vector3.zero
			piece.burstUntil = 0
			piece.burstLength = 1
			piece.lastGood = built.home
			piece.lastGoodAt = 0
			table.insert(pieces, piece)
			byBody[built.body] = piece
			byModel[built.model] = piece
			serverOwns(piece)
		end
	end
	overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = { folder }
end

-- Adds a push on a server-driven piece for the next frame (weapon drags).
function FurnitureService.addPush(body: BasePart, desired: Vector3, strength: number, at: Vector3?)
	if byBody[body] then
		FurniturePush.add(external, body, desired, strength, at)
	end
end

-- A sudden shove (shotgun blast, potato hit): the server takes the piece and
-- moves it at `velocity`, easing to a stop over `seconds`.
function FurnitureService.shove(body: BasePart, velocity: Vector3, seconds: number)
	local piece = byBody[body]
	if not piece then
		return
	end
	revoke(piece, seconds + 0.2)
	piece.burst = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
	piece.burstLength = seconds
	piece.burstUntil = os.clock() + seconds
end

function FurnitureService.pieceOf(part: BasePart): FurnitureBuilder.Built?
	return byBody[part]
end

function FurnitureService.weightOf(body: BasePart): string?
	local piece = byBody[body]
	return piece and piece.weight
end

function FurnitureService.findInBox(cframe: CFrame, size: Vector3): { BasePart }
	local found = {}
	for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cframe, size, overlap) do
		if byBody[part] then
			table.insert(found, part)
		end
	end
	return found
end

function FurnitureService.resetAll()
	for _, piece in pieces do
		serverOwns(piece)
		piece.contestedUntil = 0
		piece.tugOfWar = false
		piece.burstUntil = 0
		table.clear(piece.pushers)
		piece.model:PivotTo(piece.home)
		piece.lastGood = piece.home
		piece.body.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		piece.body.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
end

-- A client asks to drive the pieces it is pushing.
local function onClaim(player: Player, list: unknown)
	if typeof(list) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local claims = list :: { unknown }
	if #claims > 16 then
		return
	end
	local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	local root = p and Participants.body(p)
	if not p or not root then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, model in claims do
		local piece = if typeof(model) == "Instance" then byModel[model] else nil
		if not piece or now < piece.contestedUntil or now < piece.burstUntil then
			continue
		end
		if piece.owner and piece.owner ~= player then
			revoke(piece, CONTEST_SECONDS, false) -- two players fighting over it: server decides
			continue
		end
		if othersPushing(piece, p.id, now) then
			continue -- someone else is on it too: the server settles that
		end
		-- Only pieces you could actually be touching (body or longest weapon).
		local range = piece.body.Size.Magnitude / 2 + root.Size.X / 2 + 12 * math.max(1, p.scale) + 3
		if Util.flatDistance(piece.body.Position, root.Position) > range then
			continue
		end
		piece.lastClaim = now
		if piece.owner ~= player then
			grant(piece, player)
		end
	end
end

local function collectPushes(now: number): FurniturePush.Pushes
	local pushes: FurniturePush.Pushes = external
	external = {}
	for _, mover in getMovers() do
		local humanoid, root = mover.humanoid, mover.root
		local walk = humanoid.WalkSpeed
		if walk <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		local move = humanoid.MoveDirection
		local flat = Vector3.new(move.X, 0, move.Z)
		local moving = flat.Magnitude > 0.1
		local dir = if moving then flat.Unit else Vector3.zero
		local strength = RoundRules.pushStrength(mover.scale)
		local touched: { [BasePart]: boolean } = {}
		if moving then
			local probe, size = FurniturePush.moverProbe(root, dir, mover.scale)
			for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(probe, size, overlap) do
				local piece = byBody[part]
				if piece then
					touched[part] = true
					piece.pushers[mover.id] = now
					FurniturePush.add(pushes, part, dir * walk, strength, probe.Position)
				end
			end
		end
		-- A held weapon's shaft is solid, same as on the client: it pushes
		-- what it touches along your path, or out of its way when you stand
		-- still or turn. While hooking a piece (held click) the drag does the work.
		if mover.reach and not mover.dragging then
			local grip = CharacterLook.grip(mover.scale)
			local hand = (root.CFrame * grip).Position
			local shaft, shaftSize = FurniturePush.itemProbe(root, grip, mover.aim, mover.reach, mover.guard)
			local firm = strength * (mover.firmness or 1)
			for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(shaft, shaftSize, overlap) do
				local piece = byBody[part]
				if piece and not touched[part] then
					if moving then
						-- Only walking counts as pushing for ownership: someone just
						-- standing near a piece with a weapon out shouldn't take it
						-- away from the player driving it.
						piece.pushers[mover.id] = now
						FurniturePush.add(pushes, part, dir * walk, firm, part.Position + mover.aim * 0.5)
					else
						local exit = FurniturePush.shaftExit(hand, mover.aim, part)
						FurniturePush.add(
							pushes,
							part,
							exit * walk * Config.SHAFT_FURNITURE_FACTOR,
							firm,
							nil
						)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return pushes
end

-- Is a client-driven piece somewhere a legitimate push could have put it?
local function plausible(piece: Piece, now: number): boolean
	local body = piece.body
	local owner = piece.owner
	local p = owner and Participants.fromPlayer(owner)
	local root = p and Participants.body(p)
	if not p or not root then
		return false
	end
	local v = body.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	if Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude > Config.FURNITURE_MAX_SPEED * 1.5 or v.Y > 8 then
		return false
	end
	if body.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > 3 then
		return false
	end
	-- Client positions arrive in bursts, so compare against the time since
	-- the piece last moved, not one server frame (capped so a piece that sat
	-- still for a while can't jump far).
	local moved = Util.flatDistance(body.Position, piece.lastGood.Position)
	local elapsed = math.clamp(now - piece.lastGoodAt, 1 / 60, 0.3)
	if moved > Config.FURNITURE_MAX_SPEED * 1.6 * elapsed + 1.5 then
		return false -- teleported
	end
	local range = body.Size.Magnitude / 2 + root.Size.X / 2 + 14 * math.max(1, p.scale) + 6
	return Util.flatDistance(body.Position, root.Position) <= range
end

local function step(dt: number)
	local now = os.clock()
	local pushes = collectPushes(now)
	for _, piece in pieces do
		local body = piece.body
		if body.Parent == nil then
			continue
		end

		-- Who is pushing this piece right now (seen by the server)?
		local owner = piece.owner
		local ownerId = if owner then "P" .. owner.UserId else ""
		local active, someoneElse = 0, false
		for id, seen in piece.pushers do
			if now - seen > 0.3 then
				piece.pushers[id] = nil
			else
				active += 1
				if owner and id ~= ownerId then
					someoneElse = true
				end
			end
		end
		if now >= piece.contestedUntil then
			piece.tugOfWar = false
		end
		if active >= 2 or someoneElse then
			-- A tug of war: the server simulates it so both sides count.
			piece.tugOfWar = true
			revoke(piece, CONTEST_SECONDS, false)
		elseif not owner and piece.tugOfWar and now < piece.contestedUntil and active >= 1 then
			-- Keep the server in charge until the tug of war is really over.
			piece.contestedUntil = now + CONTEST_SECONDS
		elseif owner then
			if owner.Parent ~= Players or now - piece.lastClaim > Config.FURNITURE_RELEASE_SECONDS then
				revoke(piece, 0)
			elseif not plausible(piece, now) then
				-- Moved in a way no push could: put it back and take it away.
				revoke(piece, 1.5)
				piece.model:PivotTo(piece.lastGood)
			end
		end
		if piece.owner then
			-- Only advance when a new position has arrived (see plausible).
			if (body.Position - piece.lastGood.Position).Magnitude > 0.01 then
				piece.lastGood, piece.lastGoodAt = body.CFrame, now
			end
		end

		if piece.owner == nil then
			piece.lastGood, piece.lastGoodAt = body.CFrame, now
			local v = body.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			if now < piece.burstUntil then
				local k = (piece.burstUntil - now) / piece.burstLength
				body.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					Vector3.new(piece.burst.X * k, math.min(v.Y, 0), piece.burst.Z * k)
			else
				local push = pushes[body]
				if push then
					local velocity, spin = FurniturePush.resolve(body, push)
					body.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, math.min(v.Y, 0), velocity.Z)
					body.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, spin, 0)
				elseif
					math.abs(v.X) + math.abs(v.Z) > 0.02 or body.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > 0.02
				then
					stop(piece) -- no sliding
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function FurnitureService.start(movers: () -> { Mover })
	getMovers = movers
	Remotes.unreliable("PushClaim").OnServerEvent:Connect(onClaim)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		for _, piece in pieces do
			if piece.owner == player then
				revoke(piece, 0)
			end
		end
	end)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step)
end

return FurnitureService

scripts.name: ItemService
scripts.source:
-- Held items and items lying on the ground. Each human holds at most one
-- item (shown in their right hand). E picks up the nearest ground item, G
-- drops, left click uses. Becoming a zombie drops whatever you held.
-- Every use is validated and resolved here on the server.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Announcer = require(script.Parent.Announcer)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local CharacterLook = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CharacterLook)
local Combat = require(script.Parent.Combat)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local FurnitureService = require(script.Parent.FurnitureService)
