local ItemModels = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.ItemModels)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local MapBuilder = require(script.Parent.MapBuilder)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Projectiles = require(script.Parent.Projectiles)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local Traps = require(script.Parent.Traps)
local RoundRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoundRules)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local ItemService = {}

local groundFolder: Folder
local rng = Random.new()

-- Hand models -------------------------------------------------------------------

local function attachHeld(p: Participant)
	local character = p.character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local old = character:FindFirstChild("HeldItem")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	if not p.heldItem or p.team ~= "Human" then
		return
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local model = ItemModels.build(p.heldItem)
	model.Name = "HeldItem"
	local handle = model.PrimaryPart :: BasePart
	local s = p.scale
	local grip = CharacterLook.grip(s)
	model:PivotTo(root.CFrame * grip)
	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			Parts.makeVisual(part)
		end
	end
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "GripWeld"
	weld.Part0 = root
	weld.Part1 = handle
	weld.C0 = grip
	weld.Parent = handle
	model.Parent = character
end

function ItemService.refreshHand(p: Participant)
	attachHeld(p)
end

local function setStreaming(p: Participant, itemId: string?)
	p.streaming = itemId ~= nil
	if p.character then
		p.character:SetAttribute("Spraying", itemId) -- clients draw the spray
	end
end

local function setHeld(p: Participant, itemId: string?, charges: number?)
	p.heldItem = itemId
	p.dragging = false
	local item = Items.get(itemId)
	p.heldCharges = charges or (item and item.charges)
	setStreaming(p, nil)
	p.state:SetAttribute("HeldItem", itemId or "")
	p.state:SetAttribute("HeldCharges", p.heldCharges or 0)
	attachHeld(p)
end

-- Ground items -----------------------------------------------------------------------

function ItemService.spawnGround(itemId: string, position: Vector3, charges: number?): Model
	local model = ItemModels.build(itemId)
	model.Name = itemId
	-- Built at the origin, so the bounding box center is the offset to undo.
	local center = model:GetBoundingBox().Position
	local y = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor + 0.55
	local spin = CFrame.Angles(0, rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2), 0)
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position.X, y, position.Z) * spin * CFrame.new(-center.X, 0, -center.Z))
	local ring = Parts.disc(
		"Ring",
		Vector3.new(position.X, MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor + 0.05, position.Z),
		4,
		0.06,
		"FFFFFF",
		model
	)
	ring.Transparency = 0.55
	ring.CanCollide = false
	ring.CanQuery = false
	model:SetAttribute("ItemId", itemId)
	model:SetAttribute("Charges", charges)
	model:SetAttribute("SpotX", position.X)
	model:SetAttribute("SpotZ", position.Z)
	model.Parent = groundFolder
	return model
end

local function groundSpot(model: Model): Vector3
	return Vector3.new(model:GetAttribute("SpotX") :: number, 0, model:GetAttribute("SpotZ") :: number)
end

function ItemService.clearGround()
	groundFolder:ClearAllChildren()
end

function ItemService.scatter()
	local count = rng:NextInteger(Config.GROUND_ITEMS_MIN, Config.GROUND_ITEMS_MAX)
	local spots = table.clone(MapLayout.current().itemSpots)
	local pool = Items.groundTable()
	local total = 0
	for _, entry in pool do
		total += entry.weight
	end
	for _ = 1, math.min(count, #spots) do
		local spot = table.remove(spots, rng:NextInteger(1, #spots)) :: MapLayout.Point
		local roll = rng:NextNumber() * total
		local chosen = pool[#pool].id
		for _, entry in pool do
			roll -= entry.weight
			if roll < 0 then
				chosen = entry.id
				break
			end
		end
		ItemService.spawnGround(chosen, Vector3.new(spot.x, 0, spot.z))
	end
end

-- Holding ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Puts an item in the participant's hand, dropping what they held before.
function ItemService.give(p: Participant, itemId: string, charges: number?)
	if p.heldItem then
		ItemService.drop(p)
	end
	setHeld(p, itemId, charges)
end

function ItemService.drop(p: Participant)
	local itemId = p.heldItem
	if not itemId then
		return
	end
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	if root then
		local spot = root.Position + p.aim * (root.Size.X / 2 + 2)
		ItemService.spawnGround(itemId, spot, p.heldCharges)
	end
	setHeld(p, nil)
end

function ItemService.take(p: Participant)
	setHeld(p, nil)
end

function ItemService.pickUp(p: Participant)
	if p.team ~= "Human" then
		return
	end
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local best: Model? = nil
	local bestDistance = Config.PICKUP_RADIUS * math.max(1, p.scale)
	for _, model in groundFolder:GetChildren() do
		if model:IsA("Model") then
			local d = Util.flatDistance(groundSpot(model), root.Position)
			if d <= bestDistance then
				best, bestDistance = model, d
			end
		end
	end
	if not best then
		return
	end
	local itemId = best:GetAttribute("ItemId") :: string
	local charges = best:GetAttribute("Charges")
	best:Destroy()
	ItemService.give(p, itemId, if typeof(charges) == "number" then charges else nil)
	Announcer.fx("Pickup", { position = root.Position })
end

function ItemService.onInfected(p: Participant)
	if p.heldItem then
		ItemService.drop(p)
	end
	p.dragging = false
end

-- Using ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function breakWallAhead(p: Participant, aim: Vector3, reach: number): boolean
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	if not root then
		return false
	end
	for _, angle in { 0, 0.18, -0.18 } do
		local direction = (CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0) * aim) * reach
		local result = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, direction, Combat.wallParams())
		if result then
			local segment = MapBuilder.segmentOf(result.Instance)
			if segment and MapBuilder.breakSegment(segment) then
				local wall = segment.PrimaryPart
				if wall then
					Announcer.fx("WallBreak", { cframe = wall.CFrame, size = wall.Size })
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function use(p: Participant, item: Items.Item, aim: Vector3)
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local kind = item.kind
	if kind == "Melee" or kind == "Blast" then
		local reach = (item.reach or 5) * math.max(1, p.scale * 0.9)
		for _, hit in Combat.zombiesInCone(p, aim, reach, item.arc or 90) do
			local direction = if item.straight then aim else hit.direction
			Combat.knockback(hit.target, direction * (item.knockback or 50), item.stun or 0.3)
			local zRoot = Participants.body(hit.target)
			if zRoot and item.fx then
				Announcer.fx("Hit", { position = zRoot.Position, fx = item.fx })
			end
			if item.effect == "Plunge" then
				Announcer.fx(
					"Plunged",
					{ character = hit.target.character, seconds = item.effectSeconds or 1.5 }
				)
			end
		end
		if kind == "Blast" then
			Announcer.fx("Blast", { origin = root.Position, direction = aim, reach = reach, item = item.id })
			if item.breaksWalls then
				breakWallAhead(p, aim, reach)
			end
			-- The blast also throws furniture around (heavier pieces less).
			local center = root.Position + aim * (reach / 2)
			for _, body in
				FurnitureService.findInBox(
					CFrame.lookAt(center, center + aim),
					Vector3.new(reach * 0.9, 4, reach)
				)
			do
				local away = Util.flatUnit(body.Position - root.Position) or aim
				local mass = (Config.FURNITURE_MASS :: { [string]: number })[FurnitureService.weightOf(body) or "Medium"]
					or 0.45
				FurnitureService.shove(body, away * 28 * math.clamp(1 - mass / 1.6, 0.15, 1), 0.35)
			end
		else
			Announcer.fx("Swing", { character = p.character, item = item.id })
			p.dragging = true -- held click hooks furniture (see dragStep)
		end
	elseif kind == "Projectile" then
		Projectiles.fire(p, item, aim)
		Announcer.fx("Shoot", { character = p.character, item = item.id })
	elseif kind == "Trap" then
		Traps.place(root.Position - aim * (root.Size.X / 2 + 0.6), item)
		Announcer.fx("Drop", { position = root.Position })
		p.heldCharges = (p.heldCharges or 1) - 1
		p.state:SetAttribute("HeldCharges", p.heldCharges)
		if p.heldCharges <= 0 then
			ItemService.take(p)
		end
	elseif kind == "Consumable" and item.speedBoost then
		CharacterService.speedEffect(p, item.speedBoost, item.boostSeconds or 8)
		ItemService.take(p)
		Announcer.fx("Gulp", { position = root.Position, character = p.character })
		if p.player then
			Announcer.toast(
				p.player,
				"Zoom! Faster for " .. (item.boostSeconds or 8) .. " seconds",
				Config.COLORS.Good
			)
		end
	elseif kind == "Consumable" then
		local before = p.immunity
		Participants.setImmunity(p, p.immunity + (item.immunity or 0))
		ItemService.take(p)
		Announcer.fx("Eat", { position = root.Position })
		if p.player then
			Announcer.toast(
				p.player,
				string.format("Immunity %d -> %d / %d", before, p.immunity, Config.IMMUNITY_MAX),
				Config.COLORS.Good
			)
		end
	elseif kind == "Passive" then
		if p.player then
			Announcer.toast(
				p.player,
				string.format("Hold this when the round ends: +%d%% score", (item.rewardBonus or 0) * 100)
			)
		end
	end
end

local function onUse(player: Player, action: unknown, aim: unknown)
	local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	if not p or typeof(aim) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end
	local direction = Util.flatUnit(aim :: Vector3)
	if not direction then
		return
	end
	p.aim = direction
	if action == "stop" then
		p.dragging = false
		setStreaming(p, nil)
		return
	end
	if action ~= "start" or p.team ~= "Human" then
		return
	end
	local item = Items.get(p.heldItem)
	if not item then
		return
	end
	if item.kind == "Melee" then
		p.dragging = true -- hooking furniture works even while the swing cools down
	elseif item.kind == "Stream" then
		setStreaming(p, item.id) -- sprays until "stop" (see streamStep)
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < p.itemReadyAt then
		return
	end
	p.itemReadyAt = now + (item.cooldown or 0.5)
	use(p, item, direction)
end

-- Bots use their held item with the same rules and cooldowns as players
-- (they never hook furniture; streams spray for a moment).
function ItemService.botUse(p: Participant, aim: Vector3)
	local direction = Util.flatUnit(aim)
	local item = Items.get(p.heldItem)
	if not direction or not item or p.team ~= "Human" then
		return
	end
	p.aim = direction
	if item.kind == "Stream" then
		setStreaming(p, item.id)
		task.delay(0.6, function()
			if p.heldItem == item.id then
				setStreaming(p, nil)
			end
		end)
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < p.itemReadyAt then
		return
	end
	p.itemReadyAt = now + (item.cooldown or 0.5)
	use(p, item, direction)
	p.dragging = false
end

-- Holding click with a melee weapon hooks the nearest piece the weapon
-- touches and pulls it toward you. Your own client does this instantly for
-- pieces it drives; this server copy covers pieces the server is driving
-- (for example during a tug of war at a barricade).
-- Held melee weapons are solid to zombies too: a zombie touching the shaft
-- (within the item's `guard`) is shoved off it in short pulses, so a stick
-- held across a doorway keeps zombies out. Firm weapons (bat, pan) hold
-- them completely; soft ones (pool noodle) give, so zombies squeeze past.
-- A bigger holder holds harder, a bigger zombie pushes through easier.
local SHAFT_INTERVAL = 1 / 15
local nextShaftStep = 0

local function shaftStep()
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < nextShaftStep then
		return
	end
	nextShaftStep = now + SHAFT_INTERVAL
	local zombies = Participants.onTeam("Zombie")
	if #zombies == 0 then
		return
	end
	for _, p in Participants.onTeam("Human") do
		local item = Items.get(p.heldItem)
		local root = Participants.body(p)
		if not item or item.kind ~= "Melee" or not root then
			continue
		end
		local reach = (item.reach or 5) * math.max(1, p.scale * 0.9)
		local guard = item.guard or 0.5
		local hand = (root.CFrame * CharacterLook.grip(p.scale)).Position
		local start = Vector3.new(hand.X, 0, hand.Z)
		for _, zombie in zombies do
			local zRoot = Participants.body(zombie)
			if zRoot then
				local z = Vector3.new(zRoot.Position.X, 0, zRoot.Position.Z)
				local along = math.clamp((z - start):Dot(p.aim), 0, reach)
				local offset = z - (start + p.aim * along)
				local radius = Config.CHARACTER.ShellDiameter / 2 * zombie.scale
				if
					offset.Magnitude < radius + guard and Combat.lineOfSight(root.Position, zRoot.Position)
				then
					local firmness = (item.firmness or 1) * math.clamp(p.scale / zombie.scale, 0.5, 2)
					local away = Util.flatUnit(offset) or p.aim
					-- Each pulse covers part of the tick: soft weapons leave long gaps
					-- the zombie walks through, firm ones short gaps to steer around.
					local seconds = SHAFT_INTERVAL * Config.SHAFT_PULSE_SHARE * math.min(1, firmness)
					local speed = Config.SHAFT_ZOMBIE_PUSH * math.min(firmness, 1.5)
					Combat.knockback(zombie, away * speed, 0, seconds, true)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function dragStep()
	for _, p in Participants.onTeam("Human") do
		if p.dragging then
			local item = Items.get(p.heldItem)
			local root, humanoid = Participants.body(p)
			if not item or item.kind ~= "Melee" or not root or not humanoid then
				p.dragging = false
				continue
			end
			local reach = (item.reach or 5) * math.max(1, p.scale * 0.9)
			local hand = (root.CFrame * CharacterLook.grip(p.scale)).Position
			local center = Vector3.new(hand.X, root.Position.Y, hand.Z) + p.aim * (reach / 2)
			local box = CFrame.lookAt(center, center + p.aim)
			local nearest: BasePart? = nil
			local nearestDistance = math.huge
			for _, body in FurnitureService.findInBox(box, Vector3.new(1, root.Size.Y + 1, reach)) do
				local d = Util.flatDistance(body.Position, root.Position)
				if d < nearestDistance then
					nearest, nearestDistance = body, d
				end
			end
			if nearest and nearestDistance > root.Size.X / 2 + 2 then
				local toward = Util.flatUnit(root.Position - nearest.Position)
				if toward then
					local hook = if item.dragsFurniture then 1.5 else 1
					local strength = RoundRules.pushStrength(p.scale) * hook
					FurnitureService.addPush(
						nearest,
						toward * humanoid.WalkSpeed * Config.ITEM_DRAG_FACTOR,
						strength,
						nil
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Water gun and leaf blower: while held, push every zombie in the cone a
-- little, many times a second. The leaf blower also blows light furniture.
local function streamStep()
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, p in Participants.onTeam("Human") do
		if not p.streaming then
			continue
		end
		local item = Items.get(p.heldItem)
		local root = Participants.body(p)
		if not item or item.kind ~= "Stream" or not root then
			setStreaming(p, nil)
			continue
		end
		if now < p.nextStreamTick then
			continue
		end
		p.nextStreamTick = now + (item.tick or 0.12)
		if item.charges then
			p.heldCharges = (p.heldCharges or 1) - 1
			p.state:SetAttribute("HeldCharges", p.heldCharges)
			if p.heldCharges <= 0 then
				ItemService.take(p) -- out of water
			end
		end
		local reach = (item.reach or 14) * math.max(1, p.scale * 0.9)
		for _, hit in Combat.zombiesInCone(p, p.aim, reach, item.arc or 30) do
			local falloff = 1 - hit.distance / (reach * 1.5)
			Combat.knockback(hit.target, p.aim * (item.knockback or 15) * falloff, item.stun or 0.1)
		end
		if item.fx == "Leaves" then
			local center = root.Position + p.aim * (reach / 2)
			local box = CFrame.lookAt(center, center + p.aim)
			for _, body in FurnitureService.findInBox(box, Vector3.new(reach * 0.6, 4, reach)) do
				local weight = FurnitureService.weightOf(body)
				if weight == "Light" or weight == "Medium" then
					FurnitureService.shove(body, p.aim * (if weight == "Light" then 12 else 6), 0.18)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function ItemService.init()
	groundFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("GroundItems") :: Folder
	CharacterService.onResized = attachHeld -- the grip moves with your size

	Remotes.event("UseItem").OnServerEvent:Connect(onUse)
	Remotes.unreliable("Aim").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, aim)
		local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
		local direction = if p and typeof(aim) == "Vector3" then Util.flatUnit(aim) else nil
		if p and direction then
			p.aim = direction
		end
	end)

	local lastAction: { [Player]: number } = {}
	local function throttled(player: Player): boolean
		local now = os.clock()
		if lastAction[player] and now - lastAction[player] < 0.2 then
			return true
		end
		lastAction[player] = now
		return false
	end

	Remotes.event("PickUp").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
		if p and not throttled(player) then
			ItemService.pickUp(p)
		end
	end)
	Remotes.event("DropItem").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
		if p and p.team == "Human" and not throttled(player) then
			ItemService.drop(p)
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastAction[player] = nil
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(dragStep)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(shaftStep)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(streamStep)
end

return ItemService

scripts.name: Main
scripts.source:
-- Server entry point: builds the world, starts every service, and turns
-- joining players into participants.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Remotes")) -- creates the remotes

local WorldSetup = require(script.Parent.WorldSetup)
WorldSetup.run()

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)

local AdminService = require(script.Parent.AdminService)
local BotService = require(script.Parent.BotService)
local BushService = require(script.Parent.BushService)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Combat = require(script.Parent.Combat)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local FurnitureService = require(script.Parent.FurnitureService)
local ItemService = require(script.Parent.ItemService)
local MapBuilder = require(script.Parent.MapBuilder)
local MonetizationService = require(script.Parent.MonetizationService)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Projectiles = require(script.Parent.Projectiles)
local RoundManager = require(script.Parent.RoundManager)
local ShopService = require(script.Parent.ShopService)
local TopScores = require(script.Parent.TopScores)
local Traps = require(script.Parent.Traps)

local firstMap = MapLayout.use(Config.MAP_ROTATION[1])
MapBuilder.build(firstMap)
FurnitureService.build(firstMap)
CharacterService.buildTemplate()
CharacterService.init()

FurnitureService.start(function()
	local movers = {}
	for _, p in Participants.all() do
		local root, humanoid = Participants.body(p)
		if root and humanoid then
			local item = Items.get(p.heldItem)
			local melee = p.team == "Human" and item and item.kind == "Melee"
			table.insert(movers, {
				root = root,
				humanoid = humanoid,
				id = p.id,
				scale = p.scale,
				aim = p.aim,
				reach = if melee and item then (item.reach or 5) * math.max(1, p.scale * 0.9) else nil,
				dragging = p.dragging,
				firmness = if melee and item then item.firmness else nil,
				guard = if melee and item then item.guard else nil,
			})
		end
	end
	return movers
end)

Combat.init()
Projectiles.init()
Traps.init()
BushService.init()
ItemService.init()
ShopService.init()
DataService.init()
MonetizationService.init()
TopScores.start()
RoundManager.start()
AdminService.init()

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	player.CanLoadCharacterAppearance = false
	local profile = DataService.load(player) -- yields
	local passes = MonetizationService.ownedPasses(player) -- yields
	if player.Parent ~= Players then
		return
	end
	local p = Participants.add({
		id = Participants.playerId(player),
		name = player.DisplayName,
		player = player,
		isBot = false,
		profile = profile,
		passes = passes,
	})
	MonetizationService.applyPasses(p)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	if p then
		Participants.remove(p)
	end
end)

BotService.start()
print("[Brain Tag] server ready")

scripts.name: MapBuilder
scripts.source:
-- Builds the neighborhood from MapLayout: grass with little details, dirt
-- paths, the road, house floors with patterns, outlined walls split into
-- breakable segments, windows, bushes and an invisible boundary.

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)

local MapBuilder = {}

local COLORS = MapLayout.COLORS
local H = MapLayout.HEIGHTS
local WALL_HEIGHT = MapLayout.WALL_HEIGHT

type Rect = MapLayout.Rect
type Layout = MapLayout.Layout

local mapFolder: Folder
local wallsFolder: Folder? = nil
local brokenSegments: { Model } = {}

local function sub(name: string, parent: Instance): Folder
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = name
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end

-- Thin detail lying on a surface whose top is `surfaceY`.
local function detail(
	name: string,
	x: number,
	z: number,
	sx: number,
	sz: number,
	surfaceY: number,
	color: string,
	parent: Instance,
	yaw: number?
): Part
	local part = Parts.make({
		name = name,
		size = Vector3.new(sx, 0.04, sz),
		cframe = CFrame.new(x, surfaceY + 0.015, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw or 0, 0),
		color = color,
		canCollide = false,
		canQuery = false,
		parent = parent,
	})
	return part
end

local function flatDisc(
	name: string,
	x: number,
	z: number,
	diameter: number,
	surfaceY: number,
	color: string,
	parent: Instance
)
	local part = Parts.disc(name, Vector3.new(x, surfaceY + 0.02, z), diameter, 0.05, color, parent)
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	return part
end

local function slab(name: string, r: Rect, topY: number, color: string, parent: Instance): Part
	return Parts.slab(name, r.x1, r.z1, r.x2, r.z2, topY, 0.4, color, parent)
end

-- Ground, decorations, paths -----------------------------------------------------

local function speckle(
	r: Rect,
	surfaceY: number,
	color: string,
	perArea: number,
	rng: Random,
	parent: Instance
)
	local count = math.floor((r.x2 - r.x1) * (r.z2 - r.z1) / perArea)
	for _ = 1, count do
		flatDisc(
			"Speck",
			rng:NextNumber(r.x1 + 0.4, r.x2 - 0.4),
			rng:NextNumber(r.z1 + 0.4, r.z2 - 0.4),
			rng:NextNumber(0.25, 0.5),
			surfaceY,
			color,
			parent
		)
	end
end

local function buildGround(parent: Instance, layout: Layout)
	-- Outside the brick wall: a darker field, far bigger than the playable
	-- area so the camera never sees past it (beyond it you'd see the sky).
	local outside = Parts.slab("Outside", -900, -900, 900, 900, H.Grass - 0.05, 4, COLORS.Outside, parent)
	outside.Name = "Outside"
	local b = layout.bounds
	local ground = Parts.slab("Grass", b.x1, b.z1, b.x2, b.z2, H.Grass, 4, COLORS.Grass, parent)
	ground.Name = "Ground"

	local decor = sub("GrassDetails", parent)
	local rng = Random.new(1337)
	local blocked = MapLayout.noDecorRects(layout)
	local bounds = layout.bounds
	local function isFree(x: number, z: number): boolean
		for _, r in blocked do
			if MapLayout.inRect(r, x, z, 1) then
				return false
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	local placed = 0
	local tries = 0
	while placed < 460 and tries < 6000 do
		tries += 1
		local x = rng:NextNumber(bounds.x1 + 3, bounds.x2 - 3)
		local z = rng:NextNumber(bounds.z1 + 3, bounds.z2 - 3)
		if isFree(x, z) then
			placed += 1
			local roll = rng:NextNumber()
			if roll < 0.5 then
				-- Tuft: three dark blades fanned out.
				for _, angle in { -0.5, 0, 0.5 } do
					detail("Tuft", x + angle * 0.5, z, 0.25, 1.1, H.Grass, COLORS.GrassTuft, decor, angle)
				end
			elseif roll < 0.7 then
				flatDisc("Flower", x, z, 1.0, H.Grass, COLORS.Flower, decor)
				flatDisc("FlowerCenter", x, z, 0.35, H.Grass + 0.03, COLORS.FlowerCenter, decor)
			elseif roll < 0.88 then
				flatDisc("Pebble", x, z, rng:NextNumber(0.5, 0.9), H.Grass, COLORS.Pebble, decor)
				if rng:NextNumber() < 0.5 then
					flatDisc(
						"Pebble",
						x + 0.8,
						z + 0.3,
						rng:NextNumber(0.35, 0.6),
						H.Grass,
						COLORS.Pebble,
						decor
					)
				end
			else
				local yaw = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi)
				detail("Twig", x, z, 0.16, 1.5, H.Grass, COLORS.Twig, decor, yaw)
				detail("Twig", x + 0.3, z + 0.2, 0.12, 0.6, H.Grass, COLORS.Twig, decor, yaw + 0.8)
			end
		end
	end

	local paths = sub("Paths", parent)
	for _, r in layout.paths do
		slab("Dirt", r, H.Dirt, COLORS.Dirt, paths)
		speckle(r, H.Dirt, COLORS.DirtSpeck, 14, rng, paths)
	end

	local patios = sub("Patios", parent)
	for _, r in layout.patios do
		slab("Patio", r, H.Patio, COLORS.Concrete, patios)
		speckle(r, H.Patio, COLORS.ConcreteSpeck, 30, rng, patios)
	end
end

-- Pools: a white rim, blue water with light ripples, and an invisible wall
-- so nobody walks across the water.
local function buildPools(parent: Instance, layout: Layout)
	for _, r in layout.pools do
		local rim = { x1 = r.x1 - 1.5, z1 = r.z1 - 1.5, x2 = r.x2 + 1.5, z2 = r.z2 + 1.5 }
		slab("PoolRim", rim, H.PoolRim, COLORS.PoolRim, parent)
		slab("PoolWater", r, H.PoolRim + 0.02, COLORS.PoolWater, parent)
		local z = r.z1 + 3
		while z < r.z2 - 2 do
			detail(
				"Ripple",
				(r.x1 + r.x2) / 2 + math.sin(z) * 4,
				z,
				(r.x2 - r.x1) * 0.6,
				0.3,
				H.PoolRim + 0.02,
				"8FD3F5",
				parent
			)
			z += 5
		end
		Parts.make({
			name = "PoolWall",
			size = Vector3.new(r.x2 - r.x1 + 2, 6, r.z2 - r.z1 + 2),
			cframe = CFrame.new((r.x1 + r.x2) / 2, 3, (r.z1 + r.z2) / 2),
			color = "000000",
			transparency = 1,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = parent,
		})
	end
end

local function buildRoad(parent: Instance, layout: Layout)
	local road = layout.road
	local rng = Random.new(99)
	for _, r in road.sidewalks do
		slab("Sidewalk", r, H.Sidewalk, COLORS.Sidewalk, parent)
		speckle(r, H.Sidewalk, COLORS.SidewalkSpeck, 40, rng, parent)
	end
	for _, r in road.asphalt do
		slab("Asphalt", r, H.Asphalt, COLORS.Asphalt, parent)
	end
	for _, r in road.centerLines do
		slab("CenterLine", r, H.RoadLine, COLORS.CenterLine, parent)
	end
	for _, r in road.edgeLines do
		slab("EdgeLine", r, H.RoadLine, COLORS.EdgeLine, parent)
	end
	for _, island in layout.islands do
		slab("IslandWalk", island.walk, H.IslandWalk, COLORS.Sidewalk, parent)
		slab("IslandGrass", island.grass, H.IslandGrass, COLORS.Grass, parent)
	end

	for _, spawn in layout.zombieSpawns do
		flatDisc("ZombiePit", spawn.x, spawn.z, 11, H.RoadLine, COLORS.ZombiePit, parent)
		flatDisc("ZombiePitInner", spawn.x, spawn.z, 7, H.RoadLine + 0.03, "4A1C1C", parent)
	end
end

-- Floors ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function brickFloor(r: Rect, parent: Instance)
	slab("Brick", r, H.Floor, COLORS.Brick, parent)
	local row = 0
	local z = r.z1
	while z < r.z2 - 0.5 do
		local nextZ = math.min(z + 2.5, r.z2)
		if nextZ < r.z2 then
			detail("Mortar", (r.x1 + r.x2) / 2, nextZ, r.x2 - r.x1, 0.22, H.Floor, COLORS.BrickMortar, parent)
		end
		local x = r.x1 + (if row % 2 == 0 then 5 else 2.5)
		while x < r.x2 - 0.5 do
			detail("Joint", x, (z + nextZ) / 2, 0.22, nextZ - z, H.Floor, COLORS.BrickMortar, parent)
			x += 5
		end
		z = nextZ
		row += 1
	end
end

local function tileFloor(r: Rect, parent: Instance)
	slab("Tile", r, H.Floor, COLORS.Tile, parent)
	local size = 4
	local i = 0
	local x = r.x1
	while x < r.x2 - 0.01 do
		local x2 = math.min(x + size, r.x2)
		local j = 0
		local z = r.z1
		while z < r.z2 - 0.01 do
			local z2 = math.min(z + size, r.z2)
			if (i + j) % 2 == 1 then
				detail("TileAlt", (x + x2) / 2, (z + z2) / 2, x2 - x, z2 - z, H.Floor, COLORS.TileAlt, parent)
			end
			z = z2
			j += 1
		end
		x = x2
		i += 1
	end
end

local function woodFloor(r: Rect, parent: Instance, rng: Random)
	slab("Wood", r, H.Floor, COLORS.Wood, parent)
	local z = r.z1 + 2.5
	while z < r.z2 - 0.5 do
		detail("Plank", (r.x1 + r.x2) / 2, z, r.x2 - r.x1, 0.18, H.Floor, COLORS.WoodLine, parent)
		local x = r.x1 + rng:NextNumber(3, 12)
		while x < r.x2 - 2 do
			detail("PlankEnd", x, z - 1.25, 0.18, 2.5, H.Floor, COLORS.WoodLine, parent)
			x += rng:NextNumber(11, 17)
		end
		z += 2.5
	end
end

local function concreteFloor(r: Rect, parent: Instance, rng: Random)
	slab("Concrete", r, H.Floor, COLORS.Concrete, parent)
	speckle(r, H.Floor, COLORS.ConcreteSpeck, 12, rng, parent)
end

local function buildFloors(parent: Instance, layout: Layout)
	local rng = Random.new(7)
	for _, room in layout.rooms do
		local folder = sub(room.house .. " " .. room.name, parent)
		if room.floor == "Brick" then
			brickFloor(room.rect, folder)
		elseif room.floor == "Tile" then
			tileFloor(room.rect, folder)
		elseif room.floor == "Concrete" then
			concreteFloor(room.rect, folder, rng)
		else
			woodFloor(room.rect, folder, rng)
		end
	end
end

-- Walls ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function outlineColor(layout: Layout, houseId: string): string
	for _, house in layout.houses do
		if house.id == houseId then
			return if house.outline == "Orange" then COLORS.OutlineOrange else COLORS.OutlineBlue
		end
	end
	return COLORS.OutlineBlue
end

local function buildWalls(parent: Instance, layout: Layout)
	for i, piece in MapLayout.allWallPieces(layout) do
		local r = piece.rect
		local sx, sz = r.x2 - r.x1, r.z2 - r.z1
		local cx, cz = (r.x1 + r.x2) / 2, (r.z1 + r.z2) / 2
		local segment = Instance.new("Model")
		segment.Name = "WallSegment" .. i

		local wall = Parts.make({
			name = "Wall",
			size = Vector3.new(sx, WALL_HEIGHT, sz),
			cframe = CFrame.new(cx, WALL_HEIGHT / 2, cz),
			color = COLORS.Wall,
			parent = segment,
		})
		-- A slightly bigger, slightly lower slab: from above only its edge shows,
		-- which draws a colored outline around the whole wall shape.
		Parts.make({
			name = "Outline",
			size = Vector3.new(sx + 1, WALL_HEIGHT - 0.1, sz + 1),
			cframe = CFrame.new(cx, (WALL_HEIGHT - 0.1) / 2, cz),
			color = outlineColor(layout, piece.house),
			canCollide = false, -- keeps doorways at their designed width
			canQuery = false,
			parent = segment,
		})
		if piece.window then
			Parts.make({
				name = "Window",
				size = if piece.horizontal then Vector3.new(sx, 0.1, 1.2) else Vector3.new(1.2, 0.1, sz),
				cframe = CFrame.new(cx, WALL_HEIGHT + 0.05, cz),
				color = COLORS.Window,
				canCollide = false,
				canQuery = false,
				parent = segment,
			})
		end
		segment.PrimaryPart = wall
		segment:SetAttribute("House", piece.house)
		CollectionService:AddTag(segment, "Breakable")
		segment.Parent = parent
	end
end

-- Bushes and boundary -------------------------------------------------------------

-- Tall leaf cylinders you can walk into. Seen from the top-down camera they
-- cover anyone standing inside (see Bushes.luau).
local function buildBushes(parent: Instance, layout: Layout)
	local height = Config.BUSH_HEIGHT
	for _, bush in layout.bushes do
		local base = if bush.color == "Orange" then COLORS.BushOrange else COLORS.BushGreen
		local light = if bush.color == "Orange" then "F2AC62" else "5CBF67"
		local model = Instance.new("Model")
		model.Name = "Bush"
		local blobs = {
			{ 0, 0, bush.r * 2 },
			{ math.cos(0.7) * bush.r * 0.6, math.sin(0.7) * bush.r * 0.6, bush.r * 1.4 },
			{ math.cos(3.5) * bush.r * 0.6, math.sin(3.5) * bush.r * 0.6, bush.r * 1.3 },
		}
		local outline = if bush.color == "Orange" then "B5651E" else "2E7D3E"
		for _, blob in blobs do
			-- A darker, slightly bigger, slightly lower disc draws the outline.
			Parts.disc(
				"Outline",
				Vector3.new(bush.x + blob[1], (height - 0.1) / 2, bush.z + blob[2]),
				blob[3] + 0.7,
				height - 0.1,
				outline,
				model
			)
		end
		for _, blob in blobs do
			Parts.disc(
				"Leaves",
				Vector3.new(bush.x + blob[1], height / 2, bush.z + blob[2]),
				blob[3],
				height,
				base,
				model
			)
			Parts.disc(
				"Highlight",
				Vector3.new(bush.x + blob[1] - 0.2, height + 0.03, bush.z + blob[2] - 0.2),
				blob[3] * 0.6,
				0.06,
				light,
				model
			)
		end
		-- Walk-through and shoot-through: bushes only hide what's inside.
		for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.CanCollide = false
				part.CanQuery = false
				part.CanTouch = false
			end
		end
		model.Parent = parent
	end
end

-- A brick wall around the playable area so it's obvious where the map ends:
-- brick-textured tops with a dark cap line on the inside edge, plus an
-- invisible tall barrier on top so nothing is ever knocked over it.
local BOUNDARY_THICKNESS = 3
local BOUNDARY_HEIGHT = 8

type Side = { cx: number, cz: number, sx: number, sz: number, inward: Vector3 }

local function buildBoundary(parent: Instance, layout: Layout)
	local b = layout.bounds
	local t = BOUNDARY_THICKNESS
	local w, d = b.x2 - b.x1, b.z2 - b.z1
	local sides: { Side } = {
		{ cx = (b.x1 + b.x2) / 2, cz = b.z1 - t / 2, sx = w + t * 2, sz = t, inward = Vector3.zAxis },
		{ cx = (b.x1 + b.x2) / 2, cz = b.z2 + t / 2, sx = w + t * 2, sz = t, inward = -Vector3.zAxis },
		{ cx = b.x1 - t / 2, cz = (b.z1 + b.z2) / 2, sx = t, sz = d, inward = Vector3.xAxis },
		{ cx = b.x2 + t / 2, cz = (b.z1 + b.z2) / 2, sx = t, sz = d, inward = -Vector3.xAxis },
	}
	for _, side in sides do
		local cx, cz, sx, sz, inward = side.cx, side.cz, side.sx, side.sz, side.inward
		Parts.make({
			name = "BrickWall",
			size = Vector3.new(sx, BOUNDARY_HEIGHT, sz),
			cframe = CFrame.new(cx, BOUNDARY_HEIGHT / 2, cz),
			color = COLORS.BoundaryBrick,
			material = Enum.Material.Brick,
			parent = parent,
		})
		-- Dark line along the inside edge, like the outline on house walls.
		local edge = Vector3.new(cx, 0, cz) + inward * (t / 2 - 0.25)
		Parts.make({
			name = "WallCap",
			size = if inward.X == 0 then Vector3.new(sx, 0.1, 0.5) else Vector3.new(0.5, 0.1, sz),
			cframe = CFrame.new(edge.X, BOUNDARY_HEIGHT + 0.05, edge.Z),
			color = COLORS.BoundaryCap,
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = parent,
		})
		Parts.make({
			name = "Boundary",
			size = Vector3.new(sx, 40, sz),
			cframe = CFrame.new(cx, BOUNDARY_HEIGHT + 20, cz),
			color = "000000",
			transparency = 1,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = parent,
		})
	end
end

-- Public ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Surface physics for furniture (see FurnitureBuilder): the weight-100 side
-- of a contact decides its friction.
local SLIPPERY = PhysicalProperties.new(0.7, 0, 0, 100, 1)
local GRIPPY = PhysicalProperties.new(0.7, 1, 0, 100, 1)

local function setPhysics(folder: Instance, properties: PhysicalProperties)
	for _, part in folder:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
			part.CustomPhysicalProperties = properties
		end
	end
end

-- Builds `layout`, replacing whatever map was there. The Walls folder is
-- kept (only emptied) so raycast filters that point at it stay valid.
function MapBuilder.build(layout: Layout)
	mapFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("Map") :: Folder
	local walls = wallsFolder or sub("Walls", mapFolder)
	wallsFolder = walls
	for _, child in mapFolder:GetChildren() do
		if child ~= walls then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	walls:ClearAllChildren()
	table.clear(brokenSegments)

	local ground = sub("Ground", mapFolder)
	buildGround(ground, layout)
	local road = sub("Road", mapFolder)
	buildRoad(road, layout)
	local pools = sub("Pools", mapFolder)
	buildPools(pools, layout)
	local floors = sub("Floors", mapFolder)
	buildFloors(floors, layout)
	buildWalls(walls, layout)
	local bushes = sub("Bushes", mapFolder)
	buildBushes(bushes, layout)
	buildBoundary(sub("Boundary", mapFolder), layout)
	for _, folder in { ground, road, floors } do
		setPhysics(folder, SLIPPERY)
	end
	setPhysics(walls, GRIPPY)
	setPhysics(pools, GRIPPY)
	mapFolder:SetAttribute("MapName", layout.name)
end

function MapBuilder.wallsFolder(): Folder
	assert(wallsFolder, "MapBuilder.build has not run yet")
	return wallsFolder
end

-- Shotgun hit: hide a wall segment until the next round.
function MapBuilder.breakSegment(segment: Model): boolean
	if segment:GetAttribute("Broken") or not CollectionService:HasTag(segment, "Breakable") then
		return false
	end
	segment:SetAttribute("Broken", true)
	for _, part in segment:GetChildren() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part:SetAttribute("WasCollide", part.CanCollide)
			part:SetAttribute("WasQuery", part.CanQuery)
			part.Transparency = 1
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CanQuery = false
		end
	end
	table.insert(brokenSegments, segment)
	return true
end

function MapBuilder.restoreWalls()
	for _, segment in brokenSegments do
		segment:SetAttribute("Broken", nil)
		for _, part in segment:GetChildren() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.Transparency = 0
				part.CanCollide = part:GetAttribute("WasCollide") ~= false
				part.CanQuery = part:GetAttribute("WasQuery") ~= false
			end
		end
	end
	table.clear(brokenSegments)
end

-- Finds the breakable segment a part belongs to.
function MapBuilder.segmentOf(part: Instance): Model?
	local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if model and CollectionService:HasTag(model, "Breakable") then
		return model
	end
	return nil
end

return MapBuilder

scripts.name: MonetizationService
scripts.source:
-- Robux purchases: game passes (permanent perks) and developer products
-- (one-off items, boosts and skins). Ids live in Config.MONETIZATION; any id
-- left at 0 is simply ignored.
--
-- ProcessReceipt follows Roblox's recommended pattern: a purchase is granted
-- once, recorded in the buyer's saved profile by its PurchaseId, and only
-- reported as granted after that profile is saved. If anything fails, Roblox
-- retries later and the receipt log prevents a double grant.

local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Announcer = require(script.Parent.Announcer)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local ItemService = require(script.Parent.ItemService)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Skins = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Skins)
local ShopService = require(script.Parent.ShopService)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local MonetizationService = {}

local money = Config.MONETIZATION

local function keyFor(map: { [string]: number }, id: number): string?
	for key, value in map do
		if value ~= 0 and value == id then
			return key
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Game passes ----------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Which configured passes this player owns (yields; call before spawning).
function MonetizationService.ownedPasses(player: Player): { [string]: boolean }
	local owned: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for key, id in money.GamePasses do
		if id ~= 0 then
			local ok, has = pcall(function()
				return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, id)
			end)
			if ok and has then
				owned[key :: string] = true
			end
		end
	end
	return owned
end

local function applyPasses(p: Participant)
	-- Pass skins unlock automatically.
	for _, skin in Skins.list do
		if skin.pass and p.passes[skin.pass] then
			ShopService.grantSkin(p, skin.id)
		end
	end
	Participants.publish(p)
	CharacterService.refreshNameTag(p)
end

function MonetizationService.applyPasses(p: Participant)
	applyPasses(p)
end

-- Developer products -----------------------------------------------------------------

local function giveOrQueue(p: Participant, itemId: string)
	if p.team == "Human" and Participants.body(p) then
		ItemService.give(p, itemId)
		if p.player then
			Announcer.toast(p.player, "Delivered! Check your hand.", Config.COLORS.Good)
		end
	elseif p.profile then
		table.insert(p.profile.PendingItems, itemId)
		if p.player then
			Announcer.toast(p.player, "Saved for you: you'll get it next round.", Config.COLORS.Good)
		end
	end
end

type Handler = (p: Participant) -> ()

local HANDLERS: { [string]: Handler } = {
	InstantBat = function(p)
		giveOrQueue(p, "Bat")
	end,
	InstantSpear = function(p)
		giveOrQueue(p, "Spear")
	end,
	InstantShotgun = function(p)
		giveOrQueue(p, "Shotgun")
	end,
	ImmunityShot = function(p)
		Participants.setImmunity(p, p.immunity + money.IMMUNITY_SHOT_AMOUNT)
		if p.player then
			Announcer.toast(p.player, "Immunity boosted!", Config.COLORS.Good)
		end
	end,
	ScoreBoost30 = function(p)
		local now = os.time()
		p.boostEndsAt = math.max(now, p.boostEndsAt) + money.SCORE_BOOST_SECONDS
		if p.profile then
			p.profile.BoostEndsAt = p.boostEndsAt
		end
		p.state:SetAttribute("BoostEndsAt", p.boostEndsAt)
		if p.player then
			Announcer.toast(p.player, "2x score is active!", Config.COLORS.Good)
		end
	end,
}

-- Every skin sold as a product gets a handler that unlocks and equips it.
for _, skin in Skins.list do
	if skin.product then
		HANDLERS[skin.product] = function(p)
			ShopService.grantSkin(p, skin.id)
			ShopService.equipSkin(p, skin)
			if p.player then
				Announcer.toast(p.player, "Unlocked " .. skin.name .. "!", Config.COLORS.Good)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function processReceipt(receipt: { [string]: any }): Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receipt.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet -- retried when they rejoin
	end
	local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	local profile = DataService.get(player)
	if not p or not profile then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local key = keyFor(money.Products, receipt.ProductId)
	local handler = key and HANDLERS[key]
	if not handler then
		warn(
			"[Shop] Unknown product id "
				.. tostring(receipt.ProductId)
				.. "; add it to Config.MONETIZATION.Products"
		)
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local receiptId = tostring(receipt.PurchaseId)
	if not profile.Receipts[receiptId] then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			(handler :: Handler)(p)
			return true
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[Shop] Grant failed: " .. tostring(err))
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
		end
		profile.Receipts[receiptId] = os.time()
	end

	if DataService.isSaved(player) then
		if DataService.save(player) then
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	-- Studio test purchases are free; with saving off, grant for this session.
	if RunService:IsStudio() then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
end

function MonetizationService.init()
	MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = processReceipt

	MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, purchased)
		if not purchased then
			return
		end
		local key = keyFor(money.GamePasses, passId)
		local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
		if key and p then
			p.passes[key] = true
			applyPasses(p)
			Announcer.toast(player, "Thanks! Your pass is active.", Config.COLORS.Good)
		end
	end)
end

return MonetizationService

scripts.name: Participants
scripts.source:
-- Everyone taking part in rounds: real players and Studio test bots, behind
-- one interface. Each participant is mirrored into a Configuration under
-- ReplicatedStorage.BrainTagState.Participants so every client's HUD can read
-- teams, scores and held items.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Skins = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Skins)

export type Team = "Human" | "Zombie"

export type Participant = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	player: Player?,
	isBot: boolean,
	character: Model?,
	team: Team,
	score: number,
	immunity: number,
	scale: number,
	heldItem: string?,
	humanSkin: string,
	zombieSkin: string,
	ownedSkins: { [string]: boolean },
	passes: { [string]: boolean },
	boostEndsAt: number,
	-- runtime only
	itemReadyAt: number,
	returnReadyAt: number,
	stunUntil: number,
	dragging: boolean,
	streaming: boolean, -- holding the button with a water gun / leaf blower
	nextStreamTick: number,
	heldCharges: number?, -- uses left (banana peels)
	boostUntil: number, -- energy drink
	boostFactor: number,
	slowUntil: number, -- snowball freeze
	adminSpeed: number, -- speed multiplier set from the admin panel (1 = normal)
	alpha: boolean, -- one of this round's first zombies (special look)
	knockedUntil: number, -- a real hit's shove lasts until then (see Combat.knockback)
	slowFactor: number,
	spawning: boolean,
	aim: Vector3,
	profile: any?, -- saved data table for players (DataService)
	state: Configuration,
}

local Participants = {}

local byId: { [string]: Participant } = {}
local order: { Participant } = {}
-- Plain callback lists, not BindableEvents: a BindableEvent hands listeners a
-- COPY of any table it carries, and every service must share the same
-- participant table.
local addedCallbacks: { (Participant) -> () } = {}
local removingCallbacks: { (Participant) -> () } = {}

-- Runs `callback(p)` in its own thread for every participant added from now on.
function Participants.onAdded(callback: (Participant) -> ())
	table.insert(addedCallbacks, callback)
end

-- Runs `callback(p)` just before a participant is removed.
function Participants.onRemoving(callback: (Participant) -> ())
	table.insert(removingCallbacks, callback)
end

local function stateFolder(): Folder
	return ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BrainTagState"):WaitForChild("Participants") :: Folder
end

local function csv(set: { [string]: boolean }): string
	local list = {}
	for key, on in set do
		if on then
			table.insert(list, key)
		end
	end
	table.sort(list)
	return table.concat(list, ",")
end

-- Writes every replicated field. Cheap enough to call after any change.
function Participants.publish(p: Participant)
	local s = p.state
	s:SetAttribute("DisplayName", p.name)
	s:SetAttribute("UserId", if p.player then p.player.UserId else 0)
	s:SetAttribute("IsBot", p.isBot)
	s:SetAttribute("Team", p.team)
	s:SetAttribute("Score", math.floor(p.score))
	s:SetAttribute("Immunity", p.immunity)
	s:SetAttribute("Scale", p.scale)
	s:SetAttribute("HeldItem", p.heldItem or "")
	s:SetAttribute("HeldCharges", p.heldCharges or 0)
	s:SetAttribute("HumanSkin", p.humanSkin)
	s:SetAttribute("ZombieSkin", p.zombieSkin)
	s:SetAttribute("OwnedSkins", csv(p.ownedSkins))
	s:SetAttribute("Passes", csv(p.passes))
	s:SetAttribute("VIP", p.passes.VIP == true)
	s:SetAttribute("BoostEndsAt", p.boostEndsAt)
	if p.profile then
		s:SetAttribute("Wins", p.profile.Wins or 0)
		s:SetAttribute("Infections", p.profile.Infections or 0)
		s:SetAttribute("RoundsPlayed", p.profile.RoundsPlayed or 0)
		s:SetAttribute("SeenTutorial", p.profile.SeenTutorial == true)
	end
end

export type NewParticipant = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	player: Player?,
	isBot: boolean,
	profile: any?,
	passes: { [string]: boolean }?,
}

function Participants.add(info: NewParticipant): Participant
	local state = Instance.new("Configuration")
	state.Name = info.id
	local profile = info.profile
	local owned = {}
	if profile and profile.OwnedSkins then
		for id, on in profile.OwnedSkins do
			owned[id] = on == true
		end
	end
	owned[Skins.DEFAULT_HUMAN] = true
	owned[Skins.DEFAULT_ZOMBIE] = true

	local p: Participant = {
		id = info.id,
		name = info.name,
		player = info.player,
		isBot = info.isBot,
		character = nil,
		team = "Human",
		score = if profile then profile.Score or 0 else 0,
		immunity = 0,
		scale = 1,
		heldItem = nil,
		humanSkin = if profile then profile.HumanSkin or Skins.DEFAULT_HUMAN else Skins.DEFAULT_HUMAN,
		zombieSkin = if profile then profile.ZombieSkin or Skins.DEFAULT_ZOMBIE else Skins.DEFAULT_ZOMBIE,
		ownedSkins = owned,
		passes = info.passes or {},
		boostEndsAt = if profile then profile.BoostEndsAt or 0 else 0,
		itemReadyAt = 0,
		returnReadyAt = 0,
		stunUntil = 0,
		dragging = false,
		streaming = false,
		nextStreamTick = 0,
		heldCharges = nil,
		boostUntil = 0,
		boostFactor = 1,
		slowUntil = 0,
		adminSpeed = 1,
		alpha = false,
		knockedUntil = 0,
		slowFactor = 1,
		spawning = false,
		aim = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
		profile = profile,
		state = state,
	}
	byId[p.id] = p
	table.insert(order, p)
	Participants.publish(p)
	state.Parent = stateFolder()
	for _, callback in addedCallbacks do
		task.spawn(callback, p)
	end
	return p
end

function Participants.remove(p: Participant)
	if byId[p.id] ~= p then
		return
	end
	for _, callback in removingCallbacks do
		task.spawn(callback, p)
	end
	byId[p.id] = nil
	local index = table.find(order, p)
	if index then
		table.remove(order, index)
	end
	p.state:Destroy()
end

function Participants.get(id: string): Participant?
	return byId[id]
end

function Participants.playerId(player: Player): string
	return "P" .. player.UserId
end

function Participants.fromPlayer(player: Player): Participant?
	return byId[Participants.playerId(player)]
end

function Participants.fromCharacter(model: Instance?): Participant?
	if not model then
		return nil
	end
	local id = model:GetAttribute("ParticipantId")
	if typeof(id) == "string" then
		return byId[id]
	end
	return nil
end

-- Finds the participant whose character contains `part`.
function Participants.fromPart(part: Instance): Participant?
	local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	while model do
		local p = Participants.fromCharacter(model)
		if p then
			return p
		end
		model = model:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	end
	return nil
end

function Participants.all(): { Participant }
	return table.clone(order)
end

function Participants.count(): number
	return #order
end

function Participants.onTeam(team: Team): { Participant }
	local list = {}
	for _, p in order do
		if p.team == team then
			table.insert(list, p)
		end
	end
	return list
end

-- Root and humanoid of a participant whose character is alive, else nil.
function Participants.body(p: Participant): (BasePart?, Humanoid?)
	local character = p.character
	if not character or character.Parent == nil then
		return nil, nil
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return nil, nil
	end
	return root, humanoid
end

function Participants.setScore(p: Participant, value: number)
	p.score = math.max(0, math.floor(value))
	if p.profile then
		p.profile.Score = p.score
	end
	p.state:SetAttribute("Score", p.score)
end

function Participants.addScore(p: Participant, amount: number)
	Participants.setScore(p, p.score + amount)
end

function Participants.setImmunity(p: Participant, value: number)
	p.immunity = math.clamp(value, 0, 100)
	p.state:SetAttribute("Immunity", p.immunity)
end

return Participants

scripts.name: Projectiles
scripts.source:
-- Everything that flies: potatoes, pebbles, snowballs, bubbles and rubber
-- ducks. Simulated on the server with sphere casts so hits are decided in
-- one place. Shots pass through humans and bushes and stop at the first
-- zombie, wall or piece of furniture, then apply their effect (shove,
-- freeze, bubble trap or explosion).

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Announcer = require(script.Parent.Announcer)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Combat = require(script.Parent.Combat)
local FurnitureService = require(script.Parent.FurnitureService)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local Projectiles = {}

type Shot = {
	model: Model,
	position: Vector3,
	direction: Vector3,
	traveled: number,
	item: Items.Item,
	params: RaycastParams,
	ignored: { Instance },
}

local shots: { Shot } = {}
local folder: Folder

local function ball(model: Model, diameter: number, offset: Vector3, color: string, transparency: number?)
	local part = Parts.make({
		name = "Ball",
		shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
		size = Vector3.one * diameter,
		cframe = CFrame.new(offset),
		color = color,
		transparency = transparency,
		canCollide = false,
		canQuery = false,
		parent = model,
	})
	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		model.PrimaryPart = part
	end
end

-- The flying object, built at the origin facing -Z.
local function buildLook(item: Items.Item): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = item.projectile or "Potato"
	local d = (item.projectileRadius or 0.6) * 2
	local look = item.projectile
	if look == "Pebble" then
		ball(model, d, Vector3.zero, "8C8C8C")
	elseif look == "Snowball" then
		ball(model, d, Vector3.zero, "FFFFFF")
		ball(model, d * 0.5, Vector3.new(0.2, 0.25, -0.1), "E8F6FF")
	elseif look == "Bubble" then
		ball(model, d, Vector3.zero, "BFE9FF", 0.55)
		ball(model, d * 0.25, Vector3.new(-d * 0.2, d * 0.3, -d * 0.15), "FFFFFF", 0.2) -- shine
	elseif look == "Duck" then
		ball(model, d, Vector3.zero, "FFD93B")
		ball(model, d * 0.6, Vector3.new(0, d * 0.35, -d * 0.35), "FFD93B")
		Parts.make({
			name = "Beak",
			size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.15, 0.4) * d,
			cframe = CFrame.new(0, d * 0.32, -d * 0.7),
			color = "F28C1C",
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = model,
		})
	else
		ball(model, d, Vector3.zero, if item.isRare then "B98A4E" else "C9A66B")
		ball(model, d * 0.25, Vector3.new(d * 0.2, d * 0.3, 0), "8B6A43")
	end
	return model
end

local function impact(shot: Shot, at: Vector3, target: Participant?, hitPart: Instance)
	local item = shot.item
	local dir = shot.direction
	if item.effect == "Explode" then
		Combat.explode(at, item.radius or 10, item.knockback or 100, item.stun or 0.5)
		for _, body in
			FurnitureService.findInBox(
				CFrame.new(at),
				Vector3.new(1, 0, 1) * (item.radius or 10) * 1.6 + Vector3.yAxis * 6
			)
		do
			local away = Util.flatUnit(body.Position - at) or dir
			FurnitureService.shove(body, away * 18, 0.35)
		end
		Announcer.fx("Boom", { position = at })
		return
	end
	if target and target.team == "Zombie" then
		if item.knockback and item.knockback > 0 then
			Combat.knockback(target, dir * item.knockback, item.stun or 0.3)
		else
			Combat.knockback(target, Vector3.zero, item.stun or 0.3)
		end
		if item.effect == "Freeze" then
			CharacterService.speedEffect(target, item.slowFactor or 0.4, item.effectSeconds or 2.5)
			Announcer.fx("Frozen", { character = target.character, seconds = item.effectSeconds or 2.5 })
		elseif item.effect == "Bubble" then
			Announcer.fx("Bubbled", { character = target.character, seconds = item.effectSeconds or 2 })
		end
	elseif hitPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		local weight = FurnitureService.weightOf(hitPart)
		if weight == "Light" or (weight == "Medium" and (item.knockback or 0) >= 80) then
			FurnitureService.shove(hitPart, dir * 12, 0.25)
		end
	end
	Announcer.fx("Splat", { position = at, look = item.projectile })
end

local function finish(shot: Shot)
	shot.model:Destroy()
	local index = table.find(shots, shot)
	if index then
		table.remove(shots, index)
	end
end

local function step(dt: number)
	for i = #shots, 1, -1 do
		local shot = shots[i]
		local item = shot.item
		local distance = (item.projectileSpeed or 90) * dt
		local radius = item.projectileRadius or 0.6
		local done = false
		-- A Spherecast ignores parts already overlapping its starting sphere,
		-- so each cast starts a little behind the shot. Otherwise a zombie
		-- walking into it between frames would be missed.
		local back = radius + 1
		local origin = shot.position - shot.direction * back
		for _ = 1, 4 do
			local result =
				workspace:Spherecast(origin, radius, shot.direction * (distance + back), shot.params)
			if not result then
				break
			end
			local target = Participants.fromPart(result.Instance)
			if target and target.team == "Human" and target.character then
				-- Fly through teammates.
				table.insert(shot.ignored, target.character)
				shot.params.FilterDescendantsInstances = shot.ignored
				continue
			end
			impact(shot, result.Position, target, result.Instance)
			finish(shot)
			done = true
			break
		end
		if not done then
			shot.position += shot.direction * distance
			shot.traveled += distance
			if shot.traveled >= (item.projectileRange or 100) then
				if item.effect == "Explode" then
					impact(shot, shot.position, nil, workspace) -- ducks go off at the end of their flight
				end
				finish(shot)
			else
				-- Ducks and potatoes tumble a little as they fly.
				local spin = CFrame.Angles(0, shot.traveled * 0.15, 0)
				shot.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(shot.position, shot.position + shot.direction) * spin)
			end
		end
	end
end

function Projectiles.fire(shooter: Participant, item: Items.Item, aim: Vector3)
	local root = Participants.body(shooter)
	if not root or not shooter.character then
		return
	end
	local radius = item.projectileRadius or 0.6
	local origin = root.Position + aim * (root.Size.X / 2 + radius + 0.4)
	local model = buildLook(item)
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + aim))
	model.Parent = folder
	local ignored: { Instance } = {
		shooter.character,
		folder,
		workspace:WaitForChild("GroundItems"),
		workspace:WaitForChild("Traps"),
		workspace:WaitForChild("Effects"),
	}
	local map = workspace:WaitForChild("Map")
	for _, name in { "Ground", "Road", "Floors" } do -- shots stop at the boundary wall
		local child = map:FindFirstChild(name)
		if child then
			table.insert(ignored, child)
		end
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
	table.insert(shots, {
		model = model,
		position = origin,
		direction = aim,
		traveled = 0,
		item = item,
		params = params,
		ignored = ignored,
	})
end

function Projectiles.clear()
	for i = #shots, 1, -1 do
		finish(shots[i])
	end
end

function Projectiles.init()
	folder = workspace:WaitForChild("Projectiles") :: Folder
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step)
end

return Projectiles

scripts.name: RoundManager
scripts.source:
-- The round loop: Waiting -> Prep -> Outbreak -> Infection -> End -> (reset) -> Prep.
--
-- Prep: everyone is human; the banner counts down "Outbreak happening in N
-- seconds"; humans shop and barricade. Outbreak: first zombies are picked,
-- weighted by immunity. Infection: a zombie touching a human converts them.
-- Zombies win when no humans remain; survivors win if anyone lasts the timer.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Announcer = require(script.Parent.Announcer)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Combat = require(script.Parent.Combat)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local FurnitureService = require(script.Parent.FurnitureService)
local ItemService = require(script.Parent.ItemService)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local MapBuilder = require(script.Parent.MapBuilder)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Projectiles = require(script.Parent.Projectiles)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local Traps = require(script.Parent.Traps)
local RoundRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoundRules)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)
local Wizard = require(script.Parent.Wizard)

type Participant = Participants.Participant
type Phase = "Waiting" | "Prep" | "Infection" | "End"
type Winner = RoundRules.Winner

local RoundManager = {}

local state: Folder
local phase: Phase = "Waiting"
local rng = Random.new()

-- Spawning ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function spawnFrame(team: string, scale: number): CFrame
	local layout = MapLayout.current()
	local list = if team == "Zombie" then layout.zombieSpawns else layout.humanSpawns
	local spot = list[rng:NextInteger(1, #list)]
	local jitter = if team == "Zombie" then 3 else 5
	local x = spot.x + rng:NextNumber(-jitter, jitter)
	local z = spot.z + rng:NextNumber(-jitter, jitter)
	local y = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor
		+ Config.CHARACTER.HipHeight
		+ Config.CHARACTER.RootHeight / 2 * scale
		+ 0.3
	return CFrame.new(x, y, z)
end

local function recount()
	state:SetAttribute("Survivors", #Participants.onTeam("Human"))
	state:SetAttribute("Zombies", #Participants.onTeam("Zombie"))
end

function RoundManager.phase(): Phase
	return phase
end

local function setPhase(name: Phase, seconds: number)
	phase = name
	state:SetAttribute("Phase", name)
	state:SetAttribute("PhaseEndsAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + seconds)
end

local function secondsLeft(): number
	return (state:GetAttribute("PhaseEndsAt") :: number) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
end

-- Teams --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function RoundManager.setTeam(p: Participant, team: Participants.Team)
	if p.team == team then
		return
	end
	p.team = team
	p.state:SetAttribute("Team", team)
	p.boostUntil, p.slowUntil = 0, 0 -- drinks and freezes don't carry across teams
	if team == "Human" then
		p.alpha = false
	end
	if team == "Zombie" then
		ItemService.onInfected(p)
	end
	CharacterService.applyLook(p)
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	ItemService.refreshHand(p)
	recount()
end

local function bonusesFor(p: Participant, includeDrumstick: boolean): RoundRules.RewardBonuses
	local held = Items.get(p.heldItem)
	return {
		drumstick = if includeDrumstick and held and held.kind == "Passive" then held.rewardBonus else nil,
		vip = p.passes.VIP == true,
		doubleScore = p.passes.DoubleScore == true,
		boosted = os.time() < p.boostEndsAt,
	}
end

local function award(p: Participant, base: number, includeDrumstick: boolean, reason: string)
	local amount = RoundRules.reward(base, bonusesFor(p, includeDrumstick))
	Participants.addScore(p, amount)
	CharacterService.refreshSize(p)
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	if p.player then
		Announcer.toast(
			p.player,
			string.format("+%s score  %s", Util.commas(amount), reason),
			Config.COLORS.Good
		)
	end
end

local function infect(zombie: Participant, human: Participant)
	local root = Participants.body(human)
	-- The zombie eats a share of the human's points: the human shrinks and
	-- slows, the zombie grows and speeds up.
	local stolen = math.floor(human.score * Config.INFECT_STEAL_FRACTION)
	if stolen > 0 then
		Participants.addScore(human, -stolen)
		Participants.addScore(zombie, stolen)
		human.scale = RoundRules.scaleForScore(human.score)
		human.state:SetAttribute("Scale", human.scale)
		if human.player then
			Announcer.toast(
				human.player,
				string.format("-%s points: %s ate them!", Util.commas(stolen), zombie.name),
				Config.COLORS.ZombieText
			)
		end
		if zombie.player then
			Announcer.toast(
				zombie.player,
				string.format("+%s points eaten from %s", Util.commas(stolen), human.name),
				Config.COLORS.Good
			)
		end
	end
	RoundManager.setTeam(human, "Zombie") -- rebuilds the look at the new size
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(human)
	award(zombie, Config.INFECT_REWARD, false, "infection")
	if zombie.profile then
		zombie.profile.Infections = (zombie.profile.Infections or 0) + 1
		zombie.state:SetAttribute("Infections", zombie.profile.Infections)
	end
	if root then
		Announcer.fx("Infect", { position = root.Position })
	end
	Announcer.chat(string.format("%s infected %s!", zombie.name, human.name), "9BE22D")
end

-- Every frame of the infection phase: any zombie close enough to a human,
-- with no wall between them, converts that human.
local function infectionStep()
	if phase ~= "Infection" then
		return
	end
	local zombies = Participants.onTeam("Zombie")
	local humans = Participants.onTeam("Human")
	for _, human in humans do
		local hRoot = Participants.body(human)
		if hRoot and human.team == "Human" then
			for _, zombie in zombies do
				local zRoot = Participants.body(zombie)
				if zRoot and zombie.team == "Zombie" then
					local reach = RoundRules.infectDistance(zombie.scale, human.scale)
					if
						Util.flatDistance(zRoot.Position, hRoot.Position) < reach
						and Combat.clearPath(zRoot.Position, hRoot.Position)
					then
						infect(zombie, human)
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- World reset ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function grantRoundStartItems(p: Participant)
	if p.heldItem then
		return
	end
	local profile = p.profile
	if profile and profile.PendingItems and #profile.PendingItems > 0 then
		local itemId = table.remove(profile.PendingItems, 1)
		if typeof(itemId) == "string" and Items.get(itemId) then
			ItemService.give(p, itemId)
			if p.player then
				Announcer.toast(
					p.player,
					"Your " .. (Items.get(itemId) :: Items.Item).name .. " is ready!",
					Config.COLORS.Good
				)
			end
			return
		end
	end
	if p.passes.StarterKit then
		ItemService.give(p, "Bat")
	end
end

-- Everyone back to human at a yard spawn, furniture and walls restored.
local function resetWorld()
	Wizard.leave()
	Projectiles.clear()
	Traps.clear()
	ItemService.clearGround()
	FurnitureService.resetAll()
	MapBuilder.restoreWalls()
	for _, p in Participants.all() do
		p.team = "Human"
		p.stunUntil = 0
		p.boostUntil, p.slowUntil = 0, 0
		p.alpha = false
		p.dragging = false
		p.scale = RoundRules.scaleForScore(p.score) -- you grow as your score grows
		p.state:SetAttribute("Team", "Human")
		p.state:SetAttribute("Scale", p.scale)
		CharacterService.place(p, spawnFrame("Human", p.scale))
		CharacterService.applyLook(p)
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
		grantRoundStartItems(p)
		ItemService.refreshHand(p)
	end
	recount()
end

-- Phases ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function enoughPlayers(): boolean
	return Participants.count() >= Config.MIN_PLAYERS
end

local function waitForPlayers()
	if enoughPlayers() then
		return
	end
	setPhase("Waiting", 0)
	resetWorld()
	while not enoughPlayers() do
		state:SetAttribute("Needed", Config.MIN_PLAYERS)
		task.wait(1)
	end
end

-- Waits until the phase timer ends. Returns false if players dropped below
-- the minimum (round aborted).
local function waitPhase(): boolean
	while secondsLeft() > 0 do
		if not enoughPlayers() then
			return false
		end
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	return true
end

local function pickFirstZombies(): { Participant }
	local candidates = {}
	for _, p in Participants.onTeam("Human") do
		if Participants.body(p) then
			table.insert(candidates, p)
		end
	end
	local count = RoundRules.firstZombieCount(#candidates)
	return RoundRules.weightedPick(
		candidates,
		function(p: Participant)
			return RoundRules.zombieWeight(p.immunity)
		end,
		count,
		function()
			return rng:NextNumber()
		end
	)
end

local function turnFirstZombie(p: Participant)
	p.alpha = true -- the alpha look (see Skins "Alpha")
	RoundManager.setTeam(p, "Zombie")
	Participants.setImmunity(p, 0)
	if Config.FIRST_ZOMBIES_TO_SPAWN then
		CharacterService.place(p, spawnFrame("Zombie", p.scale))
	end
	p.returnReadyAt = os.clock() + 1
end

local function outbreak()
	Wizard.leave()
	local picked = pickFirstZombies()
	local names = {}
	for _, p in picked do
		turnFirstZombie(p)
		table.insert(names, p.name)
	end
	Announcer.chat(
		"* OUTBREAK! "
			.. table.concat(names, ", ")
			.. (if #names == 1 then " is" else " are")
			.. " a zombie! *",
		"E0303A"
	)
	Announcer.fx("Outbreak", {})
end

local function finishRound(winner: Winner)
	setPhase("End", Config.END_SCREEN_SECONDS)
	state:SetAttribute("Winner", winner)
	for _, p in Participants.all() do
		if p.profile then
			p.profile.RoundsPlayed = (p.profile.RoundsPlayed or 0) + 1
			p.state:SetAttribute("RoundsPlayed", p.profile.RoundsPlayed)
		end
		if winner == "Survivors" and p.team == "Human" then
			award(p, Config.SURVIVOR_WIN_REWARD, true, "survived!")
			if p.profile then
				p.profile.Wins = (p.profile.Wins or 0) + 1
				p.state:SetAttribute("Wins", p.profile.Wins)
			end
		elseif winner == "Zombies" and p.team == "Zombie" then
			award(p, Config.ZOMBIE_WIN_REWARD, false, "zombies win")
		end
	end
	Announcer.chat(if winner == "Survivors" then "Survivors Win!!!" else "Zombies Win!!!")
	Announcer.fx("RoundEnd", { winner = winner })
	task.wait(Config.END_SCREEN_SECONDS)
	state:SetAttribute("Winner", "")
end

local function runInfection(): Winner?
	setPhase("Infection", Config.ROUND_SECONDS)
	while true do
		task.wait(0.1)
		local humans = Participants.onTeam("Human")
		local zombies = Participants.onTeam("Zombie")
		local result = RoundRules.outcome(#humans, secondsLeft())
		if result then
			return result :: Winner
		end
		if #zombies == 0 then
			-- Every zombie left the game: pick a new one, or let the humans win.
			if #humans >= 2 then
				local replacement = pickFirstZombies()[1]
				if replacement then
					turnFirstZombie(replacement)
					Announcer.chat("* The zombies fled... " .. replacement.name .. " turned! *", "E0303A")
				end
			else
				return "Survivors" :: Winner
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Map rotation ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local mapIndex = 1
local roundsOnMap = 0

local function loadMap(name: string)
	local layout = MapLayout.use(name)
	ItemService.clearGround()
	MapBuilder.build(layout)
	FurnitureService.build(layout)
	state:SetAttribute("Map", layout.title)
	Announcer.chat("* Next map: " .. layout.title .. " *")
end

local function nextMapIfDue()
	if roundsOnMap >= Config.ROUNDS_PER_MAP and #Config.MAP_ROTATION > 1 then
		roundsOnMap = 0
		mapIndex = mapIndex % #Config.MAP_ROTATION + 1
		loadMap(Config.MAP_ROTATION[mapIndex])
	end
	roundsOnMap += 1
end

local function runRound()
	waitForPlayers()

	nextMapIfDue()
	resetWorld()
	local round = state:GetAttribute("Round")
	state:SetAttribute("Round", (if typeof(round) == "number" then round else 0) + 1)
	ItemService.scatter()
	setPhase("Prep", Config.PREP_SECONDS)
	Wizard.schedule()
	Announcer.chat(
		MapLayout.current().title
			.. ": outbreak in "
			.. Config.PREP_SECONDS
			.. " seconds. Barricade a room and grab items!"
	)
	if waitPhase() then
		outbreak()
		local winner = runInfection()
		if winner then
			finishRound(winner :: Winner)
		end
	end
end

local function loop()
	while true do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			runRound()
			return true
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[Rounds] round failed, starting a new one: " .. tostring(err))
			state:SetAttribute("Winner", "")
			task.wait(2)
		end
	end
end

-- Joining, leaving, respawning ----------------------------------------------------------------

local function spawnNew(p: Participant)
	p.scale = RoundRules.scaleForScore(p.score)
	p.state:SetAttribute("Scale", p.scale)
	-- Late joiners become zombies once the outbreak has happened.
	if phase == "Infection" then
		p.team = "Zombie"
		p.state:SetAttribute("Team", "Zombie")
	end
	CharacterService.spawn(p, spawnFrame(p.team, p.scale))
	if p.team == "Human" then
		grantRoundStartItems(p)
	end
	ItemService.refreshHand(p)
	recount()
end

local function onZombieReturn(player: Player)
	local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	if not p or p.team ~= "Zombie" or phase ~= "Infection" then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < p.returnReadyAt then
		return
	end
	p.returnReadyAt = now + Config.ZOMBIE_RETURN_COOLDOWN
	CharacterService.place(p, spawnFrame("Zombie", p.scale))
end

function RoundManager.roundNumber(): number
	local round = state:GetAttribute("Round")
	return if typeof(round) == "number" then round else 0
end

-- Admin controls -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Ends the current phase now (prep -> outbreak, infection -> survivors win).
function RoundManager.skipPhase(): boolean
	if phase == "Waiting" or phase == "End" then
		return false
	end
	state:SetAttribute("PhaseEndsAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
	return true
end

function RoundManager.addTime(seconds: number): boolean
	local endsAt = state:GetAttribute("PhaseEndsAt")
	if typeof(endsAt) ~= "number" or phase == "Waiting" or phase == "End" then
		return false
	end
	state:SetAttribute("PhaseEndsAt", endsAt + seconds)
	return true
end

-- The next round starts on the next map in the rotation.
function RoundManager.queueNextMap(): boolean
	if #Config.MAP_ROTATION < 2 then
		return false
	end
	roundsOnMap = Config.ROUNDS_PER_MAP
	return true
end

function RoundManager.respawn(p: Participant)
	CharacterService.spawn(p, spawnFrame(p.team, p.scale))
	ItemService.refreshHand(p)
end

-- Lets bots press Z too.
function RoundManager.zombieReturn(p: Participant)
	if p.team == "Zombie" and phase == "Infection" and os.clock() >= p.returnReadyAt then
		p.returnReadyAt = os.clock() + Config.ZOMBIE_RETURN_COOLDOWN
		CharacterService.place(p, spawnFrame("Zombie", p.scale))
	end
end

function RoundManager.start()
	state = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BrainTagState") :: Folder
	state:SetAttribute("Map", MapLayout.current().title)

	CharacterService.onNeedRespawn = function(p)
		CharacterService.spawn(p, spawnFrame(p.team, p.scale))
		ItemService.refreshHand(p)
	end

	Participants.onAdded(spawnNew)
	Participants.onRemoving(function(p)
		if p.isBot and p.character then
			p.character:Destroy()
		end
		task.defer(recount)
	end)

	Remotes.event("ZombieReturn").OnServerEvent:Connect(onZombieReturn)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(infectionStep)
	task.spawn(loop)
end

return RoundManager

scripts.name: ShopService
scripts.source:
-- Score shop (B), the wizard's shop, skins and the first-join tutorial flag.
-- Clients only ask; every price, distance and balance is checked here.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Announcer = require(script.Parent.Announcer)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local ItemService = require(script.Parent.ItemService)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local Skins = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Skins)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)
local Wizard = require(script.Parent.Wizard)

type Participant = Participants.Participant

local ShopService = {}

local rng = Random.new()

function ShopService.rareChance(p: Participant): number
	if p.passes.Lucky then
		return Config.MONETIZATION.LUCKY_RARE_CHANCE
	end
	return Config.RARE_CHANCE
end

local function buyItem(player: Player, itemId: unknown, fromWizard: unknown): (boolean, string)
	if typeof(itemId) ~= "string" then
		return false, "Unknown item"
	end
	local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	local item = Items.get(itemId)
	if not p or not item then
		return false, "Unknown item"
	end
	if p.team ~= "Human" then
		return false, "Zombies can't shop!"
	end
	local root = Participants.body(p)
	if not root then
		return false, "Wait until you spawn"
	end

	local price: number
	if fromWizard == true then
		if not item.wizardPrice then
			return false, "The wizard doesn't sell that"
		end
		if not Wizard.isNear(root.Position) then
			return false, "Walk closer to the wizard"
		end
		price = item.wizardPrice
	else
		if not item.price then
			return false, "That isn't sold here"
		end
		price = item.price
	end
	if p.score < price then
		return false, "You need " .. Util.commas(price) .. " score"
	end

	Participants.addScore(p, -price)
	CharacterService.refreshSize(p) -- points are size and speed
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
	CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)

	local finalId = item.id
	if item.rare and rng:NextNumber() < ShopService.rareChance(p) then
		finalId = item.rare
	end
	ItemService.give(p, finalId)
	local final = Items.get(finalId) :: Items.Item
	if finalId ~= item.id then
		Announcer.chat(string.format("* %s rolled a %s! *", p.name, final.name), "F5C542")
		return true, "RARE! You got a " .. final.name .. "!"
	end
	return true, "Bought " .. final.name
end

-- Marks a skin owned (in the session and the saved profile).
function ShopService.grantSkin(p: Participant, skinId: string)
	p.ownedSkins[skinId] = true
	if p.profile then
		p.profile.OwnedSkins[skinId] = true
	end
	Participants.publish(p)
end

function ShopService.equipSkin(p: Participant, skin: Skins.Skin)
	if skin.team == "Zombie" then
		p.zombieSkin = skin.id
		if p.profile then
			p.profile.ZombieSkin = skin.id
		end
	else
		p.humanSkin = skin.id
		if p.profile then
			p.profile.HumanSkin = skin.id
		end
	end
	Participants.publish(p)
	if p.team == skin.team then
		CharacterService.applyLook(p)
		ItemService.refreshHand(p)
	end
end

-- Returns a status the client acts on:
--   "equipped" | "bought" | "prompt" (Robux product) | "promptPass" | "error"
local function buySkin(player: Player, skinId: unknown): (string, string)
	if typeof(skinId) ~= "string" then
		return "error", "Unknown skin"
	end
	local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
	local skin = Skins.get(skinId)
	if not p or not skin then
		return "error", "Unknown skin"
	end
	if skin.pass and p.passes[skin.pass] then
		ShopService.grantSkin(p, skin.id)
	end
	if p.ownedSkins[skin.id] then
		ShopService.equipSkin(p, skin)
		return "equipped", skin.name .. " equipped"
	end
	if skin.scorePrice then
		if p.score < skin.scorePrice then
			return "error", "You need " .. Util.commas(skin.scorePrice) .. " score"
		end
		Participants.addScore(p, -skin.scorePrice)
		CharacterService.refreshSize(p) -- points are size and speed
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
		CharacterService.refreshSpeed(p)
		ShopService.grantSkin(p, skin.id)
		ShopService.equipSkin(p, skin)
		return "bought", "Unlocked " .. skin.name .. "!"
	end
	if skin.product then
		return "prompt", skin.product
	end
	if skin.pass then
		return "promptPass", skin.pass
	end
	return "error", "Not available"
end

function ShopService.init()
	Remotes.func("BuyItem").OnServerInvoke = buyItem
	Remotes.func("BuySkin").OnServerInvoke = buySkin
	Remotes.event("TutorialDone").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		local p = Participants.fromPlayer(player)
		if p and p.profile then
			p.profile.SeenTutorial = true
			p.state:SetAttribute("SeenTutorial", true)
		end
	end)
end

return ShopService

scripts.name: TopScores
scripts.source:
-- All-time top 10 (across servers) for the trophy panel, refreshed every
-- couple of minutes from the OrderedDataStore that DataService updates.

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
