local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local TopScores = {}

local names: { [number]: string } = {}

local function nameOf(userId: number): string
	if names[userId] then
		return names[userId]
	end
	local ok, name = pcall(function()
		return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(userId)
	end)
	if ok and name then
		names[userId] = name
		return name
	end
	return "Player " .. userId
end

local function refresh()
	local rows = {}
	for _, entry in DataService.topScores(10) do
		table.insert(rows, { name = nameOf(entry.userId), score = entry.score })
	end
	local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BrainTagState")
	if state then
		state:SetAttribute("TopScores", HttpService:JSONEncode(rows))
	end
end

function TopScores.start()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			if DataService.isAvailable() then
				refresh()
			end
			task.wait(Config.TOP_SCORES_REFRESH_SECONDS)
		end
	end)
end

return TopScores

scripts.name: Traps
scripts.source:
-- Banana peels: dropped by humans, slippery for zombies. A zombie that steps
-- on one slips: a shove in the way they were walking and a long daze.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Announcer = require(script.Parent.Announcer)
local Combat = require(script.Parent.Combat)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)
local Participants = require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

local Traps = {}

type Trap = { model: Model, position: Vector3, item: Items.Item }

local traps: { Trap } = {}
local folder: Folder
local MAX_TRAPS = 30

local function buildPeel(at: Vector3, spin: number): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "BananaPeel"
	local y = MapLayout.HEIGHTS.Floor + 0.12
	local center = CFrame.new(at.X, y, at.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, spin, 0)
	for i = 0, 2 do
		local arm = center * CFrame.Angles(0, i * math.pi * 2 / 3, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.6)
		Parts.make({
			name = "Peel",
			size = Vector3.new(0.55, 0.12, 1.3),
			cframe = arm,
			color = "F7DC6F",
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = model,
		})
		Parts.make({
			name = "PeelInside",
			size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.13, 1.0),
			cframe = arm * CFrame.new(0, 0.005, 0.05),
			color = "FFF6C7",
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = model,
		})
	end
	Parts.disc("Stem", center.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0), 0.5, 0.2, "8B5A2B", model).CanCollide =
		false
	return model
end

function Traps.place(position: Vector3, item: Items.Item)
	if #traps >= MAX_TRAPS then
		local oldest = table.remove(traps, 1)
		if oldest then
			oldest.model:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local model = buildPeel(position, math.random() * math.pi * 2)
	model.Parent = folder
	table.insert(traps, { model = model, position = Vector3.new(position.X, 0, position.Z), item = item })
end

function Traps.clear()
	for _, trap in traps do
		trap.model:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(traps)
end

local function step()
	if #traps == 0 then
		return
	end
	for _, zombie in Participants.onTeam("Zombie") do
		local root, humanoid = Participants.body(zombie)
		if root and humanoid then
			for i = #traps, 1, -1 do
				local trap = traps[i]
				if Util.flatDistance(root.Position, trap.position) <= 1.4 + root.Size.X / 2 then
					local move = Util.flatUnit(humanoid.MoveDirection)
						or Util.flatUnit(root.CFrame.LookVector)
						or Vector3.xAxis
					Combat.knockback(zombie, move * (trap.item.knockback or 45), trap.item.stun or 1.2)
					Announcer.fx("Slip", { position = trap.position, character = zombie.character })
					trap.model:Destroy()
					table.remove(traps, i)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function Traps.init()
	folder = workspace:WaitForChild("Traps") :: Folder
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step)
end

return Traps

scripts.name: Wizard
scripts.source:
-- The wizard: shows up at a random moment during the prep phase in one of the
-- yards, sells rare items to humans standing within reach (press B near
-- him), and leaves when the outbreak starts.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Announcer = require(script.Parent.Announcer)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local MapLayout = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MapLayout)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

local Wizard = {}

local model: Model? = nil
local scheduleToken = 0
local rng = Random.new()

local function build(at: Vector3): Model
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = "Wizard"
	local function disc(name: string, offset: Vector3, diameter: number, height: number, color: string): Part
		return Parts.disc(name, at + offset, diameter, height, color, m)
	end
	-- Like the original: a blue robe, a big brown pointy hat, a grey beard.
	disc("RobeOutline", Vector3.new(0, 1.95, 0), 4.3, 3.9, "2C5866")
	local robe = disc("Robe", Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), 3.9, 4, "4F8FA3")
	disc("RobeTrim", Vector3.new(0, 4.03, 0), 3.1, 0.06, "6FB0C2")
	disc("HatBrimOutline", Vector3.new(0, 4.55, 0), 3.7, 0.3, "4A2C17")
	disc("HatBrim", Vector3.new(0, 4.6, 0), 3.4, 0.3, "6B4226")
	disc("HatMid", Vector3.new(0, 5.1, 0), 2.2, 0.7, "8B5A2B")
	disc("HatTip", Vector3.new(0, 5.6, 0), 0.9, 0.3, "A0703F")
	disc("Star", Vector3.new(0.5, 5.5, 0.3), 0.5, 0.25, "FFD54A")
	disc("Beard", Vector3.new(0, 4.3, -1.6), 1.4, 0.3, "B8BEC4")
	-- Staff with a glowing orb.
	Parts.make({
		name = "Staff",
		size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, 4.5),
		cframe = CFrame.new(at + Vector3.new(1.9, 4.4, -0.6)),
		color = "8B5A2B",
		canCollide = false,
		parent = m,
	})
	local orb = Parts.make({
		name = "Orb",
		shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
		size = Vector3.one * 1.1,
		cframe = CFrame.new(at + Vector3.new(1.9, 4.7, -3.0)),
		color = "7FE7FF",
		material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		canCollide = false,
		parent = m,
	})
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = Color3.fromHex("7FE7FF")
	light.Range = 10
	light.Brightness = 2
	light.Parent = orb
	m.PrimaryPart = robe

	local tag = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	tag.Name = "NameTag"
	tag.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 44)
	tag.AlwaysOnTop = true
	tag.LightInfluence = 0
	tag.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 2, -4.2)
	tag.Adornee = robe
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansExtraBold
	label.TextSize = 18
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHex("D7B8FF")
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
	label.Text = "Wizard\n[B] special items"
	label.Parent = tag
	tag.Parent = robe
	return m
end

function Wizard.arrive()
	if model then
		return
	end
	local spots = MapLayout.current().wizardSpots
	local spot = spots[rng:NextInteger(1, #spots)]
	local m = build(Vector3.new(spot.x, 0, spot.z))
	m.Parent = workspace
	model = m
	local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BrainTagState")
	if state then
		state:SetAttribute("WizardHere", true)
	end
	Announcer.chat("* The wizard has arrived! Press [B] at wizard to buy special items! *")
end

function Wizard.leave()
	scheduleToken += 1
	if model then
		model:Destroy()
		model = nil
		Announcer.chat("* The wizard vanished in a puff of smoke. *")
	end
	local state = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BrainTagState")
	if state then
		state:SetAttribute("WizardHere", false)
	end
end

-- Arrives after a random delay inside the configured window, unless leave()
-- is called first.
function Wizard.schedule()
	scheduleToken += 1
	local token = scheduleToken
	task.delay(rng:NextNumber(Config.WIZARD_ARRIVE_MIN, Config.WIZARD_ARRIVE_MAX), function()
		if token == scheduleToken then
			Wizard.arrive()
		end
	end)
end

function Wizard.isNear(position: Vector3): boolean
	local current = model
	if not current or not current.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	return Util.flatDistance(current.PrimaryPart.Position, position) <= Config.WIZARD_SHOP_RADIUS
end

return Wizard

scripts.name: WorldSetup
scripts.source:
-- One-time world settings: flat lighting, collision groups, the folders other
-- services fill, and the replicated state folder the HUD reads.

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local WorldSetup = {}

WorldSetup.GROUPS = {
	Characters = "Characters",
	Furniture = "Furniture",
	Shells = "CharacterShells", -- body-sized cylinders that only hit each other
}

local function folder(name: string, parent: Instance): Folder
	local existing = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing:IsA("Folder") then
		return existing
	end
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = name
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end

function WorldSetup.run()
	Players.CharacterAutoLoads = false

	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.Brightness = 1
	Lighting.ClockTime = 12
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0
	Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
	for _, child in Lighting:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Atmosphere") or child:IsA("BloomEffect") or child:IsA("SunRaysEffect") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local groups = WorldSetup.GROUPS
	PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(groups.Characters)
	PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(groups.Furniture)
	PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(groups.Shells)
	-- Root boxes never hit each other; the shells do the bumping, and only
	-- with each other, so a big player's wide shell never snags a doorway.
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(groups.Characters, groups.Characters, false)
	for _, other in { "Default", groups.Characters, groups.Furniture } do
		PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(groups.Shells, other, false)
	end
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(groups.Shells, groups.Shells, Config.PLAYERS_COLLIDE)

	for _, name in { "Map", "Furniture", "GroundItems", "Projectiles", "Traps", "Effects", "Bots" } do
		folder(name, workspace)
	end

	local state = folder("BrainTagState", ReplicatedStorage)
	folder("Participants", state)
	state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Waiting")
	state:SetAttribute("PhaseEndsAt", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("Survivors", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("Zombies", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("Winner", "")
	state:SetAttribute("Round", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("Needed", Config.MIN_PLAYERS)
	state:SetAttribute("WizardHere", false)
	state:SetAttribute("TopScores", "[]")
end

function WorldSetup.state(): Folder
	return ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BrainTagState") :: Folder
end

return WorldSetup

scripts.name: BushController
scripts.source:
-- Hiding in bushes, on your screen: the bush you stand in fades so you can
-- see yourself (and anyone hiding with you), and the name tags of players
-- hiding in other bushes disappear.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Bushes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Bushes)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local BushController = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local INTERVAL = 0.1

local faded: Model? = nil

local function fade(bush: Model?, amount: number)
	if not bush then
		return
	end
	for _, part in bush:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = amount
		end
	end
end

local function characters(): { Instance }
	local list = workspace:GetChildren()
	local bots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Bots")
	if bots then
		for _, bot in bots:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(list, bot)
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function rootOf(model: Instance): BasePart?
	return model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
end

local function step()
	local me = player.Character
	local myRoot = me and rootOf(me)
	local mine = if myRoot then Bushes.coverAt(myRoot.Position) else nil
	if mine ~= faded then
		fade(faded, 0)
		fade(mine, Config.BUSH_SEE_THROUGH)
		faded = mine
	end

	for _, model in characters() do
		if model:IsA("Model") and model:GetAttribute("ParticipantId") and model ~= me then
			local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local tag = head and head:FindFirstChild("NameTag")
			local root = rootOf(model)
			if tag and tag:IsA("BillboardGui") and root then
				local theirs = Bushes.coverAt(root.Position)
				local show = theirs == nil or theirs == mine
				if tag.Enabled ~= show then
					tag.Enabled = show
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function BushController.start()
	local elapsed = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed < INTERVAL then
			return
		end
		elapsed = 0
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			step()
			return true
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[Bushes] " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end)
end

return BushController

scripts.name: CameraController
scripts.source:
-- Straight-down camera that follows your character. A narrow field of view
-- from high up gives the flat, near-orthographic 2D look. Screen up is world
-- -Z. No zoom or rotation (the Settings panel offers three fixed heights).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.ClientState)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local CameraController = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local height = Config.CAMERA_HEIGHT
local focus: Vector3? = nil
local SCREEN_UP = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)

function CameraController.setHeight(newHeight: number)
	height = newHeight
end

function CameraController.height(): number
	return height
end

local function update(dt: number)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return
	end
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	camera.FieldOfView = Config.CAMERA_FOV

	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if root then
		local target = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, 0, root.Position.Z)
		if not focus or Config.CAMERA_SMOOTHING <= 0 or (focus - target).Magnitude > 60 then
			focus = target -- locked on (and snaps after spawns and teleports)
		else
			focus = focus:Lerp(target, 1 - math.exp(-Config.CAMERA_SMOOTHING * dt))
		end
	end
	if focus then
		-- Bigger players see a little more around them.
		local scale = ClientState.my("Scale") or 1
		local eye = height * (1 + (scale - 1) * Config.CAMERA_GROWTH)
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(focus + Vector3.new(0, eye, 0), focus, SCREEN_UP)
	end
end

function CameraController.start()
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("BrainTagCamera", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, update)
end

return CameraController

scripts.name: ChatSetup
scripts.source:
-- TextChatService setup: chat window at the bottom-right (bottom-left and
-- hidden until opened on phones) with channel tabs,
-- yellow system announcements from the server, and a gold [VIP] tag.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.ClientState)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)

local ChatSetup = {}

local function escape(text: string): string
	return (string.gsub(string.gsub(string.gsub(text, "&", "&"), "<", "<"), ">", ">"))
end

function ChatSetup.setVisible(visible: boolean)
	local window = TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatWindowConfiguration")
	local input = TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatInputBarConfiguration")
	if window then
		window.Enabled = visible
	end
	if input then
		input.Enabled = visible
	end
end

function ChatSetup.isVisible(): boolean
	local window = TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatWindowConfiguration")
	return window == nil or window.Enabled
end

function ChatSetup.start()
	local touch = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
	task.spawn(function()
		local window = TextChatService:WaitForChild("ChatWindowConfiguration", 10) :: ChatWindowConfiguration?
		if window then
			-- Desktop: bottom-right (points sit bottom-left). Phones keep the
			-- touch buttons bottom-right, so chat stays left and starts hidden
			-- (the chat button top-left shows it).
			window.HorizontalAlignment = if touch
				then Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left
				else Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
			window.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
			if touch then
				ChatSetup.setVisible(false)
			end
		end
		local tabs = TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChannelTabsConfiguration")
		if tabs then
			tabs.Enabled = true
		end
	end)

	TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = function(message: TextChatMessage)
		local properties = Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")
		local source = message.TextSource
		if source then
			local entry = ClientState.participants:FindFirstChild("P" .. source.UserId)
			if entry and entry:GetAttribute("VIP") then
				properties.PrefixText = string.format(
					'<font color="#%s">[VIP]</font> %s',
					Config.COLORS.VipName,
					message.PrefixText
				)
			end
		end
		return properties
	end

	local general: TextChannel? = nil
	task.spawn(function()
		local channels = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChannels", 20)
		general = channels and channels:WaitForChild("RBXGeneral", 20) :: TextChannel?
	end)

	Remotes.event("Announce").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(text: string, hex: string?)
		if typeof(text) ~= "string" then
			return
		end
		local channel = general
		if channel then
			channel:DisplaySystemMessage(
				string.format('<font color="#%s">%s</font>', hex or Config.COLORS.SystemMessage, escape(text))
			)
		end
	end)
end

return ChatSetup

scripts.name: ClientState
scripts.source:
-- Read-only view of the replicated game state for client code: the round
-- phase and timer, and every participant's public info.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ClientState = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local folder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BrainTagState") :: Folder
local participants = folder:WaitForChild("Participants") :: Folder

ClientState.folder = folder
ClientState.participants = participants

function ClientState.phase(): string
	return (folder:GetAttribute("Phase") :: string?) or "Waiting"
end

function ClientState.secondsLeft(): number
	local endsAt = folder:GetAttribute("PhaseEndsAt")
	if typeof(endsAt) ~= "number" then
		return 0
	end
	return math.max(0, endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
end

function ClientState.attr(name: string): any
	return folder:GetAttribute(name)
end

function ClientState.myId(): string
	return "P" .. player.UserId
end

-- This player's replicated entry (nil until the server finished loading them).
function ClientState.me(): Configuration?
	return participants:FindFirstChild(ClientState.myId()) :: Configuration?
end

function ClientState.my(name: string): any
	local me = ClientState.me()
	return me and me:GetAttribute(name)
end

function ClientState.isZombie(): boolean
	return ClientState.my("Team") == "Zombie"
end

function ClientState.myCharacter(): (Model?, BasePart?, Humanoid?)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return character, root, humanoid
end

function ClientState.owns(listAttr: string, key: string): boolean
	local raw = ClientState.my(listAttr)
	if typeof(raw) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end
	for entry in string.gmatch(raw, "[^,]+") do
		if entry == key then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

export type Row = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	score: number,
	team: string,
	isMe: boolean,
	isBot: boolean,
	vip: boolean,
}

function ClientState.rows(): { Row }
	local rows = {}
	local myId = ClientState.myId()
	for _, entry in participants:GetChildren() do
		table.insert(rows, {
			id = entry.Name,
			name = (entry:GetAttribute("DisplayName") :: string?) or entry.Name,
			score = (entry:GetAttribute("Score") :: number?) or 0,
			team = (entry:GetAttribute("Team") :: string?) or "Human",
			isMe = entry.Name == myId,
			isBot = entry:GetAttribute("IsBot") == true,
			vip = entry:GetAttribute("VIP") == true,
		})
	end
	table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
		if a.score == b.score then
			return a.name < b.name
		end
		return a.score > b.score
	end)
	return rows
end

return ClientState

scripts.name: Effects
scripts.source:
-- Plays what the server announces: your own knockback, item swings, potato
-- splats, shotgun blasts, wall debris, infection bursts and sounds.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Knockback = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Knockback)
local Parts = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Parts)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local Sounds = require(script.Parent.Sounds)

local Effects = {}

local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local ItemModels = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.ItemModels)

-- Funny sounds made from the few sounds that ship with every Roblox client,
-- pitched up or down: { sound name in Config.SOUNDS, pitch, volume }.
local SOUND_STYLES: { [string]: { any } } = {
	Squeak = { "RoundEnd", 2.4, 0.6 },
	Clang = { "RoundEnd", 0.55, 0.9 },
	Boing = { "Lunge", 0.45, 0.9 },
	Pop = { "RoundEnd", 3.2, 0.6 },
	Swish = { "Whoosh", 1.5, 0.5 },
	Twang = { "Lunge", 1.8, 0.6 },
	Gulp = { "Pickup", 0.7, 0.6 },
	Slip = { "Whoosh", 0.6, 0.8 },
	Bump = { "Lunge", 0.35, 0.35 },
}

local function playStyle(style: string?, position: Vector3?): boolean
	local entry = style and SOUND_STYLES[style]
	if not entry then
		return false
	end
	Sounds.play(entry[1], position, entry[3], entry[2])
	return true
end

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local effectsFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("Effects")

local baseGrip: { [Weld]: CFrame } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any

local function fadeAndRemove(part: BasePart, seconds: number, grow: Vector3?)
	local goal: { [string]: any } = { Transparency = 1 }
	if grow then
		goal.Size = grow
	end
	local tween = TweenService:Create(
		part,
		TweenInfo.new(seconds, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		goal
	)
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Once(function()
		part:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function flatPart(position: Vector3, diameter: number, color: string): Part
	local part = Parts.disc("Fx", position, diameter, 0.1, color, effectsFolder)
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	return part
end

-- Swings the held item around its grip (or thrusts a spear).
local function swing(character: Model?, itemId: string)
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local held = character:FindFirstChild("HeldItem")
	local handle = held and held:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	local weld = handle and handle:FindFirstChild("GripWeld") :: Weld?
	if not weld then
		return
	end
	local base = baseGrip[weld] or weld.C0
	baseGrip[weld] = base
	local thrust = itemId == "Spear" or itemId == "AncientSpear"
	local started = os.clock()
	local duration = if thrust then 0.22 else 0.28
	local connection: RBXScriptConnection
	connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local t = (os.clock() - started) / duration
		if t >= 1 or weld.Parent == nil then
			connection:Disconnect()
			if weld.Parent then
				weld.C0 = base
			end
			return
		end
		if thrust then
			local push = math.sin(t * math.pi) * 2.2
			weld.C0 = base * CFrame.new(0, 0, -push)
		else
			-- Sweep from the right side across to the left, then settle.
			local angle = if t < 0.6
				then math.rad(70) - (t / 0.6) * math.rad(130)
				else math.rad(-60) * (1 - (t - 0.6) / 0.4)
			weld.C0 = base * CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0)
		end
	end)
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local item = Items.get(itemId)
	if not playStyle(item and item.sound, root and root.Position) then
		Sounds.play(if thrust then "Lunge" else "Whoosh", root and root.Position)
	end
end

-- Little bits flying out from a point and fading (stars, feathers, crumbs...).
local BITS: { [string]: { colors: { string }, size: number, count: number, shape: Enum.PartType } } = {
	Stars = { colors = { "FFE14D", "FFFFFF", "FFC21A" }, size = 0.5, count = 6, shape = Enum.PartType.Block },
	Puff = { colors = { "FFFFFF", "EDEDED" }, size = 0.45, count = 4, shape = Enum.PartType.Ball },
	Feathers = {
		colors = { "FFFFFF", "FFF3B0", "FFE14D" },
		size = 0.45,
		count = 8,
		shape = Enum.PartType.Block,
	},
	Crumbs = { colors = { "D9A15C", "B5783A", "E8C28A" }, size = 0.3, count = 10, shape = Enum.PartType.Ball },
	Sparkle = {
		colors = { "FF5FA2", "7FD3FF", "FFFFFF", "FFE14D" },
		size = 0.35,
		count = 8,
		shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
	},
	Confetti = {
		colors = { "E5484D", "F1C40F", "2ECC71", "3498DB", "9B59B6", "FF5FA2" },
		size = 0.35,
		count = 30,
		shape = Enum.PartType.Block,
	},
	Snow = { colors = { "FFFFFF", "E8F6FF" }, size = 0.35, count = 10, shape = Enum.PartType.Ball },
	Peel = { colors = { "F7DC6F", "FFFFFF", "FFE14D" }, size = 0.4, count = 7, shape = Enum.PartType.Block },
}

local function bits(kind: string, position: Vector3, direction: Vector3?, spread: number?)
	local spec = BITS[kind]
	if not spec then
		return
	end
	local rng = Random.new()
	for i = 1, spec.count do
		local part = Parts.make({
			name = "Bit",
			shape = spec.shape,
			size = Vector3.new(spec.size, 0.08, spec.size)
				* (if spec.shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then 1 else 1),
			cframe = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
				* CFrame.Angles(0, rng:NextNumber(0, 6.28), 0),
			color = spec.colors[(i - 1) % #spec.colors + 1],
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = effectsFolder,
		})
		if spec.shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then
			part.Size = Vector3.one * spec.size
		end
		local dir: Vector3
		if direction then
			local cone = spread or 0.6
			dir = (CFrame.Angles(0, rng:NextNumber(-cone, cone), 0) * direction) * rng:NextNumber(14, 34)
		else
			local a = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
			dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(a), 0, math.sin(a)) * rng:NextNumber(6, 14)
		end
		local finish = position + Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z) * 0.35
		local info = TweenInfo.new(rng:NextNumber(0.4, 0.8), Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local tween = TweenService:Create(part, info, {
			CFrame = CFrame.new(finish + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, rng:NextNumber(0, 6.28), 0),
			Transparency = 1,
		})
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Once(function()
			part:Destroy()
		end)
	end
end

-- A temporary visual stuck to a character (plunger, bubble, ice).
local function stickTo(character: Model?, seconds: number, build: (root: BasePart) -> { BasePart })
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local parts = build(root)
	for _, part in parts do
		part.Anchored = false
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.Massless = true
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = root
		weld.Part1 = part
		weld.Parent = part
		part.Parent = character
	end
	task.delay(seconds, function()
		for _, part in parts do
			part:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

local function bodyScale(root: BasePart): number
	return root.Size.X / 2.2
end

-- Spray particles on everyone currently holding a water gun / leaf blower.
local SPRAY_COLORS = {
	WaterGun = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromHex("8FD3F5"), Color3.fromHex("E8F6FF")),
	LeafBlower = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromHex("6BBF4E")),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromHex("E8913A")),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHex("C0392B")),
	}),
}

local function characters(): { Instance }
	local list = workspace:GetChildren()
	local bots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Bots")
	if bots then
		for _, bot in bots:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(list, bot)
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function updateSprays()
	for _, character in characters() do
		if character:IsA("Model") and character:GetAttribute("ParticipantId") then
			local spraying = character:GetAttribute("Spraying")
			local held = character:FindFirstChild("HeldItem")
			local handle = held and held:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if handle then
				local emitter = handle:FindFirstChild("Spray", true) :: ParticleEmitter?
				if spraying and not emitter then
					local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
					attachment.Name = "SprayAt"
					attachment.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, -4.3)
					attachment.Parent = handle
					local created = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
					created.Name = "Spray"
					created.Color = SPRAY_COLORS[spraying] or SPRAY_COLORS.WaterGun
					created.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front
					created.Speed = NumberRange.new(28, 40)
					created.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(if spraying == "LeafBlower" then 18 else 6, 4)
					created.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.5)
					created.Rate = 70
					created.Size = NumberSequence.new(if spraying == "LeafBlower" then 0.9 else 0.6, 0.2)
					created.LightEmission = 0.2
					created.Parent = attachment
					emitter = created
				end
				if emitter then
					emitter.Enabled = spraying ~= nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function blast(origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, reach: number)
	for _, angle in { -0.3, -0.15, 0, 0.15, 0.3 } do
		local dir = CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0) * direction
		local mid = origin + dir * (reach / 2)
		local tracer = Parts.make({
			name = "Pellet",
			size = Vector3.new(0.25, 0.25, reach),
			cframe = CFrame.lookAt(mid, mid + dir),
			color = "FFE36E",
			material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = effectsFolder,
		})
		fadeAndRemove(tracer, 0.18)
	end
	local flash = flatPart(origin + direction * 2 + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), 3, "FFF3B0")
	flash.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	fadeAndRemove(flash, 0.15, flash.Size * 1.6)
	Sounds.play("Shotgun", origin, 0.8)
end

local function debris(cframe: CFrame, size: Vector3)
	local rng = Random.new()
	for _ = 1, 8 do
		local offset = Vector3.new(
			rng:NextNumber(-size.X / 2, size.X / 2),
			rng:NextNumber(-1, 3),
			rng:NextNumber(-size.Z / 2, size.Z / 2)
		)
		local chunk = Parts.make({
			name = "Debris",
			size = Vector3.one * rng:NextNumber(0.8, 1.8),
			cframe = cframe * CFrame.new(offset),
			color = "4A4A4A",
			anchored = false,
			canCollide = false,
			canQuery = false,
			parent = effectsFolder,
		})
		chunk.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
			Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-25, 25), rng:NextNumber(20, 40), rng:NextNumber(-25, 25))
		task.delay(1.2, function()
			chunk:Destroy()
		end)
	end
end

local function burst(position: Vector3, color: string, size: number)
	local ring = flatPart(Vector3.new(position.X, 0.6, position.Z), 2, color)
	ring.Transparency = 0.2
	fadeAndRemove(ring, 0.45, Vector3.new(0.1, size, size))
end

local HANDLERS: { [string]: (data: { [string]: any }) -> () } = {
	Swing = function(data)
		swing(data.character, data.item)
	end,
	Shoot = function(data)
		local character = data.character :: Model?
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		Sounds.play("Potato", root and root.Position)
	end,
	Splat = function(data)
		local look = data.look
		if look == "Snowball" then
			bits("Snow", data.position)
		elseif look == "Bubble" then
			burst(data.position, "BFE9FF", 5)
			playStyle("Pop", data.position)
		elseif look == "Pebble" then
			burst(data.position, "8C8C8C", 2.5)
		else
			burst(data.position, "C9A66B", 4)
		end
	end,
	Blast = function(data)
		if data.item == "ConfettiCannon" then
			bits("Confetti", data.origin, data.direction, 0.6)
			playStyle("Pop", data.origin)
			playStyle("Squeak", data.origin)
		else
			blast(data.origin, data.direction, data.reach)
		end
	end,
	Hit = function(data)
		bits(data.fx, data.position)
	end,
	Plunged = function(data)
		stickTo(data.character, data.seconds, function(root)
			local s = bodyScale(root)
			local plunger = ItemModels.build("Plunger")
			-- Cup on the face, stick pointing straight out the front.
			plunger:PivotTo(
				root.CFrame
					* CFrame.new(0, 1.2 * s, -1.0 * s)
					* CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)
					* CFrame.new(0, 0, 3.4)
			)
			local parts = {}
			for _, part in plunger:GetDescendants() do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "Handle" then
					for _, weld in part:GetChildren() do
						if weld:IsA("Weld") then
							weld:Destroy()
						end
					end
					table.insert(parts, part)
				end
			end
			return parts
		end)
	end,
	Bubbled = function(data)
		local character = data.character :: Model?
		stickTo(character, data.seconds, function(root)
			local s = bodyScale(root)
			local bubble = Parts.make({
				name = "Bubble",
				shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
				size = Vector3.one * 5.2 * s,
				cframe = root.CFrame,
				color = "BFE9FF",
				transparency = 0.6,
			})
			local shine = Parts.make({
				name = "Shine",
				shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
				size = Vector3.one * 1.1 * s,
				cframe = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(-1.2 * s, 1.9 * s, -1.0 * s),
				color = "FFFFFF",
				transparency = 0.3,
			})
			return { bubble, shine }
		end)
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		if root then
			task.delay(data.seconds, function()
				burst(root.Position, "BFE9FF", 7)
				playStyle("Pop", root.Position)
			end)
		end
	end,
	Frozen = function(data)
		local character = data.character :: Model?
		if not character then
			return
		end
		local ice = Instance.new("Highlight")
		ice.FillColor = Color3.fromHex("9FE3FF")
		ice.FillTransparency = 0.45
		ice.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		ice.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
		ice.Parent = character
		task.delay(data.seconds, function()
			ice:Destroy()
		end)
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		if root then
			bits("Snow", root.Position)
		end
	end,
	Slip = function(data)
		bits("Peel", data.position)
		bits("Stars", data.position)
		playStyle("Slip", data.position)
	end,
	Drop = function(data)
		Sounds.play("Pickup", data.position, 0.4, 0.8)
	end,
	Gulp = function(data)
		bits("Sparkle", data.position)
		playStyle("Gulp", data.position)
	end,
	Boom = function(data)
		bits("Feathers", data.position)
		burst(data.position, "FFD93B", 16)
		playStyle("Squeak", data.position)
	end,
	WallBreak = function(data)
		debris(data.cframe, data.size)
	end,
	Infect = function(data)
		burst(data.position, "7BC043", 10)
		Sounds.play("Groan", data.position, 0.8)
	end,
	Eat = function(data)
		burst(data.position, "F4F4F4", 4)
		Sounds.play("Pickup", data.position, 0.5, 1.4)
	end,
	Pickup = function(data)
		Sounds.play("Pickup", data.position, 0.5)
	end,
	Outbreak = function()
		Sounds.play("Groan", nil, 0.7, 0.8)
	end,
	RoundEnd = function()
		Sounds.play("RoundEnd", nil, 0.7)
	end,
}

-- Furniture scrape loop (only if Config.SOUNDS.Scrape is set).
local function startScrape()
	local loop = Sounds.loop("Scrape")
	if not loop then
		return
	end
	local furniture = workspace:WaitForChild("Furniture")
	local playing = false
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.15)
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
			local moving = false
			if root and Sounds.enabled() then
				for _, model in furniture:GetChildren() do
					local body = model:FindFirstChild("Body") :: BasePart?
					if body and not body.Anchored and body.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 2 then
						if (body.Position - root.Position).Magnitude < 40 then
							moving = true
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end
			if moving and not playing then
				loop.Volume = 0.35
				loop:Play()
				playing = true
			elseif not moving and playing then
				loop:Stop()
				playing = false
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Bumping into another character: a soft thud and a little puff where you
-- touched, so collisions read clearly. Your character's "Shell" is the
-- body-sized cylinder only other characters collide with.
local BUMP_COOLDOWN = 0.4
local lastBump = 0

local function watchShell(character: Model)
	local function hook(shell: Instance)
		if not shell:IsA("BasePart") or shell.Name ~= "Shell" then
			return
		end
		shell.Touched:Connect(function(other)
			if other.Name ~= "Shell" or other:IsDescendantOf(character) then
				return
			end
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastBump < BUMP_COOLDOWN then
				return
			end
			lastBump = now
			local between = (shell.Position + other.Position) / 2
			playStyle("Bump", between)
			bits("Puff", between)
		end)
	end
	character.ChildAdded:Connect(hook)
	for _, child in character:GetChildren() do
		hook(child)
	end
end

function Effects.start()
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchShell)
	if player.Character then
		watchShell(player.Character)
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.1)
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				updateSprays()
				return true
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn("[Fx] spray: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end)
	Remotes.event("Knockback").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(velocity: Vector3, seconds: number)
		local character = player.Character
		if character and typeof(velocity) == "Vector3" then
			Knockback.apply(character, velocity, seconds)
		end
	end)
	Remotes.event("Fx").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind: string, data: { [string]: any })
		local handler = HANDLERS[kind]
		if handler then
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				handler(data or {})
				return true
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn("[Fx] " .. kind .. ": " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end)
	startScrape()
end

return Effects

scripts.name: FurnitureController
scripts.source:
-- Drives the furniture YOU are pushing, on your own machine, so it responds
-- instantly and stops the moment you stop. The server hands you a piece when
-- you claim it and takes it back if someone else pushes it too.
--
-- You move furniture by walking into it, by walking with a weapon whose
-- shaft touches it, or by holding click with a weapon to hook the nearest
-- piece and drag it toward you.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CharacterLook = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CharacterLook)
local ClientState = require(script.Parent.ClientState)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local FurniturePush = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.FurniturePush)
local InputController = require(script.Parent.InputController)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local MovementController = require(script.Parent.MovementController)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local RoundRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoundRules)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

local FurnitureController = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local OWNER = FurniturePush.OWNER_ATTRIBUTE
local CLAIM_INTERVAL = 0.1

local folder: Instance
local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
local claimRemote: UnreliableRemoteEvent
local owned: { [BasePart]: boolean } = {}
local pendingClaims: { [Instance]: boolean } = {}
local lastClaim = 0

local function track(model: Instance)
	if not model:IsA("Model") then
		return
	end
	local body = model:WaitForChild("Body", 10) :: BasePart?
	if not body then
		return
	end
	local function refresh()
		if model:GetAttribute(OWNER) == player.UserId and model.Parent == folder then
			owned[body] = true
		else
			owned[body] = nil
		end
	end
	model:GetAttributeChangedSignal(OWNER):Connect(refresh)
	model.AncestryChanged:Connect(refresh)
	refresh()
end

local function query(cframe: CFrame, size: Vector3): { BasePart }
	local found = {}
	for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cframe, size, overlap) do
		if part.Name == "Body" and not part.Anchored then
			table.insert(found, part)
		end
	end
	return found
end

local function collect(): FurniturePush.Pushes
	local pushes: FurniturePush.Pushes = {}
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return pushes
	end
	local scale = ClientState.my("Scale") or 1
	local strength = RoundRules.pushStrength(scale)
	local walk = humanoid.WalkSpeed
	local move = Vector3.new(humanoid.MoveDirection.X, 0, humanoid.MoveDirection.Z)
	local moving = move.Magnitude > 0.1 and walk > 0
	local dir = if moving then move.Unit else Vector3.zero

	-- Walking into furniture.
	if moving then
		local probe, size = FurniturePush.moverProbe(root, dir, scale)
		for _, body in query(probe, size) do
			FurniturePush.add(pushes, body, dir * walk, strength, probe.Position)
		end
	end

	-- Weapons: the shaft pushes what it touches; holding click hooks and drags.
	local item = Items.get(ClientState.my("HeldItem"))
	if item and item.kind == "Melee" and not ClientState.isZombie() then
		local aim = MovementController.aim()
		local reach = (item.reach or 5) * math.max(1, scale * 0.9)
		local grip = CharacterLook.grip(scale)
		local hand = (root.CFrame * grip).Position
		local probe, size = FurniturePush.itemProbe(root, grip, aim, reach, item.guard)
		local touched = query(probe, size)
		local firm = strength * (item.firmness or 1) -- a stiff bat shoves harder than a noodle
		local using = InputController.isUsing()
		if using and walk > 0 then
			local nearest: BasePart? = nil
			local best = math.huge
			for _, body in touched do
				local d = Util.flatDistance(body.Position, root.Position)
				if d < best then
					nearest, best = body, d
				end
			end
			if nearest then
				local toward = Util.flatUnit(root.Position - nearest.Position)
				local gap = FurniturePush.extent(nearest, toward or aim) + root.Size.X / 2 + 0.6
				if toward and best > gap then
					local hook = if item.dragsFurniture then 1.5 else 1
					FurniturePush.add(
						pushes,
						nearest,
						toward * walk * Config.ITEM_DRAG_FACTOR,
						strength * hook,
						nil
					)
				end
			end
		end
		-- The shaft is solid: what it overlaps moves out of the way (not while
		-- hooking with held click, where the drag does the work, like the server).
		if walk > 0 and not using then
			for _, body in touched do
				if not pushes[body] then
					if moving then
						FurniturePush.add(pushes, body, dir * walk, firm, body.Position + aim * 0.5)
					else
						local exit = FurniturePush.shaftExit(hand, aim, body)
						FurniturePush.add(
							pushes,
							body,
							exit * walk * Config.SHAFT_FURNITURE_FACTOR,
							firm,
							nil
						)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- A piece you drive pushes whatever it runs into, so you can shove a line.
	for body, push in table.clone(pushes) do
		if owned[body] then
			local velocity = FurniturePush.resolve(body, push)
			local ahead = Util.flatUnit(velocity)
			if ahead and velocity.Magnitude > 0.5 then
				local reachAhead = FurniturePush.extent(body, ahead)
				local center = body.Position + ahead * (reachAhead + 0.6)
				local side = Vector3.new(-ahead.Z, 0, ahead.X)
				local width = FurniturePush.extent(body, side) * 2 * 0.9
				local probe = CFrame.lookAt(center, center + ahead)
				for _, other in query(probe, Vector3.new(width, 2, 1.2)) do
					if other ~= body and not pushes[other] then
						FurniturePush.add(pushes, other, velocity, push.strength, center)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return pushes
end

local function step()
	local pushes = collect()

	-- Ask the server for anything we're pushing.
	for body in pushes do
		local model = body.Parent
		if model then
			pendingClaims[model] = true
		end
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if next(pendingClaims) and now - lastClaim >= CLAIM_INTERVAL then
		local list = {}
		for model in pendingClaims do
			table.insert(list, model)
			if #list >= 16 then
				break
			end
		end
		table.clear(pendingClaims)
		lastClaim = now
		claimRemote:FireServer(list)
	end

	-- Drive the pieces the server gave us. Unpushed ones stand still.
	for body in owned do
		if body.Parent == nil then
			owned[body] = nil
			continue
		end
		local v = body.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local push = pushes[body]
		if push then
			local velocity, spin = FurniturePush.resolve(body, push)
			body.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, math.min(v.Y, 0), velocity.Z)
			body.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, spin, 0)
		elseif math.abs(v.X) + math.abs(v.Z) > 0.02 or body.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > 0.02 then
			body.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.min(v.Y, 0), 0)
			body.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end
end

function FurnitureController.start()
	folder = workspace:WaitForChild("Furniture")
	overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = { folder }
	claimRemote = Remotes.unreliable("PushClaim")
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		task.spawn(track, child)
	end)
	for _, child in folder:GetChildren() do
		task.spawn(track, child)
	end
	-- Before physics, so the velocities we set are used this very frame.
	RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(step)
end

return FurnitureController

scripts.name: InputController
scripts.source:
-- Keyboard, mouse and gamepad actions. Touch buttons call the same functions.
--   Left click / R2: use item (hold for the swordfish drag)
--   E / X: pick up      G / B: drop      B / Y: shop      Z / L1: zombie return

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local MovementController = require(script.Parent.MovementController)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)

local InputController = {}

local useRemote = Remotes.event("UseItem")
local pickRemote = Remotes.event("PickUp")
local dropRemote = Remotes.event("DropItem")
local returnRemote = Remotes.event("ZombieReturn")

-- Set by the HUD.
InputController.onShop = function() end
InputController.isMenuOpen = function(): boolean
	return false
end

local using = false

function InputController.useStart()
	using = true
	useRemote:FireServer("start", MovementController.aim())
end

-- True while the use button is held (hooking furniture with a weapon).
function InputController.isUsing(): boolean
	return using
end

function InputController.useStop()
	if using then
		using = false
		useRemote:FireServer("stop", MovementController.aim())
	end
end

function InputController.pickUp()
	pickRemote:FireServer()
end

function InputController.drop()
	dropRemote:FireServer()
end

function InputController.zombieReturn()
	returnRemote:FireServer()
end

function InputController.shop()
	InputController.onShop()
end

local BEGIN: { [Enum.KeyCode]: () -> () } = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.E] = InputController.pickUp,
	[Enum.KeyCode.G] = InputController.drop,
	[Enum.KeyCode.B] = InputController.shop,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Z] = InputController.zombieReturn,
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX] = InputController.pickUp,
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB] = InputController.drop,
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY] = InputController.shop,
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1] = InputController.zombieReturn,
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2] = InputController.useStart,
}

function InputController.start()
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			if not InputController.isMenuOpen() then
				InputController.useStart()
			end
			return
		end
		local action = BEGIN[input.KeyCode]
		if action then
			action()
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2
		then
			InputController.useStop()
		end
	end)
end

return InputController
