scripts.name: MovementController
scripts.source:
-- Moves the character in SCREEN directions (W = up the screen = world -Z)
-- and turns it to face the mouse. On touch screens and gamepads, where there
-- is no mouse, the character faces the way it walks instead.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local MovementController = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local aim = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
local usingMouse = not UserInputService.TouchEnabled or UserInputService.MouseEnabled
local controls: any = nil
local aimRemote: UnreliableRemoteEvent? = nil
local lastAimSent = 0
local lastAimSentValue = Vector3.zero

local KEYS: { [Enum.KeyCode]: Vector3 } = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.W] = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
	[Enum.KeyCode.Up] = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
	[Enum.KeyCode.S] = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
	[Enum.KeyCode.Down] = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
	[Enum.KeyCode.A] = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0),
	[Enum.KeyCode.Left] = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0),
	[Enum.KeyCode.D] = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0),
	[Enum.KeyCode.Right] = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0),
}

local MOUSE_INPUTS = {
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement] = true,
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1] = true,
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2] = true,
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel] = true,
	[Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard] = true,
}

function MovementController.aim(): Vector3
	return aim
end

function MovementController.usingMouse(): boolean
	return usingMouse
end

local function rawMove(): Vector3
	local v = Vector3.zero
	-- Thumbsticks and gamepads come from Roblox's PlayerModule. Its vector is
	-- already in screen terms: -Z means "up the screen".
	if controls then
		local ok, mv = pcall(function()
			return controls:GetMoveVector()
		end)
		if ok and typeof(mv) == "Vector3" then
			v += mv
		end
	end
	if not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
		-- Read keys directly too, so arrows always work. Counting a key twice
		-- is harmless because the result is normalized below.
		for key, direction in KEYS do
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(key) then
				v += direction
			end
		end
	end
	v = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
	if v.Magnitude > 1 then
		v = v.Unit
	end
	return v
end

local function step()
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false

	local move = rawMove()
	humanoid:Move(move, false) -- false = world space, not camera space

	-- Sharp, like the original: full speed the instant a key goes down, a dead
	-- stop the instant it comes up (a Humanoid alone eases in and out). Left
	-- alone while a knockback shove is playing.
	if not root:FindFirstChild("KnockbackForce") then
		local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local speed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(move.X * speed, v.Y, move.Z * speed)
	end

	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if usingMouse and camera then
		local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
		if math.abs(ray.Direction.Y) > 1e-3 then
			local t = (root.Position.Y - ray.Origin.Y) / ray.Direction.Y
			local point = ray.Origin + ray.Direction * t
			local flat = Vector3.new(point.X - root.Position.X, 0, point.Z - root.Position.Z)
			if flat.Magnitude > 0.5 then
				aim = flat.Unit
			end
		end
	elseif move.Magnitude > 0.1 then
		aim = move.Unit
	end
	root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + aim)

	-- Keep the server's idea of your aim fresh (weapon pushes and drags use it).
	local now = os.clock()
	if aimRemote and now - lastAimSent > 0.1 and aim:Dot(lastAimSentValue) < 0.995 then
		lastAimSent, lastAimSentValue = now, aim
		aimRemote:FireServer(aim)
	end
end

local function onCharacter(character: Model)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10) :: Humanoid?
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	for _, state in
		{
			Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping,
			Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing,
			Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,
			Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll,
			Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,
			Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming,
		}
	do
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(state, false)
	end
end

function MovementController.start()
	task.spawn(function()
		local Remotes = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Remotes)
		aimRemote = Remotes.unreliable("Aim")
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, module = pcall(function()
			return require(
					player:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("PlayerModule") :: ModuleScript
				) :: any
		end)
		if ok and module then
			controls = module:GetControls()
		else
			warn("[Movement] PlayerModule unavailable; keyboard only")
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(function(inputType)
		if MOUSE_INPUTS[inputType] then
			usingMouse = true
		elseif inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or string.find(inputType.Name, "Gamepad") then
			usingMouse = false
		end
	end)

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(onCharacter, player.Character)
	end

	-- Runs right after Roblox's own control script (priority Input), so our
	-- world-space move wins.
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("BrainTagMove", Enum.RenderPriority.Input.Value + 1, step)
end

return MovementController

scripts.name: Sounds
scripts.source:
-- Plays short 2D sounds, quieter the farther they happen from you (the
-- camera is far overhead, so normal 3D falloff would make everything silent).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local Sounds = {}

local enabled = true
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local HEARING = 90

function Sounds.setEnabled(on: boolean)
	enabled = on
end

function Sounds.enabled(): boolean
	return enabled
end

local function listener(): Vector3?
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	return root and root.Position
end

function Sounds.play(name: string, position: Vector3?, volume: number?, pitch: number?)
	if not enabled then
		return
	end
	local id = (Config.SOUNDS :: { [string]: string })[name]
	if not id or id == "" then
		return
	end
	local v = volume or 0.6
	if position then
		local here = listener()
		if here then
			local dx, dz = position.X - here.X, position.Z - here.Z
			v *= math.clamp(1 - math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) / HEARING, 0, 1)
		end
		if v < 0.03 then
			return
		end
	end
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = id
	sound.Volume = v
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = pitch or 1
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	sound:Play()
	sound.Ended:Once(function()
		sound:Destroy()
	end)
	task.delay(8, function()
		if sound.Parent then
			sound:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

-- A looping sound you can switch on and off (furniture scraping).
function Sounds.loop(name: string): Sound?
	local id = (Config.SOUNDS :: { [string]: string })[name]
	if not id or id == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = id
	sound.Looped = true
	sound.Volume = 0
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	return sound
end

return Sounds

scripts.name: AdminPanel
scripts.source:
-- The admin panel (F2, or the ADMIN button on the left). Only shown to
-- admins; the server checks every request again (see AdminService).
--   Target: one player or everyone
--   Items:  give any item (or drop it in front of you)
--   Speed, points, immunity, team, bring / go to / respawn
--   Round:  skip phase, add time, next map, reset furniture, clear items

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)

local AdminPanel = {}

local GRAY = Color3.fromRGB(70, 72, 78)
local ADMIN_RED = Color3.fromRGB(196, 54, 54)

export type Panel = {
	open: () -> (),
	close: () -> (),
	isOpen: () -> boolean,
	update: () -> (),
}

-- Every item: the shop's order, then the wizard's, then anything else.
local function itemIds(): { string }
	local list, seen = {}, {}
	for _, group in { Items.shopOrder, Items.wizardOrder } do
		for _, id in group do
			if not seen[id] and Items.get(id) then
				seen[id] = true
				table.insert(list, id)
			end
		end
	end
	local rest = {}
	for id in Items.all do
		if not seen[id] then
			table.insert(rest, id)
		end
	end
	table.sort(rest)
	for _, id in rest do
		table.insert(list, id)
	end
	return list
end

function AdminPanel.build(parent: Instance, toast: (string, string?) -> ()): Panel
	local remote = Remotes.func("Admin")
	local window, content = UIKit.modal(parent, "Admin", 660, 600, function() end)

	local scroll = UIKit.new("ScrollingFrame", {
		Name = "Scroll",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -28),
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ScrollBarThickness = 6,
		ZIndex = 21,
		Parent = content,
	}, { UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 6) })
	local status = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Status",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
		TextSize = 16,
		TextColor3 = UIKit.MUTED,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Text = "Pick a target, then a command.",
		ZIndex = 21,
		Parent = content,
	})

	local order = 0
	local function nextOrder(): number
		order += 1
		return order
	end

	local function heading(text: string)
		UIKit.label({
			Text = text,
			LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
			TextSize = 18,
			Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
			TextColor3 = UIKit.GOLD,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			ZIndex = 21,
			Parent = scroll,
		})
	end

	-- A wrapping row of buttons.
	local function row(height: number?): Frame
		return UIKit.new("Frame", {
			LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			ZIndex = 21,
			Parent = scroll,
		}, {
			UIKit.new("UIGridLayout", {
				CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(118, height or 32),
				CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6),
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			}),
		})
	end

	local function button(parentRow: Frame, text: string, color: Color3?, onClick: () -> ()): TextButton
		return UIKit.button({
			Text = text,
			TextSize = 15,
			TextWrapped = true,
			BackgroundColor3 = color or UIKit.ACCENT,
			ZIndex = 22,
			Parent = parentRow,
		}, onClick)
	end

	-- Target picker --------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local target = ClientState.myId()
	local targetRow: Frame
	local function send(action: string, data: { [string]: any }?)
		local args: { [string]: any } = data or {}
		args.target = target
		status.Text = "..."
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, success, message = pcall(function()
				return remote:InvokeServer(action, args)
			end)
			local text = if ok then tostring(message) else "Couldn't reach the server"
			status.Text = text
			status.TextColor3 = if ok and success then UIKit.GOOD else UIKit.RED
			if ok and success then
				toast(text)
			end
		end)
	end

	heading("Target")
	targetRow = row(30)
	local function refreshTargets()
		for _, child in targetRow:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local entries = { { id = "*", name = "Everyone" } }
		for _, r in ClientState.rows() do
			table.insert(entries, { id = r.id, name = (if r.isMe then "Me: " else "") .. r.name })
		end
		local stillThere = false
		for _, entry in entries do
			stillThere = stillThere or entry.id == target
		end
		if not stillThere then
			target = ClientState.myId()
		end
		for i, entry in entries do
			local b = button(
				targetRow,
				entry.name,
				if entry.id == target then UIKit.GOOD else GRAY,
				function()
					target = entry.id
					refreshTargets()
				end
			)
			b.LayoutOrder = i
		end
	end

	-- Items -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	heading("Give item (click)")
	local toGround = false
	local modeRow = row(30)
	local modeButton: TextButton
	modeButton = button(modeRow, "To: their hand", GRAY, function()
		toGround = not toGround
		modeButton.Text = if toGround then "To: ground near me" else "To: their hand"
	end)
	local itemRow = row(30)
	for i, id in itemIds() do
		local item = Items.get(id)
		if item then
			local b = button(itemRow, item.name, nil, function()
				send("give", { item = id, ground = toGround })
			end)
			b.LayoutOrder = i
		end
	end

	-- Speed ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	heading("Speed")
	local speedRow = row()
	for _, factor in { 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3 } do
		local label = if factor == 0 then "Freeze" elseif factor == 1 then "Normal (1x)" else factor .. "x"
		button(speedRow, label, if factor < 1 then GRAY else nil, function()
			send("speed", { factor = factor })
		end)
	end

	-- Points --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	heading("Points (size and speed follow points)")
	local pointsRow = row()
	for _, amount in { 1000, 10000, 100000, -1000 } do
		button(pointsRow, string.format("%+d", amount), if amount < 0 then GRAY else nil, function()
			send("points", { add = amount })
		end)
	end
	button(pointsRow, "Set to 0", ADMIN_RED, function()
		send("points", { set = 0 })
	end)

	-- Player --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	heading("Player")
	local playerRow = row()
	button(playerRow, "Make human", nil, function()
		send("team", { team = "Human" })
	end)
	button(playerRow, "Make zombie", ADMIN_RED, function()
		send("team", { team = "Zombie" })
	end)
	button(playerRow, "Immunity 100", nil, function()
		send("immunity", { value = 100 })
	end)
	button(playerRow, "Bring to me", nil, function()
		send("bring")
	end)
	button(playerRow, "Go to", nil, function()
		send("goTo")
	end)
	button(playerRow, "Respawn", GRAY, function()
		send("respawn")
	end)

	-- Round ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	heading("Round")
	local roundRow = row()
	button(roundRow, "Skip phase", nil, function()
		send("skip")
	end)
	button(roundRow, "+60 seconds", nil, function()
		send("time", { seconds = 60 })
	end)
	button(roundRow, "-30 seconds", GRAY, function()
		send("time", { seconds = -30 })
	end)
	button(roundRow, "Next map (next round)", nil, function()
		send("nextMap")
	end)
	button(roundRow, "Reset furniture", GRAY, function()
		send("resetFurniture")
	end)
	button(roundRow, "Clear ground items", GRAY, function()
		send("clearItems")
	end)

	-- Open button (admins only) ----------------------------------------------------------------
	local openButton = UIKit.button({
		Name = "AdminButton",
		Text = "ADMIN (F2)",
		TextSize = 15,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(104, 34),
		BackgroundColor3 = ADMIN_RED,
		Visible = false,
		Parent = parent,
	})

	local function isAdmin(): boolean
		return ClientState.my("Admin") == true
	end

	local lastCount = -1
	local panel: Panel = {
		open = function()
			if isAdmin() then
				lastCount = #ClientState.rows()
				refreshTargets()
				window.Visible = true
			end
		end,
		close = function()
			window.Visible = false
		end,
		isOpen = function()
			return window.Visible
		end,
		update = function()
			openButton.Visible = isAdmin()
			if window.Visible then
				local count = #ClientState.rows()
				if count ~= lastCount then
					lastCount = count
					refreshTargets()
				end
			end
		end,
	}
	local function toggle()
		if window.Visible then
			panel.close()
		else
			panel.open()
		end
	end
	openButton.Activated:Connect(toggle)
	local close = window:FindFirstChild("Close")
	if close and close:IsA("TextButton") then
		close.Activated:Connect(panel.close)
	end
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F2 then
			toggle()
		end
	end)
	return panel
end

return AdminPanel

scripts.name: Banner
scripts.source:
-- Top-center countdown banner: "Outbreak happening in N seconds", the
-- survival timer, or "Waiting for players".

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)
local Util = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Util)

local Banner = {}

function Banner.build(parent: Instance): () -> ()
	local frame = UIKit.panel({
		Name = "Banner",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 42),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		Parent = parent,
	}, { UIKit.padding(18, 0) })
	local label = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Text",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		TextSize = 22,
		Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
		Parent = frame,
	})

	return function()
		local phase = ClientState.phase()
		local left = ClientState.secondsLeft()
		local text
		if phase == "Waiting" then
			local count = #ClientState.participants:GetChildren()
			local needed = ClientState.attr("Needed") or 2
			text = string.format("Waiting for players (%d/%d)", count, needed)
		elseif phase == "Prep" then
			text = string.format("Outbreak happening in %d seconds", math.ceil(left))
		elseif phase == "Infection" then
			if ClientState.isZombie() then
				text = "Infect them all!  " .. Util.clock(left)
			else
				text = "Survive!  " .. Util.clock(left) .. " left"
			end
		else
			text = "Next round starting..."
		end
		label.Text = text
		label.TextColor3 = if phase == "Infection" and left <= 10 then UIKit.RED else UIKit.WHITE
	end
end

return Banner

scripts.name: BottomCenter
scripts.source:
-- Bottom-center: a context hint ("Press E to pick up Bat"), the single item
-- slot with a 3D preview of what you hold, and the "Immunity 0/100" bar.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local ItemModels = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.ItemModels)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

local BottomCenter = {}

-- " x3" for peels, " 60%" for a water tank, "" for everything else.
local function chargeText(item: Items.Item, charges: any): string
	if typeof(charges) ~= "number" or charges <= 0 or not item.charges then
		return ""
	end
	if item.kind == "Stream" then
		return string.format(" %d%%", math.ceil(charges / item.charges * 100))
	end
	return " x" .. charges
end

local function nearestGroundItem(position: Vector3): string?
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("GroundItems")
	if not folder then
		return nil
	end
	local best: string? = nil
	local bestDistance = Config.PICKUP_RADIUS
	for _, model in folder:GetChildren() do
		local x, z = model:GetAttribute("SpotX"), model:GetAttribute("SpotZ")
		if typeof(x) == "number" and typeof(z) == "number" then
			local d = Util.flatDistance(Vector3.new(x, 0, z), position)
			if d <= bestDistance then
				best, bestDistance = model:GetAttribute("ItemId") :: string?, d
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

function BottomCenter.wizardNear(position: Vector3): boolean
	local wizard = workspace:FindFirstChild("Wizard")
	local robe = wizard and wizard:FindFirstChild("Robe") :: BasePart?
	return robe ~= nil and Util.flatDistance(robe.Position, position) <= Config.WIZARD_SHOP_RADIUS
end

function BottomCenter.build(parent: Instance, touchMode: boolean): () -> ()
	local column = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "BottomCenter",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -10),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 150),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = parent,
	}, {
		UIKit.list(
			Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
			6,
			Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
			Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
		),
	})

	local hint = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Hint",
		LayoutOrder = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 22),
		TextSize = 17,
		Parent = column,
	})
	UIKit.textStroke(1.5).Parent = hint

	local slot = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "Slot",
		LayoutOrder = 2,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 72),
		BackgroundColor3 = UIKit.PANEL,
		BackgroundTransparency = UIKit.PANEL_TRANSPARENCY,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Parent = column,
	}, { UIKit.corner(10), UIKit.stroke(UIKit.WHITE, 2) })
	local itemName = UIKit.label({
		Name = "ItemName",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -2),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 14),
		TextSize = 12,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		ZIndex = 3,
		Parent = slot,
	})
	UIKit.textStroke(1).Parent = itemName

	local bar = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "Immunity",
		LayoutOrder = 3,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 18),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 44),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Parent = column,
	}, { UIKit.corner(9) })
	local fill = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "Fill",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(94, 196, 255),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Parent = bar,
	}, { UIKit.corner(9) })
	local barText = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Text",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		TextSize = 13,
		ZIndex = 2,
		Parent = bar,
	})
	UIKit.textStroke(1).Parent = barText

	local shownItem: string? = nil
	local preview: ViewportFrame? = nil

	return function()
		local held = ClientState.my("HeldItem")
		local itemId = if typeof(held) == "string" and held ~= "" then held else nil
		if itemId ~= shownItem then
			shownItem = itemId
			if preview then
				preview:Destroy()
				preview = nil
			end
			if itemId then
				preview = UIKit.viewport(slot, ItemModels.build(itemId), { ZIndex = 2 })
			end
		end
		local item = Items.get(itemId)
		local charges = ClientState.my("HeldCharges")
		itemName.Text = if item then item.name .. chargeText(item, charges) else ""

		local immunity = ClientState.my("Immunity") or 0
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(immunity / Config.IMMUNITY_MAX, 0, 1), 1)
		barText.Text = string.format("Immunity  %d/%d", immunity, Config.IMMUNITY_MAX)

		local _, root = ClientState.myCharacter()
		local text = ""
		local keys = not touchMode
		if root then
			if ClientState.isZombie() then
				if ClientState.phase() == "Infection" then
					text = if keys then "[Z] back to spawn" else ""
				end
			else
				local ground = nearestGroundItem(root.Position)
				local groundItem = Items.get(ground)
				if BottomCenter.wizardNear(root.Position) then
					text = if keys
						then "Press [B] to trade with the wizard"
						else "Tap SHOP to trade with the wizard"
				elseif groundItem then
					text = (if keys then "Press [E] to pick up " else "Tap PICK UP: ") .. groundItem.name
				elseif item and keys then
					local verb = if item.kind == "Stream"
						then "[Hold click] spray"
						elseif item.kind == "Trap" then "[Click] drop one"
						elseif item.kind == "Melee" then "[Click] swing  [Hold] drag furniture"
						else "[Click] use"
					text = verb .. "   [G] drop"
				end
			end
		end
		hint.Text = text
	end
end

return BottomCenter

scripts.name: BottomLeft
scripts.source:
-- Bottom-left: your points, the speed boost and size they give you, and
-- anything changing your speed right now (energy drink, freeze, stun).
-- Plus a 2x score timer when one is running.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local RoundRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoundRules)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

local BottomLeft = {}

local ICE = Color3.fromHex("8FD3FF")

function BottomLeft.build(parent: Instance): () -> ()
	local box = UIKit.panel({
		Name = "ScoreBox",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -12),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		Parent = parent,
	}, { UIKit.padding(12, 8), UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 2) })
	local function line(name: string, order: number, height: number, props: { [string]: any }?): TextLabel
		local label = UIKit.label({
			Name = name,
			LayoutOrder = order,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
			TextSize = height - 2,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			Parent = box,
		})
		local extra: { [string]: any } = props or {}
		for key, value in extra do
			(label :: any)[key] = value
		end
		return label
	end
	local points = line("Points", 1, 24, { Font = UIKit.HEAVY })
	local speed = line("Speed", 2, 18)
	local size = line("Size", 3, 18)
	local effect = line("Effect", 4, 16, { Visible = false })
	local boost = line("Boost", 5, 16, { TextColor3 = UIKit.GOLD, Visible = false })

	return function()
		local value = ClientState.my("Score") or 0
		points.Text = "Points: " .. Util.commas(value)
		local multiplier = Config.SPEED_MULTIPLIER(value)
		speed.Text = string.format("Speed boost: +%d%%", math.floor((multiplier - 1) * 100 + 0.5))
		size.Text = string.format("Size: %.2fx", ClientState.my("Scale") or 1)

		-- Compare your real walk speed with what your points alone give you.
		local _, _, humanoid = ClientState.myCharacter()
		local expected = RoundRules.walkSpeed(value, ClientState.isZombie())
		local ratio = if humanoid and expected > 0 then humanoid.WalkSpeed / expected else 1
		effect.Visible = math.abs(ratio - 1) > 0.03
		if ratio < 0.01 then
			effect.Text = "Stunned!"
			effect.TextColor3 = ICE
		elseif ratio > 1 then
			effect.Text = string.format("Speed right now: x%.2f", ratio)
			effect.TextColor3 = UIKit.GOLD
		else
			effect.Text = string.format("Slowed: x%.2f", ratio)
			effect.TextColor3 = ICE
		end

		local endsAt = ClientState.my("BoostEndsAt")
		local left = if typeof(endsAt) == "number" then endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow() else 0
		boost.Visible = left > 0
		if left > 0 then
			boost.Text = "2x score  " .. Util.clock(left)
		end
	end
end

return BottomLeft

scripts.name: Center
scripts.source:
-- Center screen: the big "Survivors Win!!!" / "Zombies Win!!!" text, plus
-- short toasts under the banner.

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)

local Center = {}

function Center.buildWinText(parent: Instance): () -> ()
	local label = UIKit.label({
		Name = "WinText",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.42),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.2),
		TextScaled = true,
		Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
		Visible = false,
		ZIndex = 10,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	UIKit.new("UITextSizeConstraint", { MaxTextSize = 96, Parent = label })
	UIKit.textStroke(4).Parent = label
	local scale = UIKit.new("UIScale", { Scale = 1, Parent = label })

	local shown = ""
	return function()
		local winner = ClientState.attr("Winner")
		local text = if winner == "Survivors"
			then "Survivors Win!!!"
			elseif winner == "Zombies" then "Zombies Win!!!"
			else ""
		if text ~= shown then
			shown = text
			label.Visible = text ~= ""
			label.Text = text
			if text ~= "" then
				scale.Scale = 0.4
				TweenService:Create(
					scale,
					TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{ Scale = 1 }
				):Play()
			end
		end
	end
end

function Center.buildToasts(parent: Instance): (text: string, hex: string?) -> ()
	local stack = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "Toasts",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 58),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 120),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = parent,
	}, { UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 4, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center) })

	local order = 0
	return function(text: string, hex: string?)
		order += 1
		local toast = UIKit.panel({
			Name = "Toast",
			LayoutOrder = order,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
			Parent = stack,
		}, { UIKit.padding(14, 0) })
		local label = UIKit.label({
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
			TextSize = 17,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = if hex then Color3.fromHex(hex) else UIKit.WHITE,
			Parent = toast,
		})
		local toasts = stack:GetChildren()
		local count = 0
		for _, child in toasts do
			if child:IsA("Frame") then
				count += 1
			end
		end
		if count > 3 then
			local oldest: Frame? = nil
			for _, child in toasts do
				if child:IsA("Frame") and (not oldest or child.LayoutOrder < oldest.LayoutOrder) then
					oldest = child
				end
			end
			if oldest then
				oldest:Destroy()
			end
		end
		task.delay(3, function()
			if toast.Parent then
				local info = TweenInfo.new(0.4)
				TweenService:Create(toast, info, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
				TweenService:Create(label, info, { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
				task.wait(0.45)
				toast:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end
end

return Center

scripts.name: Hud
scripts.source:
-- Builds the whole HUD in code and keeps it up to date.
--   top-left: buttons        top-center: countdown      top-right: counts + leaderboard
--   bottom-left: points      bottom-center: item slot   bottom-right: chat
--   center: win text, toasts, shop / settings / trophy / quick start windows

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local AdminPanel = require(script.Parent.AdminPanel)
local Banner = require(script.Parent.Banner)
local BottomCenter = require(script.Parent.BottomCenter)
local BottomLeft = require(script.Parent.BottomLeft)
local Center = require(script.Parent.Center)
local ChatSetup = require(script.Parent.Parent.ChatSetup)
local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local InputController = require(script.Parent.Parent.InputController)
local MobileButtons = require(script.Parent.MobileButtons)
local QuickStart = require(script.Parent.QuickStart)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local ShopPanel = require(script.Parent.ShopPanel)
local SidePanels = require(script.Parent.SidePanels)
local TopLeft = require(script.Parent.TopLeft)
local TopRight = require(script.Parent.TopRight)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)

local Hud = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function hideDefaultGui()
	for _, kind in { Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, Enum.CoreGuiType.Health } do
		for _ = 1, 10 do
			local ok = pcall(function()
				StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(kind, false)
			end)
			if ok then
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end
end

function Hud.start()
	task.spawn(hideDefaultGui)

	local gui = UIKit.new("ScreenGui", {
		Name = "BrainTagHud",
		ResetOnSpawn = false,
		IgnoreGuiInset = false,
		ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.CoreUISafeInsets,
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
		Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"),
	})
	local uiScale = UIKit.new("UIScale", { Parent = gui })
	local function rescale()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if camera then
			uiScale.Scale = math.clamp(camera.ViewportSize.Y / 760, 0.62, 1)
		end
	end
	rescale()
	if workspace.CurrentCamera then
		workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(rescale)
	end

	local touchMode = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled

	local toast = Center.buildToasts(gui)
	ShopPanel.build(gui, toast)
	local openQuick, quickOpen = QuickStart.build(gui, touchMode, function()
		Remotes.event("TutorialDone"):FireServer()
	end)
	local settings = SidePanels.buildSettings(gui, openQuick)
	local trophy = SidePanels.buildTrophy(gui)
	local admin = AdminPanel.build(gui, toast)

	local function closeAll()
		ShopPanel.close()
		settings.close()
		trophy.close()
		admin.close()
	end

	local function toggleShop()
		if ShopPanel.isOpen() then
			ShopPanel.close()
			return
		end
		if ClientState.isZombie() then
			toast("Zombies can't shop!", Config.COLORS.ZombieText)
			return
		end
		closeAll()
		local _, root = ClientState.myCharacter()
		local atWizard = root ~= nil and BottomCenter.wizardNear(root.Position)
		ShopPanel.open(if atWizard then "Wizard" else "Items")
	end

	TopLeft.build(gui, {
		menu = function()
			closeAll()
			openQuick()
		end,
		shop = toggleShop,
		settings = function()
			local wasOpen = settings.isOpen()
			closeAll()
			if not wasOpen then
				settings.open()
			end
		end,
		trophy = function()
			local wasOpen = trophy.isOpen()
			closeAll()
			if not wasOpen then
				trophy.open()
			end
		end,
		chat = function()
			ChatSetup.setVisible(not ChatSetup.isVisible())
		end,
	})

	local updaters = {
		Banner.build(gui),
		TopRight.build(gui),
		BottomCenter.build(gui, touchMode),
		BottomLeft.build(gui),
		Center.buildWinText(gui),
	}
	if touchMode then
		table.insert(updaters, MobileButtons.build(gui))
	end

	InputController.onShop = toggleShop
	InputController.isMenuOpen = function()
		return ShopPanel.isOpen() or settings.isOpen() or trophy.isOpen() or quickOpen() or admin.isOpen()
	end

	Remotes.event("Toast").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(text: string, hex: string?)
		if typeof(text) == "string" then
			toast(text, hex)
		end
	end)

	-- First visit: show the quick start once the server has loaded our data.
	task.spawn(function()
		local me = ClientState.participants:WaitForChild(ClientState.myId(), 60)
		if me and me:GetAttribute("SeenTutorial") ~= true then
			openQuick()
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			for _, update in updaters do
				local ok, err = pcall(function()
					update()
					return true
				end)
				if not ok then
					warn("[Hud] " .. tostring(err))
				end
			end
			ShopPanel.update()
			trophy.update()
			admin.update()

			-- Close the shop if you turned into a zombie or walked away from the wizard.
			if ShopPanel.isOpen() then
				local _, root = ClientState.myCharacter()
				if ClientState.isZombie() then
					ShopPanel.close()
				elseif
					ShopPanel.mode() == "Wizard" and (not root or not BottomCenter.wizardNear(root.Position))
				then
					ShopPanel.close()
				end
			end

			-- Your own name tag is lime green (only on your screen).
			local character = player.Character
			local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local tag = head and head:FindFirstChild("NameTag")
			local label = tag and tag:FindFirstChild("Label") :: TextLabel?
			if label then
				label.TextColor3 = UIKit.LIME
			end

			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)
end

return Hud

scripts.name: MobileButtons
scripts.source:
-- On-screen buttons for phones and tablets: USE (hold), PICK UP, DROP, SHOP,
-- and RETURN for zombies. Placed bottom-right.

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local InputController = require(script.Parent.Parent.InputController)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)

local MobileButtons = {}

local function round(parent: Instance, text: string, size: number, position: UDim2, color: Color3): TextButton
	local button = UIKit.button({
		Text = text,
		TextSize = if size > 70 then 22 else 14,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = position,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
		BackgroundColor3 = color,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	local corner = button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if corner then
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0) -- full circle
	end
	return button
end

function MobileButtons.build(parent: Instance): () -> ()
	local cluster = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "MobileButtons",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -100),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 200),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = parent,
	})

	local use = round(cluster, "USE", 86, UDim2.fromOffset(140, 140), UIKit.ACCENT)
	use.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		then
			InputController.useStart()
		end
	end)
	use.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		then
			InputController.useStop()
		end
	end)

	local pick = round(cluster, "PICK\nUP", 56, UDim2.fromOffset(52, 150), UIKit.PANEL)
	pick.Activated:Connect(InputController.pickUp)
	local drop = round(cluster, "DROP", 50, UDim2.fromOffset(78, 92), UIKit.PANEL)
	drop.Activated:Connect(InputController.drop)
	local shop = round(cluster, "SHOP", 50, UDim2.fromOffset(140, 66), UIKit.PANEL)
	shop.Activated:Connect(InputController.shop)
	local back = round(cluster, "RETURN", 70, UDim2.fromOffset(140, 140), UIKit.RED)
	back.Activated:Connect(InputController.zombieReturn)

	return function()
		local zombie = ClientState.isZombie()
		use.Visible = not zombie
		pick.Visible = not zombie
		drop.Visible = not zombie
		shop.Visible = not zombie
		back.Visible = zombie and ClientState.phase() == "Infection"
	end
end

return MobileButtons

scripts.source: -- The "Quick start" card shown on your first visit (and from the menu button). local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit) local QuickStart = {} function QuickStart.build(parent: Instance, touchMode: boolean, onDone: () -> ()): (() -> (), () -> boolean) local card = UIKit.panel({ Name = "QuickStart", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(440, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 0.05, Visible = false, ZIndex = 30, Parent = parent, }, { UIKit.padding(22, 18), UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 8, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center) }) UIKit.new("UISizeConstraint", { MaxSize = Vector2.new(440, 600), Parent = card }) local function line(order: number, text: string, size: number, font: Enum.Font, color: Color3?) UIKit.label({ LayoutOrder = order, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Text = text, TextSize = size, Font = font, TextColor3 = color or UIKit.WHITE, TextWrapped = true, RichText = true, ZIndex = 31, Parent = card, }) end line(1, "Quick start", 30, UIKit.HEAVY) line( 2, "Everyone starts human. When the outbreak hits, some players turn into zombies. Survive until the timer runs out, or infect every human.", 17, UIKit.FONT, UIKit.MUTED ) local controls: { string } = if touchMode then { "Thumbstick move", "USE swing or fire your item", "PICK UP / DROP grab or let go of an item", "SHOP buy items (and trade with the wizard)", "RETURN zombies: back to spawn", } else { "WASD / Arrows move", "Mouse aim Click use item", "B shop (or the wizard, when you stand next to him)", "E pick up G drop", "Z zombies: back to spawn", } for i, text in controls do line(2 + i, text, 18, UIKit.BOLD) end line( 10, "Tip: walk into furniture to push it (bigger players push harder). Hold click with a weapon to drag it. Jam a couch into a doorway to build a barricade!", 17, UIKit.BOLD, UIKit.LIME ) UIKit.button({ LayoutOrder = 11, Text = "Got it", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 42), BackgroundColor3 = UIKit.GOOD, TextSize = 22, ZIndex = 31, Parent = card, }, function() card.Visible = false onDone() end) local function open() card.Visible = true end local function isOpen(): boolean return card.Visible end return open, isOpen end return QuickStart

scripts.name: ShopPanel
scripts.source:
-- The shop window. Tabs: Items (spend score), Skins (score, Robux or VIP) and
-- Robux (game passes and developer products). Opened next to the wizard, it
-- shows his rare stock instead. The server validates every purchase.

local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CharacterLook = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.CharacterLook)
local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local ItemModels = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.ItemModels)
local Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Items)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local Skins = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Skins)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util)

type Mode = "Items" | "Wizard" | "Skins" | "Robux"

-- Filled in by build().
local ShopPanel = {
	open = function(_mode: Mode) end,
	close = function() end,
	isOpen = function(): boolean
		return false
	end,
	update = function() end,
	mode = function(): Mode
		return "Items"
	end,
}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local money = Config.MONETIZATION
local buyItemRemote = Remotes.func("BuyItem")
local buySkinRemote = Remotes.func("BuySkin")

local PASSES = {
	{
		key = "VIP",
		name = "VIP",
		description = "Gold name and [VIP] chat tag, +20% score, VIP skins.",
		preview = "skin:Royal",
	},
	{
		key = "DoubleScore",
		name = "Double Score",
		description = "+100% score from every reward. Forever.",
		preview = "item:GoldenDrumstick",
	},
	{
		key = "StarterKit",
		name = "Starter Kit",
		description = "Start every round holding a Bat.",
		preview = "item:Bat",
	},
	{
		key = "Lucky",
		name = "Lucky",
		description = "Rare roll chance 5% -> 15% on every purchase.",
		preview = "item:AncientSpear",
	},
}

local PRODUCTS = {
	{
		key = "InstantBat",
		name = "Instant Bat",
		description = "A Bat in your hand right now.",
		preview = "item:Bat",
	},
	{
		key = "InstantSpear",
		name = "Instant Spear",
		description = "A Spear in your hand right now.",
		preview = "item:Spear",
	},
	{
		key = "InstantShotgun",
		name = "Instant Shotgun",
		description = "The big one. Right now.",
		preview = "item:Shotgun",
	},
	{
		key = "ImmunityShot",
		name = "Immunity Shot",
		description = "+50 immunity right now.",
		preview = "item:Pill",
	},
	{
		key = "ScoreBoost30",
		name = "2x Score, 30 min",
		description = "Double every reward for 30 minutes. Stacks.",
		preview = "item:Drumstick",
	},
}

local prices: { [string]: number } = {}

local function fetchPrice(kind: "Product" | "GamePass", id: number, onDone: () -> ())
	local cacheKey = kind .. id
	if prices[cacheKey] or id == 0 then
		return
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, info = pcall(function()
			return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(
				id,
				if kind == "GamePass" then Enum.InfoType.GamePass else Enum.InfoType.Product
			)
		end)
		if ok and info and typeof(info.PriceInRobux) == "number" then
			prices[cacheKey] = info.PriceInRobux
			onDone()
		end
	end)
end

local function priceText(kind: "Product" | "GamePass", id: number): string
	local price = prices[kind .. id]
	return if price then "R$ " .. price else "Robux"
end

local function buildPreview(spec: string): Model?
	local kind, id = string.match(spec, "^(%a+):(%w+)$")
	if kind == "item" and id then
		return ItemModels.build(id)
	elseif kind == "skin" and id then
		local skin = Skins.get(id)
		if skin then
			return CharacterLook.preview(skin.id, skin.team)
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function ShopPanel.build(parent: Instance, toast: (string, string?) -> ())
	local mode: Mode = "Items"
	local skinTeam: Skins.Team = "Human"
	local render: () -> ()

	local window, content, heading = UIKit.modal(parent, "Shop", 780, 520, function()
		ShopPanel.close()
	end)

	local scoreLabel = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Score",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -54, 0, 12),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 28),
		TextSize = 18,
		TextColor3 = UIKit.GOLD,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		ZIndex = 22,
		Parent = window,
	})

	local tabBar = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "Tabs",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34),
		ZIndex = 21,
		Parent = content,
	}, { UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 8) })

	local body = UIKit.new("ScrollingFrame", {
		Name = "Body",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 42),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -42),
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ScrollBarThickness = 6,
		ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
		ZIndex = 21,
		Parent = content,
	})

	local tabButtons: { [string]: TextButton } = {}
	local function tab(name: string, order: number, onClick: () -> ()): TextButton
		local button = UIKit.button({
			Name = name,
			Text = name,
			LayoutOrder = order,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(104, 32),
			TextSize = 17,
			ZIndex = 22,
			Parent = tabBar,
		}, onClick)
		tabButtons[name] = button
		return button
	end
	for i, name in { "Items", "Skins", "Robux" } do
		tab(name, i, function()
			mode = name :: Mode
			render()
		end)
	end
	local teamHuman = tab("Human", 10, function()
		skinTeam = "Human"
		render()
	end)
	local teamZombie = tab("Zombie", 11, function()
		skinTeam = "Zombie"
		render()
	end)

	local function clearBody()
		for _, child in body:GetChildren() do
			child:Destroy()
		end
		UIKit.new("UIGridLayout", {
			CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 222),
			CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			Parent = body,
		})
	end

	type CardSpec = {
		order: number,
		title: string,
		price: string,
		priceColor: Color3?,
		description: string,
		preview: Model?,
		button: string,
		buttonColor: Color3?,
		enabled: boolean,
		onClick: (() -> ())?,
	}

	local function card(spec: CardSpec)
		local frame = UIKit.new("Frame", {
			LayoutOrder = spec.order,
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(44, 46, 52),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			ZIndex = 22,
			Parent = body,
		}, { UIKit.corner(10) })
		local previewBox = UIKit.new("Frame", {
			Name = "Preview",
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 63, 70),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 86),
			ZIndex = 22,
			Parent = frame,
		}, { UIKit.corner(8) })
		if spec.preview then
			UIKit.viewport(previewBox, spec.preview, { ZIndex = 23 })
		end
		UIKit.label({
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 98),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20),
			Text = spec.title,
			TextSize = 17,
			Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			ZIndex = 23,
			Parent = frame,
		})
		UIKit.label({
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 118),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16),
			Text = spec.price,
			TextSize = 15,
			TextColor3 = spec.priceColor or UIKit.GOLD,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			ZIndex = 23,
			Parent = frame,
		})
		UIKit.label({
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 136),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 42),
			Text = spec.description,
			TextSize = 13,
			Font = UIKit.FONT,
			TextColor3 = UIKit.MUTED,
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
			ZIndex = 23,
			Parent = frame,
		})
		UIKit.button({
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -8),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 32),
			Text = spec.button,
			TextSize = 16,
			BackgroundColor3 = if spec.enabled
				then (spec.buttonColor or UIKit.GOOD)
				else Color3.fromRGB(80, 82, 88),
			AutoButtonColor = spec.enabled,
			ZIndex = 23,
			Parent = frame,
		}, function()
			if spec.enabled and spec.onClick then
				spec.onClick()
			end
		end)
	end

	local function renderItems(fromWizard: boolean)
		local score = ClientState.my("Score") or 0
		local order: { string } = if fromWizard then Items.wizardOrder else Items.shopOrder
		for i, id in order do
			local item = Items.get(id) :: Items.Item
			local price = (if fromWizard then item.wizardPrice else item.price) or 0
			local affordable = score >= price
			card({
				order = i,
				title = item.name,
				price = Util.commas(price) .. " score",
				priceColor = if affordable then UIKit.GOLD else UIKit.RED,
				description = item.description .. (if item.rare then "  (5% chance: rare!)" else ""),
				preview = ItemModels.build(id),
				button = "Buy",
				enabled = affordable,
				onClick = function()
					local ok, okResult, message = pcall(function()
						return buyItemRemote:InvokeServer(id, fromWizard)
					end)
					if ok then
						toast(
							tostring(message),
							if okResult then Config.COLORS.Good else Config.COLORS.ZombieText
						)
					end
					task.delay(0.2, render)
				end,
			})
		end
	end

	local function prompt(kind: "Product" | "GamePass", key: string)
		local id = if kind == "GamePass" then money.GamePasses[key] else money.Products[key]
		if not id or id == 0 then
			toast("Not set up yet: add its id to Config.MONETIZATION", Config.COLORS.ZombieText)
			return
		end
		if kind == "GamePass" then
			MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, id)
		else
			MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, id)
		end
	end

	local function renderSkins()
		local equipped = ClientState.my(if skinTeam == "Zombie" then "ZombieSkin" else "HumanSkin")
		local score = ClientState.my("Score") or 0
		for i, skin in Skins.forTeam(skinTeam) do
			local owned = ClientState.owns("OwnedSkins", skin.id)
				or skin.default == true
				or (skin.pass ~= nil and ClientState.owns("Passes", skin.pass))
			local price, button, enabled = "", "", true
			if equipped == skin.id then
				price, button, enabled = "Owned", "Equipped", false
			elseif owned then
				price, button = "Owned", "Equip"
			elseif skin.scorePrice then
				price = Util.commas(skin.scorePrice) .. " score"
				button = "Unlock"
				enabled = score >= skin.scorePrice
			elseif skin.product then
				local id = money.Products[skin.product] or 0
				fetchPrice("Product", id, render)
				price, button = priceText("Product", id), "Buy"
			elseif skin.pass then
				price, button = "VIP pass", "Get VIP"
			end
			card({
				order = i,
				title = skin.name,
				price = price,
				priceColor = if owned then UIKit.LIME else UIKit.GOLD,
				description = if skin.team == "Zombie" then "Zombie skin" else "Human skin",
				preview = CharacterLook.preview(skin.id, skin.team),
				button = button,
				buttonColor = if skin.product or skin.pass then UIKit.ACCENT else UIKit.GOOD,
				enabled = enabled,
				onClick = function()
					local ok, status, message = pcall(function()
						return buySkinRemote:InvokeServer(skin.id)
					end)
					if not ok then
						return
					end
					if status == "prompt" then
						prompt("Product", message)
					elseif status == "promptPass" then
						prompt("GamePass", message)
					else
						toast(
							tostring(message),
							if status == "error" then Config.COLORS.ZombieText else Config.COLORS.Good
						)
					end
					task.delay(0.3, render)
				end,
			})
		end
	end

	local function renderRobux()
		local shown = 0
		local studio = RunService:IsStudio()
		local order = 0
		local function addCard(
			kind: "Product" | "GamePass",
			entry: { key: string, name: string, description: string, preview: string }
		)
			local id = (if kind == "GamePass" then money.GamePasses[entry.key] else money.Products[entry.key])
				or 0
			if id == 0 and not studio then
				return
			end
			order += 1
			shown += 1
			local owned = kind == "GamePass" and ClientState.owns("Passes", entry.key)
			fetchPrice(kind, id, render)
			card({
				order = order,
				title = entry.name,
				price = if owned then "Owned" elseif id == 0 then "Not set up" else priceText(kind, id),
				priceColor = if owned then UIKit.LIME else UIKit.GOLD,
				description = entry.description .. (if kind == "GamePass" then "  (permanent)" else ""),
				preview = buildPreview(entry.preview),
				button = if owned then "Owned" elseif id == 0 then "Set id in Config" else "Buy",
				buttonColor = UIKit.ACCENT,
				enabled = not owned and id ~= 0,
				onClick = function()
					prompt(kind, entry.key)
				end,
			})
		end
		for _, entry in PASSES do
			addCard("GamePass", entry)
		end
		for _, entry in PRODUCTS do
			addCard("Product", entry)
		end
		if shown == 0 then
			UIKit.label({
				Text = "Coming soon!",
				TextSize = 22,
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 222),
				ZIndex = 22,
				Parent = body,
			})
		end
	end

	render = function()
		if not window.Visible then
			return
		end
		clearBody()
		local wizard = mode == "Wizard"
		heading.Text = if wizard then "Wizard's Wares" else "Shop"
		tabBar.Visible = not wizard
		body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, if wizard then 0 else 42)
		body.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, if wizard then 0 else -42)
		for name, button in tabButtons do
			local selected = name == mode or (mode == "Skins" and name == skinTeam)
			button.BackgroundColor3 = if selected then UIKit.ACCENT else Color3.fromRGB(70, 72, 78)
		end
		teamHuman.Visible = mode == "Skins"
		teamZombie.Visible = mode == "Skins"
		if mode == "Items" then
			renderItems(false)
		elseif mode == "Wizard" then
			renderItems(true)
		elseif mode == "Skins" then
			renderSkins()
		else
			renderRobux()
		end
	end

	local lastScore = -1
	ShopPanel.update = function()
		if not window.Visible then
			return
		end
		local score = ClientState.my("Score") or 0
		scoreLabel.Text = "Score: " .. Util.commas(score)
		if score ~= lastScore then
			lastScore = score
			render()
		end
	end

	ShopPanel.open = function(newMode: Mode)
		mode = newMode
		window.Visible = true
		lastScore = -1
		render()
	end

	ShopPanel.close = function()
		window.Visible = false
	end

	ShopPanel.isOpen = function(): boolean
		return window.Visible
	end

	ShopPanel.mode = function(): Mode
		return mode
	end

	MarketplaceService.PromptProductPurchaseFinished:Connect(function()
		task.delay(1, render)
	end)
	MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function()
		task.delay(1, render)
	end)
end

return ShopPanel

ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local CameraController = require(script.Parent.Parent.CameraController) local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState) local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config) local Sounds = require(script.Parent.Parent.Sounds) local TopRight = require(script.Parent.TopRight) local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit) local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util) local SidePanels = {} export type Panel = { open: () -> (), close: () -> (), isOpen: () -> boolean, update: () -> () } local function row(parent: Instance, order: number, title: string): Frame local frame = UIKit.new("Frame", { LayoutOrder = order, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), ZIndex = 21, Parent = parent, }) UIKit.label({ Text = title, TextSize = 18, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Size = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 22, Parent = frame, }) local options = UIKit.new("Frame", { Name = scripts.source:
-- Top-left: five square icon buttons (menu, shop, settings, trophy, chat).

local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)

local TopLeft = {}

export type Actions = {
	menu: () -> (),
	shop: () -> (),
	settings: () -> (),
	trophy: () -> (),
	chat: () -> (),
}

function TopLeft.build(parent: Instance, actions: Actions)
	local bar = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "TopLeft",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 8),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(5 * 50, 46),
		Parent = parent,
	}, { UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 6) })

	local buttons: { { icon: string, action: () -> (), accent: boolean?, name: string } } = {
		{ icon = "☰", action = actions.menu, accent = true, name = "Menu" },
		{ icon = "🛒", action = actions.shop, name = "Shop" },
		{ icon = "⚙", action = actions.settings, name = "Settings" },
		{ icon = "🏆", action = actions.trophy, name = "Trophy" },
		{ icon = "💬", action = actions.chat, name = "Chat" },
	}
	for i, b in buttons do
		UIKit.button({
			Name = b.name,
			Text = b.icon,
			TextSize = 22,
			Font = UIKit.BOLD,
			LayoutOrder = i,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44),
			BackgroundColor3 = if b.accent then UIKit.ACCENT else UIKit.PANEL,
			BackgroundTransparency = if b.accent then 0 else UIKit.PANEL_TRANSPARENCY,
			Parent = bar,
		}, b.action)
	end
end

return TopLeft

scripts.name: TopRight
scripts.source:
-- Top-right: ping/fps, "N Survivors" (white) over "N Zombies" (red), and a
-- collapsible top-10 leaderboard with your own name in lime green.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local ClientState = require(script.Parent.Parent.ClientState)
local UIKit = require(script.Parent.UIKit)
local Util = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Util)

local TopRight = {}

local ROWS = 10
local HUMAN_DOT = Color3.fromHex("F2C79A")
local ZOMBIE_DOT = Color3.fromHex("7BC043")

local showStats = true

function TopRight.setStatsVisible(on: boolean)
	showStats = on
end

function TopRight.statsVisible(): boolean
	return showStats
end

function TopRight.build(parent: Instance): () -> ()
	local column = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "TopRight",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 6),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 400),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = parent,
	}, { UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 2, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right) })

	local stats = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Stats",
		LayoutOrder = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 16),
		TextSize = 13,
		Font = UIKit.FONT,
		TextColor3 = UIKit.MUTED,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		Parent = column,
	})
	local survivors = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Survivors",
		LayoutOrder = 2,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 32),
		TextSize = 30,
		Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		Parent = column,
	})
	UIKit.textStroke(1.5).Parent = survivors
	local zombies = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Zombies",
		LayoutOrder = 3,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 32),
		TextSize = 30,
		Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
		TextColor3 = UIKit.RED,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		Parent = column,
	})
	UIKit.textStroke(1.5).Parent = zombies

	local expanded = true
	local toggle = UIKit.button({
		Name = "LeaderboardToggle",
		LayoutOrder = 4,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 26),
		Text = "^  Leaderboard",
		TextSize = 16,
		BackgroundColor3 = UIKit.PANEL,
		BackgroundTransparency = UIKit.PANEL_TRANSPARENCY,
		Parent = column,
	})
	local board = UIKit.panel({
		Name = "Leaderboard",
		LayoutOrder = 5,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		Parent = column,
	}, { UIKit.padding(8, 6), UIKit.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 2) })

	toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
		expanded = not expanded
		board.Visible = expanded
		toggle.Text = (if expanded then "^" else "v") .. "  Leaderboard"
	end)

	local rows = {}
	for i = 1, ROWS do
		local row = UIKit.new("Frame", {
			Name = "Row" .. i,
			LayoutOrder = i,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
			Visible = false,
			Parent = board,
		})
		local dot = UIKit.new("Frame", {
			Name = "Dot",
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Parent = row,
		}, { UIKit.corner(4) })
		local name = UIKit.label({
			Name = "Name",
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -84, 1, 0),
			TextSize = 15,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			Parent = row,
		})
		local score = UIKit.label({
			Name = "Score",
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 1, 0),
			TextSize = 15,
			Font = UIKit.FONT,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
			Parent = row,
		})
		rows[i] = { frame = row, dot = dot, name = name, score = score }
	end

	local frames, fps = 0, 60
	local windowStart = os.clock()
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		frames += 1
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - windowStart >= 1 then
			fps = frames / (now - windowStart)
			frames, windowStart = 0, now
		end
	end)

	return function()
		stats.Visible = showStats
		if showStats then
			local ping = math.floor(Players.LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 1000)
			stats.Text = string.format("ping %d ms  |  %d fps", ping, math.floor(fps + 0.5))
		end
		local s = ClientState.attr("Survivors") or 0
		local z = ClientState.attr("Zombies") or 0
		survivors.Text = string.format("%d %s", s, if s == 1 then "Survivor" else "Survivors")
		zombies.Text = string.format("%d %s", z, if z == 1 then "Zombie" else "Zombies")

		local list = ClientState.rows()
		for i, row in rows do
			local entry = list[i]
			row.frame.Visible = entry ~= nil
			if entry then
				row.name.Text = entry.name
				row.name.TextColor3 = if entry.isMe
					then UIKit.LIME
					elseif entry.vip then UIKit.GOLD
					else UIKit.WHITE
				row.score.Text = Util.commas(entry.score)
				row.score.TextColor3 = if entry.isMe then UIKit.LIME else UIKit.WHITE
				row.dot.BackgroundColor3 = if entry.team == "Zombie" then ZOMBIE_DOT else HUMAN_DOT
			end
		end
	end
end

return TopRight

scripts.name: UIKit
scripts.source:
-- Tiny UI toolkit: every HUD element is built in code with these helpers.
-- Style: BuilderSans, white text, dark translucent rounded panels.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local UIKit = {}

UIKit.FONT = Enum.Font.BuilderSans
UIKit.BOLD = Enum.Font.BuilderSansBold
UIKit.HEAVY = Enum.Font.BuilderSansExtraBold
UIKit.PANEL = Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.Panel)
UIKit.PANEL_TRANSPARENCY = 0.25
UIKit.WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
UIKit.MUTED = Color3.fromRGB(190, 194, 200)
UIKit.LIME = Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.SelfName)
UIKit.RED = Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.ZombieText)
UIKit.GOLD = Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.VipName)
UIKit.ACCENT = Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.Accent)
UIKit.GOOD = Color3.fromHex(Config.COLORS.Good)

type Props = { [string]: any }

-- Creates an instance, applies properties (Parent last) and adds children.
function UIKit.new(className: string, props: Props?, children: { any }?): any
	local instance = Instance.new(className) :: any
	local parent = nil
	local given: Props = props or {}
	local kids: { any } = children or {}
	for key, value in given do
		if key == "Parent" then
			parent = value
		else
			instance[key] = value
		end
	end
	for _, child in kids do
		child.Parent = instance
	end
	if parent then
		instance.Parent = parent
	end
	return instance
end

function UIKit.corner(radius: number?): Instance
	return UIKit.new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 8) })
end

function UIKit.stroke(color: Color3?, thickness: number?, transparency: number?): Instance
	return UIKit.new("UIStroke", {
		Color = color or UIKit.WHITE,
		Thickness = thickness or 2,
		Transparency = transparency or 0,
		ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
	})
end

function UIKit.textStroke(thickness: number?): Instance
	return UIKit.new("UIStroke", {
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 18),
		Thickness = thickness or 2,
		ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual,
	})
end

function UIKit.padding(px: number, vertical: number?): Instance
	local v = vertical or px
	return UIKit.new("UIPadding", {
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, px),
		PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, px),
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, v),
		PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, v),
	})
end

function UIKit.list(
	direction: Enum.FillDirection?,
	padding: number?,
	hAlign: Enum.HorizontalAlignment?,
	vAlign: Enum.VerticalAlignment?
): Instance
	return UIKit.new("UIListLayout", {
		FillDirection = direction or Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
		Padding = UDim.new(0, padding or 6),
		HorizontalAlignment = hAlign or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
		VerticalAlignment = vAlign or Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	})
end

function UIKit.panel(props: Props, children: { any }?): Frame
	local merged: Props = {
		BackgroundColor3 = UIKit.PANEL,
		BackgroundTransparency = UIKit.PANEL_TRANSPARENCY,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}
	for key, value in props do
		merged[key] = value
	end
	local frame = UIKit.new("Frame", merged, children)
	UIKit.corner(8).Parent = frame
	return frame
end

function UIKit.label(props: Props): TextLabel
	local merged: Props = {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Font = UIKit.BOLD,
		TextColor3 = UIKit.WHITE,
		TextSize = 18,
		Text = "",
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}
	for key, value in props do
		merged[key] = value
	end
	return UIKit.new("TextLabel", merged)
end

function UIKit.button(props: Props, onClick: (() -> ())?): TextButton
	local merged: Props = {
		BackgroundColor3 = UIKit.ACCENT,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
		TextColor3 = UIKit.WHITE,
		TextSize = 18,
		AutoButtonColor = true,
	}
	for key, value in props do
		merged[key] = value
	end
	local button = UIKit.new("TextButton", merged)
	UIKit.corner(8).Parent = button
	if onClick then
		button.Activated:Connect(onClick)
	end
	return button
end

-- A centered modal window with a title bar and a close button. Returns the
-- window and its content frame.
function UIKit.modal(
	parent: Instance,
	title: string,
	width: number,
	height: number,
	onClose: () -> ()
): (Frame, Frame, TextLabel)
	local window = UIKit.panel({
		Name = title,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.94, 0, 0.86, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.08,
		Visible = false,
		ZIndex = 20,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	UIKit.new("UISizeConstraint", { MaxSize = Vector2.new(width, height), Parent = window })
	local heading = UIKit.label({
		Name = "Title",
		Text = title,
		TextSize = 26,
		Font = UIKit.HEAVY,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 8),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 36),
		ZIndex = 21,
		Parent = window,
	})
	UIKit.button({
		Name = "Close",
		Text = "X",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 10),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 72, 78),
		ZIndex = 22,
		Parent = window,
	}, onClose)
	local content = UIKit.new("Frame", {
		Name = "Content",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 52),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -64),
		ZIndex = 21,
		Parent = window,
	})
	return window, content, heading
end

-- Renders a 3D model inside a ViewportFrame, framed from above at an angle.
function UIKit.viewport(parent: Instance, model: Model, props: Props?): ViewportFrame
	local merged: Props = {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 205),
		LightColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.3, -1, -0.4),
	}
	local given: Props = props or {}
	for key, value in given do
		merged[key] = value
	end
	local frame = UIKit.new("ViewportFrame", merged)
	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 30
	camera.Parent = frame
	frame.CurrentCamera = camera
	model.Parent = frame
	local cf, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local radius = math.max(size.Magnitude / 2, 0.5)
	local distance = radius / math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView / 2)) * 1.08
	local from = cf.Position + Vector3.new(0.45, 1, 0.75).Unit * distance
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(from, cf.Position)
	frame.Parent = parent
	return frame
end

return UIKit
